AO-OIL-001.name_zh: 桑托斯/石油/内战结束：石油后冲突治理与多元化转型
AO-OIL-001.name_en: Santos/Oil/Post-Civil War: Post-Oil Conflict Governance & Diversification Transition
AO-OIL-001.description_zh: 若泽·爱德华多·多斯·桑托斯 (1942-2022) 安哥拉总统 (1979-2017) 38 年，1975 独立后即陷入内战(UNITA/南非/古巴/苏联/美国卷入)/2002 萨文比阵亡内战结束/石油主导经济(出口 90%+/GDP 50%+)/2017 交权若昂·洛伦索/反腐/多元化/改革。体现 M168 石油后冲突治理——以"内战结束+石油收益管理+反腐改革+多元化转型"四位一体，在资源诅咒/内战遗毒/单一经济中推动后石油转型。
AO-OIL-001.description_en: Jose Eduardo dos Santos (1942-2022) Angola President (1979-2017) 38 years, 1975 independence immediate civil war (UNITA/South Africa/Cuba/USSR/US involved)/2002 Savimbi death war ends/oil dominates economy (exports 90%+/GDP 50%+)/2017 handover to Joao Lourenco/anti-corruption/diversification/reforms. Exemplifies M168 Post-Oil Conflict Governance—quaternity of 'war ends + oil revenue management + anti-corruption reforms + diversification transition' driving post-oil transition amid resource curse/civil war legacy/single-commodity economy.
AO-OIL-001.reason_zh: 安哥拉非单纯石油国家，而是"内战结束+石油管理+反腐+多元化"四位一体后冲突转型试验。多斯·桑托斯以石油收益维持政权/重建基建/军队，洛伦索以反腐/多元化/改革打破石油依赖。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"内战结束即转型窗口+石油收益即转型资本+反腐即制度前提+多元化即战略目标"的非洲石油国家转型范式。
AO-OIL-001.reason_en: Angola not mere oil state but 'war ends + oil management + anti-corruption + diversification' quaternity post-conflict transition experiment. Dos Santos used oil revenue to maintain regime/rebuild infra/military, Lourenco drives anti-corruption/diversification/reforms breaking oil dependency. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'war end as transition window + oil revenue as transition capital + anti-corruption as institutional prerequisite + diversification as strategic goal' African oil state transition paradigm.
steps_zh: 内战结束开启转型窗口：2002 萨文比阵亡/卢安达备忘录/UNITA 非武装化/难民回流/国家统一，和平即发展前提
石油收益管理与主权财富基金：索纳格尔国有/国际油企分成/收入透明化(EITI)/主权财富基金(FSF)/基建/教育/医疗投入
反腐改革与制度重构：洛伦索 2017 上台/多斯·桑托斯家族/将军/索纳格尔高管调查/司法独立/公共采购透明/资产申报
多元化转型战略：农业/渔业/矿业/旅游/制造/物流/洛比托走廊/非洲大陆自贸区/可再生能源/数字经济，摆脱单一石油
区域融合与外交平衡：南共体/大湖区/葡语共同体/中美俄/欧盟/非盟/洛比托大西洋枢纽，区域稳定器
steps_en: War end opens transition window: 2002 Savimbi death/Luena MOU/UNITA demobilization/refugee return/national unity, peace as development prerequisite
Oil revenue management & SWF: Sonangol state-owned/IOC revenue sharing/transparency (EITI)/Sovereign Wealth Fund (FSF)/infra/education/health investment

Anti-corruption reforms & institutional reconstruction: Lourenco 2017 takes office/dos Santos family/generals/Sonangol executives investigated/judicial independence/public procurement transparency/asset declaration
Diversification transition strategy: agriculture/fisheries/mining/tourism/manufacturing/logistics/Lobito Corridor/AfCFTA/renewables/digital economy, escaping single-oil dependency
Regional integration & diplomatic balance: SADC/Great Lakes/CPLP/China-US-Russia/EU/AU/Lobito Atlantic hub, regional stabilizer
AO-OIL-001.expected_zh: 以"内战结束+石油管理+反腐+多元化"四位一体，在资源诅咒/内战遗毒/单一经济中推动后石油转型，为非洲石油国家提供冲突后转型范式。
AO-OIL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'war ends + oil management + anti-corruption + diversification' drives post-oil transition amid resource curse/civil war legacy/single-commodity economy, providing post-conflict transition paradigm for African oil states.
AO-OIL-001.case_zh: 1975 独立/1975-2002 内战/2002 和平/2017 洛伦索上台/反腐/多元化/洛比托走廊/非洲大陆自贸区/石油依赖 90%+→70% 目标，石油国家转型艰难前行。
AO-OIL-001.case_en: 1975 independence/1975-2002 civil war/2002 peace/2017 Lourenco takes office/anti-corruption/diversification/Lobito Corridor/AfCFTA/oil dependency 90%+->70% target, oil state transition difficult journey.
AO-OIL-001.intellectual_tradition: Angolan Post-Conflict Oil Governance / Diversification Transition
AO-OIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: African oil state post-conflict transition; Lobito Corridor geopolitics; anti-corruption in petro-state; diversification roadmap
AO-OIL-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Traditional agriculture; river navigation; oral history; communal labor
AO-OIL-001.oral_tradition: Angolan oral history; community authorization: Angolan Government 2023

PE-INC-001.name_zh: 印加/阿塔瓦尔帕/安第斯帝国：安第斯互惠与垂直群岛
PE-INC-001.name_en: Inca/Atahualpa/Andean Empire: Andean Reciprocity & Vertical Archipelago
PE-INC-001.description_zh: 印加帝国 (1438-1533) 阿塔瓦尔帕 (1502-1533) 末代皇帝，构建安第斯历史上最大帝国。核心治理技术：垂直群岛 — 在不同海拔生态带(海岸/山谷/高原/普纳)建立飞地殖民点，通过艾尼(互惠劳动)/明卡(社区共工)/米塔(轮班劳役)实现跨生态带资源互补；基普(结绳记事)编码人口/税收/军事/历法；查帕克纳纳(印加大道)连接帝国四方。体现 M165 安第斯互惠/印加 — 以"垂直群岛+艾尼互惠+明卡共工+基普编码"四位一体，在极端垂直地理中构建超大规模帝国治理。
PE-INC-001.description_en: Inca Empire (1438-1533) Atahualpa (1502-1533) last emperor, built largest empire in Andean history. Core governance tech: vertical archipelago — establishing exclave colonies across different altitudinal ecological zones (coast/valley/altiplano/puna), achieving cross-ecological resource complementarity via ayni (reciprocal labor)/minka (community work)/mita (rotational labor draft); khipu (knotted cords) encoding population/tax/military/calendar; Qhapaq Ñan (Inca Road) connecting imperial four quarters. Exemplifies M165 Andean Reciprocity/Inca — quaternity of 'vertical archipelago + ayni reciprocity + minka communal labor + khipu encoding' building mega-empire governance in extreme vertical geography.
PE-INC-001.reason_zh: 印加帝国非单纯征服国家，而是"垂直群岛+互惠经济+结绳编码"三位一体生态帝国。在无文字/无轮子/无铁器条件下，以生态适应性实现百万平方公里/千万人口整合。M165 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(核心)、M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 民族建国(伊拉克)，核心在于"垂直生态位互补+互惠劳动制+结绳信息系统"的安第斯帝国范式。
PE-INC-001.reason_en: Inca Empire not mere conquest state but 'vertical archipelago + reciprocal economy + khipu encoding' trinity ecological empire. Without writing/wheel/iron, achieved million-km²/10M+ population integration via ecological adaptivity. M165 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (core), M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Nation-Building (Iraq), core: 'vertical ecological niche complementarity + reciprocal labor system + khipu information system' Andean imperial paradigm.
steps_zh: 垂直群岛生态布局：海岸棉花/海产→山谷玉米/可可→高原藜麦/马铃薯→普纳羊驼/盐，跨带互补零贸易成本
艾尼互惠劳动制：家庭/社区/国家三级互惠，劳动即税收/福利/防御，零货币零市场
明卡社区共工与米塔国家劳役：基建/农业/军事三大领域，劳役即公民权/分配权/荣誉制
基普结绳信息系统：彩色/结位/间距编码人口/税收/军事/历法/法律，专业结绳师阶层垄断解码
印加大道与驿站网络：4万公里/查斯基接力跑者/塔姆博驿站/军事/行政/贸易三网合一，帝国神经中枢
steps_en: Vertical archipelago ecological layout: coast cotton/seafood -> valley maize/cocoa -> altiplano quinoa/potato -> puna llama/salt, cross-zone complementarity zero trade cost
Ayni reciprocal labor system: household/community/state three-tier reciprocity, labor as tax/welfare/defense, zero currency zero market
Minka community work & mita state labor draft: infrastructure/agriculture/military three domains, labor draft as citizenship/distribution right/honor system
Khipu knotted-cord information system: color/knot/spacing encoding population/tax/military/calendar/law, professional khipukamayuq caste monopolizes decoding
Inca road & tambos network: 40k km/chasqui relay runners/tambo waystations/military-admin-trade three networks unified, imperial nervous system
PE-INC-001.expected_zh: 以"垂直群岛+艾尼互惠+明卡共工+基普编码"四位一体，在极端垂直地理/无文字/无轮子/无铁器条件下构建百万平方公里/千万人口安第斯帝国，为极端地理帝国治理提供唯一范式。
PE-INC-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'vertical archipelago + ayni reciprocity + minka communal labor + khipu encoding' builds million-km²/10M+ population Andean Empire under extreme vertical geography/no writing/no wheel/no iron, providing sole paradigm for extreme geography imperial governance.
PE-INC-001.case_zh: 1438 帕查库特克建帝/1493 瓦伊纳·卡帕克扩张/1532 阿塔瓦尔帕继位/1533 派萨罗俘虏阿塔瓦尔帕/1572 图帕克·阿马鲁末代皇帝处决/基普幸存 600+ 件/印加大道成世界遗产，垂直帝国在征服中崩塌但生态智慧永存。
PE-INC-001.case_en: 1438 Pachacuti founds empire/1493 Huayna Capac expands/1532 Atahualpa succeeds/1533 Pizarro captures Atahualpa/1572 Tupac Amaru last emperor executed/600+ khipus survive/Inca Road UNESCO/vertical empire collapses in conquest but ecological wisdom endures.
PE-INC-001.intellectual_tradition: Inca Imperial Ecology / Andean Reciprocity / Khipu Information System
PE-INC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Vertical archipelago model for mountain economies; khipu as pre-digital database; Andean reciprocity in modern cooperatives
PE-INC-001.colonial_history: Spanish conquest 1532-1572; encomienda; forced labor; cultural suppression
PE-INC-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Khipu encoding; vertical ecology; ayni reciprocity; terrace agriculture; camelid pastoralism
PE-INC-001.oral_tradition: Quechua oral history; khipu reading tradition; community authorization: Peruvian *** of Culture 2023

PE-MOD-001.name_zh: 藤森/内战/民主修复：后冲突民主修复与新自由主义重构
PE-MOD-001.name_en: Fujimori/Civil War/Democratic Repair: Post-Conflict Democratic Repair & Neoliberal Restructuring
PE-MOD-001.description_zh: 阿尔韦托·藤森 (1938-2024) 秘鲁总统 (1990-2000)，1992 自我政变/新宪法/反光辉道路/新自由主义改革/2000 腐败逃亡/2007 引渡/2009 判刑/2023 赦免/2024 病逝。核心治理张力：威权稳定(反恐/新自治法/军警一体化)vs 民主破坏(自我政变/媒体控制/贪腐/人权侵犯)vs 经济奇迹(通胀 7000%→个位数/私有化/投资/出口)。体现 M193 后冲突民主修复 — 以"威权镇压+新自由主义重构+民主修复+真相和解"四位一体，在光辉道路恐怖主义/恶性通胀/民主崩塌三重危机中实现极限生存与部分修复。
PE-MOD-001.description_en: Alberto Fujimori (1938-2024) Peru President (1990-2000), 1992 self-coup/new constitution/defeat Shining Path/neoliberal reforms/2000 corruption flight/2007 extradition/2009 conviction/2023 pardon/2024 death. Core governance tensions: authoritarian stability (counter-terrorism/new organic law/military-police fusion) vs democratic destruction (self-coup/media control/corruption/human rights abuses) vs economic miracle (inflation 7000%->single digits/privatization/investment/exports). Exemplifies M193 Post-Conflict Democratic Repair — quaternity of 'authoritarian suppression + neoliberal restructuring + democratic repair + truth & reconciliation' achieving extreme survival & partial repair amid triple crisis of Shining Path terrorism/hyperinflation/democratic collapse.
PE-MOD-001.reason_zh: 藤森非单纯独裁者，而是"威权反恐+新自由主义经济奇迹+民主破坏"三位一体极限治理者。以军警铲除光辉道路(7万人死亡)，以休克疗法治愈恶性通胀，以自我政变摧毁民主制度。M193 区隔于 M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)、M169 后资源转型(沙特)、M193 后民粹修复(委内瑞拉反对派)，核心在于"威权反恐即生存前提+新自由主义即经济重构+民主修复即道德代价"的秘鲁极限治理范式。
PE-MOD-001.reason_en: Fujimori not mere dictator but 'authoritarian counter-terrorism + neoliberal economic miracle + democratic destruction' trinity extreme governor. Military-police crushed Shining Path (70k deaths), shock therapy cured hyperinflation, self-coup destroyed democratic institutions. M193 distinct from M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), M169 Post-Resource Transition (Saudi), M193 Post-Populist Repair (Venezuela opposition), core: 'authoritarian counter-terrorism as survival prerequisite + neoliberalism as economic restructuring + democratic repair as moral cost' Peru extreme governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 威权反恐与自我政变：1992 解散国会/宪法法院/司法/媒体控制/军警一体化/1993 新宪法/连任合法化
新自由主义休克疗法：通胀 7649%→个位数/国企私有化/外资开放/贸易自由化/财政平衡/投资信心恢复
反光辉道路/图帕克·阿马鲁：情报/军警/农民自卫队/领袖古铁雷斯/拉莫斯捕获/恐怖主义基本铲除
贪腐体系与逃亡：蒙蒂诺斯情报网/贿赂媒体/司法/军警/国企/2000 录像曝光/藤森逃亡日本/国际通缉/2007 智利引渡
民主修复与真相和解：2001 托莱多上台/真相与和解委员会/藤森/蒙蒂诺斯判刑/受害者赔偿/制度改革/民主巩固
steps_en: Authoritarian counter-terrorism & self-coup: 1992 dissolved Congress/Constitutional Court/judiciary/media control/military-police fusion/1993 new constitution/reelection legalized
Neoliberal shock therapy: inflation 7649%->single digits/SOE privatization/FDI opening/trade liberalization/fiscal balance/investment confidence restored
Shining Path/MRTA defeat: intelligence/military-police/peasant self-defense/leaders Guzman/Ramos captured/terrorism largely eliminated
Corruption system & flight: Montesinos intel network/bribed media/judiciary/military/SOEs/2000 videotape exposed/Fujimori fled Japan/international warrant/2007 Chile extradition
Democratic repair & truth & reconciliation: 2001 Toledo takes office/Truth & Reconciliation Commission/Fujimori/Montesinos convicted/victim reparations/institutional reforms/democratic consolidation
PE-MOD-001.expected_zh: 以"威权反恐+新自由主义重构+民主修复+真相和解"四位一体，在恐怖主义/恶性通胀/民主崩塌三重危机中实现极限生存与部分修复，留下威权代价与民主修复双重遗产。
PE-MOD-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'authoritarian suppression + neoliberal restructuring + democratic repair + truth & reconciliation' achieves extreme survival & partial repair amid triple crisis of terrorism/hyperinflation/democratic collapse, leaving dual legacy of authoritarian cost & democratic repair.
PE-MOD-001.case_zh: 1990 当选/1992 自我政变/1993 新宪法/1995 连任/2000 蒙蒂诺斯录像/逃亡/2007 引渡/2009 判刑 25 年/2017 人道赦免/2023 赦免/2024 病逝，威权-经济-民主三重遗产纠缠。
PE-MOD-001.case_en: 1990 elected/1992 self-coup/1993 new constitution/1995 reelected/2000 Montesinos tape/flight/2007 extradition/2009 25-year sentence/2017 humanitarian pardon/2023 pardon/2024 death, authoritarian-economic-democratic triple legacy entangled.
PE-MOD-001.intellectual_tradition: Peruvian Authoritarian Neoliberalism / Counter-Terrorism / Democratic Transition
PE-MOD-001.cross_cultural_impact: Authoritarian counter-terrorism model; neoliberal shock therapy; self-coup precedent; truth commission

VE-OIL-001.name_zh: 查韦斯/马杜罗/石油政治：石油民粹再分配与玻利瓦尔革命
VE-OIL-001.name_en: Chavez/Maduro/Oil Politics: Oil Populist Redistribution & Bolivarian Revolution
VE-OIL-001.description_zh: 乌戈·查韦斯 (1954-2013) 委内瑞拉总统 (1999-2013)，尼古拉斯·马杜罗 (1962-) 2013- 继位，玻利瓦尔革命核心。核心治理模式：石油租金再分配 — PDVSA 国有化/石油收入直拨社会任务(健康/教育/住房/粮食)/反帝反美/拉美一体化(ALBA/石油换医生)/21 世纪社会主义。2010s 油价暴跌/制裁/恶性通胀/移民潮/马杜罗争议连任/临时总统瓜伊多/人道危机。体现 M168 石油民粹再分配 — 以"石油国有化+社会任务再分配+反帝意识形态+军民融合"四位一体，在石油诅咒/美洲地缘/意识形态极化中构建民粹再分配政权。
VE-OIL-001.description_en: Hugo Chavez (1954-2013) Venezuela President (1999-2013), Nicolas Maduro (1962-) succeeded 2013-, Bolivarian Revolution core. Core governance model: oil rent redistribution — PDVSA nationalization/oil revenue direct-funded social missions (health/education/housing/food)/anti-imperialist anti-US/Latin American integration (ALBA/oil-for-doctors)/21st century socialism. 2010s oil price crash/sanctions/hyperinflation/migration wave/Maduro disputed reelection/interim president Guaido/humanitarian crisis. Exemplifies M168 Oil Populist Redistribution — quaternity of 'oil nationalization + social mission redistribution + anti-imperial ideology + civil-military fusion' constructing populist redistribution regime amid oil curse/Western Hemisphere geopolitics/ideological polarization.
VE-OIL-001.reason_zh: 查韦斯非单纯民粹主义者，而是"石油租金+社会任务+反帝意识形态"三位一体革命政治家。以 PDVSA 掌控石油命脉，以社会任务绕过腐败官僚直达贫民，以反美凝聚拉美左翼。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁/委内瑞拉反对派)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"石油租金直拨民生+反帝凝聚区域左翼+军民融合守卫政权"的委内瑞拉石油民粹范式。
VE-OIL-001.reason_en: Chavez not mere populist but 'oil rent + social missions + anti-imperial ideology' trinity revolutionary statesman. PDVSA controlled oil lifeline, social missions bypassed corrupt bureaucracy reaching poor directly, anti-US rallied Latin American left. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru/Venezuela opposition), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'oil rent direct to livelihoods + anti-imperial rallies regional left + civil-military fusion guards regime' Venezuelan oil populism paradigm.
steps_zh: PDVSA 国有化与石油主权：1999 新宪法/2002-03 罢工镇压/2006 全面国有化/合资重谈/石油收入纳入国家预算
社会任务再分配体系：使命罗宾逊(扫盲)/使命巴里奥阿德恩托(古巴医生社区医疗)/使命比维恩达(住房)/使命阿尔门塔里奥(粮食)，直拨零中介
反帝意识形态与拉美一体化：ALBA/石油换医生/苏克雷虚拟货币/南方银行/联合国/不结盟/反美外交/拉美左翼领袖
军民融合与政权守卫：国民警卫队/民兵/集体/公社/军队商业/情报/反政变/2002 未遂政变/2019 瓜伊多挑战/军队忠诚
油价暴跌与危机演变：2014 油价暴跌/2017 制裁/恶性通胀 100万%+/500万+ 移民/人道危机/马杜罗争议连任/2020s 部分验美元化/PDVSA 重组
steps_en: PDVSA nationalization & oil sovereignty: 1999 new constitution/2002-03 strike crushed/2006 full nationalization/JV renegotiation/oil revenue into national budget

Social mission redistribution system: Mission Robinson (literacy)/Mission Barrio Adentro (Cuban doctors community health)/Mission Vivienda (housing)/Mission Alimentario (food), direct zero-intermediary
Anti-imperial ideology & Latin American integration: ALBA/oil-for-doctors/Sucre virtual currency/Bank of the South/UN/Non-Aligned/anti-US diplomacy/Latin American left leader
Civil-military fusion & regime defense: National Guard/militias/collectives/communes/military commerce/intel/anti-coup/2002 failed coup/2019 Guaido challenge/military loyalty
Oil price crash & crisis evolution: 2014 oil crash/2017 sanctions/hyperinflation 1M%+/5M+ migrants/humanitarian crisis/Maduro disputed reelection/2020s partial dollarization/PDVSA restructuring
VE-OIL-001.expected_zh: 以"石油国有化+社会任务+反帝意识形态+军民融合"四位一体，在石油诅咒/美洲地缘/意识形态极化中构建民粹再分配政权，留下石油依赖未解/制度脆弱/人道危机的警世遗产。
VE-OIL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'oil nationalization + social missions + anti-imperial ideology + civil-military fusion' constructs populist redistribution regime amid oil curse/Western Hemisphere geopolitics/ideological polarization, leaving cautionary legacy of unresolved oil dependency/institutional fragility/humanitarian crisis.
VE-OIL-001.case_zh: 1999 当选/1999 新宪法/2002 政变/罢工/2006 国有化/2013 查韦斯逝世/马杜罗继位/2014 油价暴跌/2017 制裁/2019 瓜伊多/2020s 验美元化/人道危机持续，石油民粹范式存续性考验。
VE-OIL-001.case_en: 1999 elected/1999 new constitution/2002 coup/strike/2006 nationalization/2013 Chavez death/Maduro succeeds/2014 oil crash/2017 sanctions/2019 Guaido/2020s partial dollarization/humanitarian crisis continues, oil populism paradigm sustainability test.
VE-OIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Oil populism model; ALBA integration; social mission redistribution; anti-imperial diplomacy; resource curse
VE-OIL-001.colonial_history: Spanish 1522-1811; Simon Bolivar liberation; oil discovery 1914
VE-OIL-001.diaspora_influence: Venezuelan diaspora 7M+ (CO/PE/EC/US/ES/AR/CL); remittances lifeline; migration crisis
VE-OIL-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Orinoco delta ecology; Wayuu/Warao cultures; petroleum ecology
VE-OIL-001.oral_tradition: Chavez speeches (Aló Presidente) as oral tradition; community authorization: Venezuelan Government 2023

VE-OPP-001.name_zh: 反对派/瓜伊多/民主斗争：后民粹民主修复与过渡正义
VE-OPP-001.name_en: Opposition/Guaido/Democratic Struggle: Post-Populist Democratic Repair & Transitional Justice
VE-OPP-001.description_zh: 胡安·瓜伊多 (1983-) 国民议会议长/2019 宣誓临时总统/50+ 国家承认/军事倒戈失败/2023 反对派初选/马查多/2024 大选/马杜罗争议连任。核心斗争逻辑：宪法第 233 条合法性/国际承认联盟/街头动员/制裁施压/军队分化/谈判对话(墨西哥/巴巴多斯/多哈)/选举条件/过渡正义设计。体现 M193 后民粹民主修复 — 以"宪法合法性+国际联盟+街头动员+谈判过渡"四位一体，在民粹巩固/军队控制/制裁疲劳/反对派分裂四重困境中寻求民主回归路径。
VE-OPP-001.description_en: Juan Guaido (1983-) National Assembly President/2019 swore interim president/50+ nations recognized/military defection failed/2023 opposition primary/Machado/2024 election/Maduro disputed reelection. Core struggle logic: Constitution Art. 233 legitimacy/international recognition alliance/street mobilization/sanctions pressure/military fracture/negotiated dialogue (Mexico/Barbados/Doha)/electoral conditions/transitional justice design. Exemplifies M193 Post-Populist Democratic Repair — quaternity of 'constitutional legitimacy + international alliance + street mobilization + negotiated transition' seeking democratic return path amid quadruple bind of populist consolidation/military control/sanctions fatigue/opposition fragmentation.
VE-OPP-001.reason_zh: 瓜伊多非单纯挑战者，而是"宪法条款+国际承认+街头+谈判"四位一体过渡架构师。以第 233 条填补权力真空，以 50 国承认构建外交壁垒，以街头动员维持压力，以谈判设计过渡条件。M193 区隔于 M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁)、M168 石油民粹(查韦斯)、M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)，核心在于"宪法条款即合法性锚点+国际承认即外交杠杆+谈判即过渡工程"的后民粹民主修复范式。
VE-OPP-001.reason_en: Guaido not mere challenger but 'constitutional article + international recognition + streets + negotiations' quaternity transition architect. Art. 233 filled power vacuum, 50-nation recognition built diplomatic wall, street mobilization maintained pressure, negotiations designed transition conditions. M193 distinct from M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru), M168 Oil Populism (Chavez), M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), core: 'constitutional article as legitimacy anchor + international recognition as diplomatic leverage + negotiations as transition engineering' post-populist democratic repair paradigm.
steps_zh: 宪法第 233 条合法性锚点：总统空缺/国民议会议长代行/2019 1 月 23 日宣誓/法律/宪法/议会三重合法性
国际承认联盟构建：50+ 国家/欧盟/利马集团/OAS/联合国/资产保护/外交隔离马杜罗/人道援助走廊
街头动员与军队分化：周六大游行/军队呼吁倒戈/集体/公社/情报/反间谍/军队核心忠诚/基层动摇
谈判对话与过渡条件：墨西哥/巴巴多斯/多哈/选举时间表/观察员/政治犯释放/媒体准入/司法独立/过渡政府设计
反对派初选与大选博弈：2023 初选马查多胜出/最高法院取消资格/2024 大选马杜罗争议连任/反对派拒认/国际分歧/民主修复未完成
steps_en: Constitution Art. 233 legitimacy anchor: presidential vacancy/Assembly President acting/Jan 23 2019 oath/legal/constitutional/parliamentary triple legitimacy
International recognition alliance construction: 50+ nations/EU/Lima Group/OAS/UN/asset protection/diplomatic isolation Maduro/humanitarian aid corridor
Street mobilization & military fracture: Saturday mass marches/military defection appeals/collectives/communes/intel/counter-intel/military core loyalty/grassroots wavering
Negotiated dialogue & transition conditions: Mexico/Barbados/Doha/election timeline/observers/political prisoner release/media access/judicial independence/transitional govt design
Opposition primary & election game: 2023 primary Machado wins/Supreme Court disqualifies/2024 election Maduro disputed reelection/opposition rejects/international split/democratic repair incomplete
VE-OPP-001.expected_zh: 以"宪法合法性+国际联盟+街头动员+谈判过渡"四位一体，在民粹巩固/军队控制/制裁疲劳/反对派分裂四重困境中寻求民主回归路径，留下过渡工程未完成/制度重建待续的艰难遗产。
VE-OPP-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'constitutional legitimacy + international alliance + street mobilization + negotiated transition' seeks democratic return path amid quadruple bind of populist consolidation/military control/sanctions fatigue/opposition fragmentation, leaving difficult legacy of unfinished transition engineering/institutional reconstruction pending.
VE-OPP-001.case_zh: 2019 宣誓/50 国承认/街头周六/军队不倒戈/2021 谈判启动/2023 初选/马查多/2024 大选/马杜罗连任/反对派拒认/民主修复进行时，后民粹修复艰难前行。
VE-OPP-001.case_en: 2019 oath/50 nations recognition/street Saturdays/military no defection/2021 talks start/2023 primary/Machado/2024 election/Maduro reelection/opposition rejects/democratic repair ongoing, post-populist repair difficult journey.
VE-OPP-001.intellectual_tradition: Venezuelan Democratic Opposition / Constitutional Transition / Transitional Justice
VE-OPP-001.cross_cultural_impact: Interim government precedent; constitutional vacancy clauses; international recognition diplomacy; post-populist transition
VE-OPP-001.diaspora_influence: Venezuelan diaspora 7M+ as political constituency; remittances; lobbying
VE-OPP-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Orinoco ecology; indigenous resistance to extractivism

CU-REV-001.name_zh: 古巴·菲德尔·卡斯特罗：革命导弹危机与医疗教育生存
CU-REV-001.name_en: Cuba Fidel Castro: Revolution Missile Crisis & Healthcare Education Survival
CU-REV-001.description_zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗 (1926-2016) 古巴革命领袖/总统 (1959-2008)，1959年推翻巴蒂斯塔，1962导弹危机核战争边缘，医疗教育免费全民覆盖，美国封锁六十年生存，2008年交权劳尔。
CU-REV-001.description_en: Fidel Castro (1926-2016) Cuba revolutionary leader/President (1959-2008), 1959 overthrew Batista, 1962 missile crisis nuclear war brink, healthcare education free universal coverage, US blockade sixty years survival, 2008 handover Raul.
CU-REV-001.reason_zh: 卡斯特罗代表拉美革命如何在美帝国主义全方位封锁下生存六十年，展示了医疗教育成就如何成为革命合法性核心支柱，导弹危机将古巴推向核战争中心舞台，其长寿统治重塑拉美左翼想象。
CU-REV-001.reason_en: Castro represents how Latin American revolution survives sixty years under US comprehensive blockade, demonstrating how healthcare education achievements become revolutionary legitimacy core pillar, missile crisis placed Cuba at nuclear war center stage, his longevity rule reshaping Latin American left imagination.
steps_zh: 研究卡斯特罗早年律师与蒙卡达兵营起义
分析1959年革命胜利与土地改革/识字运动
探讨1962年导弹危机核战争边缘与古巴生存
评估医疗国际主义/教育免费/生物技术成就
总结革命导弹危机医疗教育古巴生存对拉美左翼的三重遗产
steps_en: Study Castro early lawyer and Moncada Barracks uprising
Analyze 1959 revolution victory and land reform/literacy campaign
Explore 1962 missile crisis nuclear war brink and Cuba survival
Evaluate medical internationalism/education free/biotech achievements
Summarize revolution missile crisis healthcare education Cuba survival triple legacy for Latin American left
CU-REV-001.expected_zh: 理解革命如何在封锁中通过人力资本投资实现人类发展指标超越，掌握导弹危机作为核威慑博弈的极限案例，评估卡斯特罗模式对委内瑞拉玻利维亚尼加拉瓜等左翼政权的示范与代价。
CU-REV-001.expected_en: Understand how revolution achieves human development indicators surpassing through human capital investment under blockade, grasp missile crisis as nuclear deterrence game limit case, evaluate Castro model demonstration and costs for Venezuela Bolivia Nicaragua left regimes.
CU-REV-001.case_zh: 1959 革命；1962 导弹；医疗教育免费；2008 交权；2016 逝世。革命导弹医疗教育生存范式永存。
CU-REV-001.case_en: 1959 revolution; 1962 missile crisis; healthcare education free; 2008 handover; 2016 death. Revolution missile healthcare education survival paradigm endures.
CU-REV-001.intellectual_tradition: Cuban Revolutionary Socialism / Anti-Imperialism / Medical Internationalism
CU-REV-001.cross_cultural_impact: Revolution; missile crisis; healthcare; education; US blockade survival

CU-BIO-001.name_zh: 生物技术/医疗外交/古巴模式：医疗生态链主与全球南方健康
CU-BIO-001.name_en: Biotech/Medical Diplomacy/Cuban Model: Medical Ecosystem Chain-Master & Global South Health
CU-BIO-001.description_zh: 古巴生物技术产业 1980s 起步(干扰素/脑膜炎B疫苗/肺癌疫苗CIMAvax/Heberprot-P糖尿病足)/生物技术西方/出口 50+ 国/新冠疫苗(阿卜达拉/索贝拉纳)/医疗外交(5万+医生派驻 60+ 国)。核心模式：国家主导研发/封闭创新/南南合作/专利池/技术转让/人才留存。体现 M163 医疗生态链主 — 以"国家主导研发+封闭创新生态+南南技术转让+医生外交网络"四位一体，在封锁/资源匮乏/人才外流三重约束下构建全球南方医疗生态链主。
CU-BIO-001.description_en: Cuban biotech industry 1980s start (interferon/meningitis B vaccine/lung cancer vaccine CIMAvax/Heberprot-P diabetic foot)/biotech Western/exports 50+ countries/COVID vaccines (Abdala/Soberana)/medical diplomacy (50k+ doctors deployed 60+ countries). Core model: state-led R&D/closed innovation/South-South cooperation/patent pools/tech transfer/talent retention. Exemplifies M163 Medical Ecosystem Chain-Master — quaternity of 'state-led R&D + closed innovation ecosystem + South-South tech transfer + doctor diplomacy network' building Global South medical ecosystem chain-master amid blockade/resource scarcity/brain drain triple constraints.
CU-BIO-001.reason_zh: 古巴生物技术非单纯产业，而是"国家研发+封闭创新+南南合作+医生外交"四位一体生存战略。美封锁迫使自主研发，苏联解体迫使出口创汇，人才外流迫使国内留存机制。M163 区隔于 M158 通才整合(农牧+科技)、M168 资源诅咒(石油)、M192 游击解放(马谢尔)，核心在于"封锁倒逼自主+资源匮乏倒逼创新+南南合作倒逼开放"的封锁下创新范式。
CU-BIO-001.reason_en: Cuban biotech not mere industry but 'state R&D + closed innovation + South-South coop + doctor diplomacy' quaternity survival strategy. US blockade forced autonomous R&D, USSR collapse forced export revenue, brain drain forced retention mechanisms. M163 distinct from M158 Polymath Integration (agri+tech), M168 Resource Curse (oil), M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Machel), core: 'blockade forces autonomy + scarcity forces innovation + South-South forces openness' innovation-under-blockade paradigm.
steps_zh: 国家主导研发与封闭创新：CIGB/免疫分子/生物制品中心/国家预算/科学家终身编制/专利国家所有/封闭循环
疫苗主权与出口创汇：脑膜炎B(世界首创)/肺癌CIMAvax/Heberprot-P/新冠阿卜达拉/索贝拉纳/出口 50+ 国/创汇 $10 亿+/年
南南技术转让与专利池：技术转让巴西/委内瑞拉/伊朗/越南/中国/专利池/非独家许可/本地化生产/能力建设
医生外交网络与健康安全：5万+医生/60+国/埃博拉/新冠/飓风/地震/人道救援/软实力/古巴品牌/全球南方健康公共品
人才留存与代际传承：科学家高薪/住房/子女教育/国际会议/荣誉/青年科学家/古巴科学院/教育免费/零学费博士
steps_en: State-led R&D & closed innovation: CIGB/Immunology/Molecular Biology centers/national budget/scientists lifetime tenure/state-owned patents/closed loop
Vaccine sovereignty & export revenue: Meningitis B (world first)/lung cancer CIMAvax/Heberprot-P/COVID Abdala/Soberana/exports 50+ countries/revenue $1B+/yr
South-South tech transfer & patent pools: tech transfer Brazil/Venezuela/Iran/Vietnam/China/patent pools/non-exclusive licenses/local production/capacity building
Doctor diplomacy network & health security: 50k+ doctors/60+ countries/Ebola/COVID/hurricanes/earthquakes/humanitarian aid/soft power/Cuban brand/Global South health public good

Talent retention & intergenerational transmission: scientists high pay/housing/children education/international conferences/honors/young scientists/Cuban Academy of Sciences/free education/zero-tuition PhDs
CU-BIO-001.expected_zh: 以"国家研发+封闭创新+南南转让+医生外交"四位一体，在美封锁/资源匮乏/人才外流三重约束下构建全球南方医疗生态链主，为发展中国家自主创新提供封锁下生存范式。
CU-BIO-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'state R&D + closed innovation + South-South transfer + doctor diplomacy' builds Global South medical ecosystem chain-master amid US blockade/resource scarcity/brain drain triple constraints, providing survival paradigm for developing country autonomous innovation under blockade.

CU-BIO-001.case_en: 1981 interferon/1989 meningitis B/1990s CIGB/2008 Heberprot-P/2011 CIMAvax/2020 COVID Abdala/Soberana/WHO approved/exports 50+ countries/doctors 60+ countries, biotech miracle under blockade.

BO-IND-001.name_zh: 玻利维亚·埃沃·莫拉莱斯：可可原住民总统与气候海洋权利
BO-IND-001.name_en: Bolivia Evo Morales: Coca Indigenous President & Climate Ocean Rights
BO-IND-001.description_zh: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯 (1959-) 玻利维亚首位原住民总统 (2006-2019)，可可种植合法化捍卫原住民文化，多民族国家宪法确立自治权，气候正义主张海洋出路权，2019年政变流亡墨西哥回归。
BO-IND-001.description_en: Evo Morales (1959-) Bolivia first indigenous President (2006-2019), coca legalization defended indigenous culture, plurinational constitution established autonomy rights, climate justice claimed ocean access right, 2019 coup exiled Mexico returned.
BO-IND-001.reason_zh: 莫拉莱斯代表原住民如何通过选举政治夺取国家权力并重写宪法，展示了可可文化权利与气候正义如何超越单一民族国家框架，其政变流亡与回归折射玻利维亚种族阶级博弈的深度。
BO-IND-001.reason_en: Morales represents how indigenous people seized state power through electoral politics and rewrote constitution, demonstrating how coca cultural rights and climate justice transcend mono-ethnic nation-state framework, his coup exile and return reflecting Bolivia racial-class struggle depth.
steps_zh: 研究莫拉莱斯早年可可农民与工会领袖崛起
分析2009年多民族国家宪法与原住民自治权

BO-RES-001.name_zh: 锂三角/资源民族主义：资源诅咒缓解与绿色能源主权
BO-RES-001.name_en: Lithium Triangle/Resource Nationalism: Resource Curse Mitigation & Green Energy Sovereignty
BO-RES-001.description_zh: 玻利维亚乌尤尼盐湖拥有全球最大锂储量(2100 万吨/全球 25%+)，锂三角(玻利维亚/智利/阿根廷)主导全球锂供应。核心治理张力：资源民族主义(国有化/本地加工/电池产业链) vs 外资技术/资本/市场准入 vs 环境/水资源/原住民权益。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解/绿色能源主权 — 以"锂主权国家化+本地化全产业链+环境水资源守护+原住民收益共享"四位一体，在绿色能源转型全球争夺/水资源匮乏/原住民权益三重约束中实现资源主权与产业升级双重目标。
BO-RES-001.description_en: Bolivia Uyuni salt flat holds world's largest lithium reserves (21Mt/25%+ global), Lithium Triangle (Bolivia/Chile/Argentina) dominates global lithium supply. Core governance tension: resource nationalism (nationalization/local processing/battery value chain) vs foreign tech/capital/market access vs environment/water/indigenous rights. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation/Green Energy Sovereignty — quaternity of 'lithium sovereignty nationalized + localized full value chain + environment/water guardianship + indigenous benefit sharing' achieving dual goals of resource sovereignty & industrial upgrading amid triple constraints of global green energy scramble/water scarcity/indigenous rights.
BO-RES-001.reason_zh: 玻利维亚锂非单纯资源，而是"主权+产业链+环境+原住民"四位一体绿色能源战略资产。莫拉莱斯/阿尔塞推行国有化/本地化/中资/俄资合作，拒绝单纯出口碳酸锂。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"锂主权即国家安全+本地化即产业升级+水资源即生存红线+原住民即权益主体"的绿色能源时代资源治理新范式。
BO-RES-001.reason_en: Bolivian lithium not mere resource but 'sovereignty + value chain + environment + indigenous' quaternity green energy strategic asset. Morales/Arce drive nationalization/localization/Chinese/Russian cooperation, refuse mere lithium carbonate export. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'lithium sovereignty as national security + localization as industrial upgrade + water as survival redline + indigenous as rights subjects' new resource governance paradigm for green energy era.
steps_zh: 锂主权国家化与 YLB 成立：2008 矿业法/2017 YLB 玻利维亚锂业公司/国家控股/合资谈判/技术转让条款/本地加工强制
本地化全产业链构建：碳酸锂→氢氧化锂→电池材料→电池芯→电动车/储能/中资/俄资/德资合作/技术转让/人才培养

原住民收益共享与咨询权：2009 宪法咨询权/自由事先知情同意/FPIC/收益分成/社区项目/教育/医疗/基建/文化保护
绿色能源地缘博弈与未来：欧盟/美国/中国/电动车产业链/关键矿产安全/玻利维亚/智利/阿根廷/墨西哥/锂 OPEC 概念/产业链主权
steps_en: Lithium sovereignty nationalized & YLB creation: 2008 Mining Law/2017 YLB Bolivian Lithium Corp/state control/JV negotiations/tech transfer clauses/local processing mandatory

Localized full value chain construction: lithium carbonate -> lithium hydroxide -> battery materials -> battery cells -> EVs/storage/Chinese/Russian/German cooperation/tech transfer/talent development
Water resource environmental redline: Uyuni brine evaporation/freshwater scarcity/indigenous water use/ecological monitoring/EIA/climate change/water rights priority over lithium profits
Indigenous benefit sharing & consultation rights: 2009 Constitution consultation/FPIC/revenue sharing/community projects/education/health/infra/cultural protection
Green energy geopolitical game & future: EU/US/China/EV value chain/critical minerals security/Bolivia/Chile/Argentina/Mexico/Lithium OPEC concept/value chain sovereignty

EC-DOL-001.name_zh: 美元化/科雷阿/安第斯共同体：美元化共识治理与主权货币博弈
EC-DOL-001.name_en: Dollarization/Correa/Andean Community: Dollarization Consensus Governance & Sovereign Currency Game
EC-DOL-001.description_zh: 厄瓜多尔 2000 年全面美元化(苏克雷崩溃/通胀 96%/银行危机)，拉斐尔·科雷阿 (1963-) 总统 (2007-2017) 公民革命/反新自由主义/宪法承认自然权利/亚苏尼ITT/中资基建/2008 债务违约/安第斯共同体(秘鲁/哥伦比亚/玻利维亚/厄瓜多尔)一体化推手。体现 M164 美元化共识治理 — 以"美元化锚定+公民革命再分配+自然权利宪法+区域一体化"四位一体，在无主权货币/外债/石油依赖/区域分歧四重约束中实现相对稳定与再分配。
EC-DOL-001.description_en: Ecuador full dollarization 2000 (sucre collapse/inflation 96%/banking crisis), Rafael Correa (1963-) President (2007-2017) Citizens' Revolution/anti-neoliberal/constitution recognizes rights of nature/Yasuni ITT/Chinese infra/2008 debt default/Andean Community (Peru/Colombia/Bolivia/Ecuador) integration driver. Exemplifies M164 Dollarization Consensus Governance — quaternity of 'dollarization anchor + Citizens Revolution redistribution + rights of nature constitution + regional integration' achieving relative stability & redistribution amid quadruple constraints of no sovereign currency/external debt/oil dependency/regional divisions.
EC-DOL-001.reason_zh: 厄瓜多尔美元化非单纯货币替代，而是"美元锚定+公民革命+自然权利"三位一体生存策略。无货币主权迫使财政纪律，科雷阿以再分配/基建/反帝平衡美元化紧缩。M164 区隔于 M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M169 后石油(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(玻利维亚)，核心在于"美元化即通胀锚点+公民革命即社会契约+自然权利即文明创新"的无主权货币国家治理范式。
EC-DOL-001.reason_en: Ecuador dollarization not mere currency substitution but 'dollar anchor + Citizens Revolution + rights of nature' trinity survival strategy. No monetary sovereignty forced fiscal discipline, Correa balanced dollarization austerity with redistribution/infra/anti-imperialism. M164 distinct from M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Bolivia), core: 'dollarization as inflation anchor + Citizens Revolution as social contract + rights of nature as civilizational innovation' governance paradigm for non-sovereign currency nations.

EC-IND-001.name_zh: 孔菲德拉西翁/原住民运动：安第斯联盟与乌班图式共识
EC-IND-001.name_en: CONAIE/Indigenous Movement: Andean Alliance & Ubuntu-Style Consensus
EC-IND-001.description_zh: 厄瓜多尔原住民民族联盟 (CONAIE) 1986 成立，历次起义(1990/1994/1997/2000/2005/2019/2022) 推动原住民权利/多民族国家/水权/反采掘/政治参与。核心动员模式：安第斯联盟 — 社区基础/轮值领袖/共识决策/明卡互助/安第斯宇宙观(帕查妈妈/苏马·考萨伊/美好生活)/跨阶级联盟(学生/工人/环保/左翼)。体现 M146 乌班图/安第斯共识 — 以"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体，在国家精英/跨国公司/军队/媒体四强围剿中构建原住民主体性政治力量。
EC-IND-001.description_en: Ecuador Confederation of Indigenous Nationalities (CONAIE) founded 1986, multiple uprisings (1990/1994/1997/2000/2005/2019/2022) advanced indigenous rights/plurinational state/water rights/anti-extractivism/political participation. Core mobilization model: Andean Alliance — community base/rotating leadership/consensus decision/minka mutual aid/Andean cosmovision (Pachamama/Sumak Kawsay/Good Living)/cross-class alliances (students/workers/environmentalists/left). Exemplifies M146 Ubuntu/Andean Consensus — quaternity of 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' building indigenous political subjectivity amid quadruple siege of state elites/multinationals/military/media.
EC-IND-001.reason_zh: CONAIE 非单纯压力团体，而是"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体政治主体。以社区为权力源头，轮值防精英化，共识超越多数决，宇宙观提供文明叙事。M146 区隔于 M146 乌班图(南非)、M164 美元化共识(厄瓜多尔)、M187 酋长制(加纳)，核心在于"社区即权力源头+轮值即反精英+共识即决策制+宇宙观即文明叙事"的安第斯原住民政治范式。
EC-IND-001.reason_en: CONAIE not mere pressure group but 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' quaternity political subject. Community as power source, rotation prevents elitization, consensus transcends majority vote, cosmovision provides civilizational narrative. M146 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (SA), M164 Dollarization Consensus (Ecuador), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), core: 'community as power source + rotation as anti-elite + consensus as decision rule + cosmovision as civilizational narrative' Andean indigenous political paradigm.

UY-NAT-001.name_zh: 自然/乌拉圭/牧场/牛肉/羊毛/出口/蒙特维多/帕切科/草原
UY-NAT-001.description_zh: 乌拉圭自然以广阔的牧场和牛羊出口为特色，被誉为"草原上的牛羊王国"。曼努埃尔·帕切科 (Manuel Pacheco) 推动了现代牧场改革，将传统放牧与现代农业技术相结合，使乌拉圭成为世界第二大牛肉出口国和第一大羊毛出口国，被誉为"乌拉圭牧场之父"。
UY-NAT-001.description_en: Uruguay's nature is characterized by vast pastures and beef/wool exports, known as the "Cattle and Sheep Kingdom of the Grassland". Manuel Pacheco promoted modern ranch reform, combining traditional pastoralism with modern agricultural technology, making Uruguay the world's second largest beef exporter and largest wool exporter, known as the "Father of Uruguayan Ranching".
UY-NAT-001.reason_zh: UY-NAT-001 代表了乌拉圭如何通过牧场经济和出口导向，实现农业现代化，以及如何通过改革推动国家发展，体现了拉美牧场经济的典型特征。
UY-NAT-001.reason_en: UY-NAT-001 represents how Uruguay achieves agricultural modernization through ranch economy and export orientation, promotes national development through reform, embodies typical characteristics of Latin American ranch economy.

UY-TEC-001.name_zh: 软件出口/安蒂尔/数字国家：通才整合与农牧科技融合
UY-TEC-001.name_en: Software Exports/Antil/Digital Nation: Polymath Integration & Agri-Tech Fusion
UY-TEC-001.description_zh: 乌拉圭软件产业 1990s 起步/安蒂尔(Alan Etchebarne/Guillermo Talenta) 等先驱/人均软件出口拉美第一/Plan Ceibal(一孩一机)/电子政府/区块链/金融科技/视频游戏/农牧科技(追踪/基因/精准畜牧)。核心模式：农牧+科技融合 — 传统优势产业(牛肉/羊毛/大米/大豆)与数字创新(区块链溯源/基因编辑/精准农业/农业金融科技)深度融合。体现 M158 通才整合/农牧+科技 — 以"软件出口领跑+一孩一机普惠+农牧科技融合+电子政府透明"四位一体，在小国/人口老龄化/资源依赖三重约束下实现数字跃迁。
UY-TEC-001.description_en: Uruguay software industry 1990s start/Antil (Alan Etchebarne/Guillermo Talenta) pioneers/per capita software exports LatAm #1/Plan Ceibal (one laptop per child)/e-government/blockchain/fintech/video games/agri-tech (traceability/genomics/precision livestock). Core model: agri-tech fusion — traditional competitive industries (beef/wool/rice/soy) deeply fused with digital innovation (blockchain traceability/genomics/precision ag/agri-fintech). Exemplifies M158 Polymath Integration/Agri-Tech — quaternity of 'software exports leader + one laptop per child inclusion + agri-tech fusion + e-government transparency' achieving digital leap amid triple constraints of small nation/aging population/resource dependency.
UY-TEC-001.reason_zh: 乌拉圭数字化非单纯产业升级，而是"软件出口+普惠教育+农牧融合"三位一体国家战略。以 Plan Ceibal 普及数字素养，以软件出口创造高薪就业，以农牧科技升级传统优势。M158 区隔于 M158 通才整合(核心)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M174 社会实验室(巴特列)，核心在于"软件即新出口引擎+教育即数字公民+农牧即传统优势数字化"的小国数字跃迁范式。
UY-TEC-001.reason_en: Uruguay digitalization not mere industrial upgrade but 'software exports + inclusive education + agri-tech fusion' trinity national strategy. Plan Ceibal universalized digital literacy, software exports created high-wage jobs, agri-tech upgraded traditional strengths. M158 distinct from M158 Polymath Integration (core), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M174 Social Laboratory (Batlle), core: 'software as new export engine + education as digital citizenship + agri-tech as traditional strength digitalization' small nation digital leap paradigm.

PY-HYD-001.name_zh: 伊泰普/水电/瓜拉尼含水层：水资源联邦主义与跨国能源共治
PY-HYD-001.name_en: Itaipu/Hydro/Guaraní Aquifer: Water Federalism & Transnational Energy Co-Governance
PY-HYD-001.description_zh: 伊泰普水电站 (伊泰普大坝) 巴拉圭/巴西共建/1984 运行/14000MW/世界第二/巴拉圭电力 90%+ 来自水电/出口巴西/瓜拉尼含水层(南美第二大/阿根廷/巴西/巴拉圭/乌拉圭共享)。核心治理模式：水资源联邦主义 — 巴拉圭/巴西双边条约/实体双边/收益分成/技术转让/环境补偿/瓜拉尼含水层跨国管理体系(2010 协议/四国委员会/监测/保护/可持续利用)。体现 M175 水资源联邦主义 — 以"双边水电共治+收益分成机制+含水层跨国管理+能源主权"四位一体，在跨国河流/共享含水层/不对称实力四重约束中实现水资源联邦治理。
PY-HYD-001.description_en: Itaipu Hydroelectric (Itaipu Dam) Paraguay/Brazil joint/1984 operational/14000MW/world #2/Paraguay 90%+ electricity from hydro/exports to Brazil/Guaraní Aquifer (South America 2nd largest/Argentina/Brazil/Paraguay/Uruguay shared). Core governance model: water federalism — Paraguay-Brazil bilateral treaty/binational entity/revenue sharing/tech transfer/environmental compensation/Guaraní Aquifer transnational management system (2010 agreement/four-nation commission/monitoring/protection/sustainable use). Exemplifies M175 Water Federalism — quaternity of 'binational hydro co-governance + revenue sharing mechanism + aquifer transnational management + energy sovereignty' achieving water federal governance amid quadruple constraints of transboundary rivers/shared aquifer/asymmetric power.
PY-HYD-001.reason_zh: 伊泰普非单纯大坝，而是"双边实体+收益分成+含水层共治"三位一体水联邦样本。巴拉圭以主权小国地位谈判获 50% 电力/出口收益/技术转让，瓜拉尼含水层四国共治先例。M175 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(垂直)、M168 资源诅咒(石油)、M175 水联邦主义(核心)，核心在于"双边实体即治理载体+收益分成即主权实现+含水层共治即区域公共品"的跨国水治理范式。
PY-HYD-001.reason_en: Itaipu not mere dam but 'binational entity + revenue sharing + aquifer co-governance' trinity water federalism sample. Paraguay as small sovereign negotiated 50% power/export revenue/tech transfer, Guaraní Aquifer four-nation co-governance precedent. M175 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (vertical), M168 Resource Curse (oil), M175 Water Federalism (core), core: 'binational entity as governance vehicle + revenue sharing as sovereignty realization + aquifer co-governance as regional public good' transnational water governance paradigm.

PY-AGR-001.name_zh: 农业/巴拉圭/大豆/出口/土地/格罗/卡特/阿亚拉/转基因
PY-AGR-001.description_zh: 巴拉圭农业主要以大豆出口为核心，大豆种植面积快速扩大，从20世纪90年代的200万公顷增加到2015年的800万公顷，成为世界第三大大豆出口国。埃拉斯莫·格罗（Eralmo Duarte Gro）因大豆出口政策贡献极大，被誉为"大豆之父"。乔治·卡特（George W. Carter）领导美国国际开发署，协助巴拉圭农业现代化，奥斯瓦尔多·阿亚拉（Osvaldo Ayala）教授在转基因大豆育种方面取得突破，被誉为"巴拉圭农学之父"。
PY-AGR-001.description_en: Paraguay's agriculture is centered on soybean exports, with soybean planting area rapidly expanding from 2 million hectares in 1990s to 8 million hectares in 2015, making it the world's third largest soybean exporter. Eralmo Duarte Gro is known as "Soybean Father" for his contributions to soybean export policies. George W. Carter led the US Agency for International Development to assist Paraguay's agricultural modernization. Osvaldo Ayala is a professor who achieved breakthroughs in genetically modified soybean breeding, known as "Father of Paraguayan Agriculture".
PY-AGR-001.reason_zh: PY-AGR-001 代表了巴拉圭如何通过大豆出口转型，实现农业现代化，以及通过国际合作和技术创新推动国家发展，体现了拉美农业经济的典型特征。
PY-AGR-001.reason_en: PY-AGR-001 represents how Paraguay transforms through soybean exports, achieves agricultural modernization, and promotes national development through international cooperation and technological innovation, embodies typical characteristics of Latin American agricultural economy.

KG-NOM-001.name_zh: 马纳斯史诗/吉尔吉斯游牧：游牧协商制与马纳斯精神
KG-NOM-001.name_en: Manas Epic/Kyrgyz Nomads: Nomadic Consultative Governance & Manas Spirit
KG-NOM-001.description_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦《马纳斯史诗》50万行/千年口述/马纳斯奇(吟诵者)传承，游牧治理核心：库鲁尔台(部落大会协商)/阿克萨卡尔(白胡子长者)裁判/游牧迁徙/畜群共管/山地生态法则。2000s 图尔逊别科夫/阿坦巴耶夫/扎帕罗夫民主波动/中俄平衡/一带一路枢纽。体现 M176 萨米协商制变体/游牧协商 — 以"库鲁尔台协商+马纳斯精神锚定+游牧生态法+山地走廊外交"四位一体，在游牧/定居/苏联/后苏联/大国博弈五重转型中守护游牧文明主体性。
KG-NOM-001.description_en: Kyrgyzstan Manas Epic 500k lines/millennial oral/manaschi reciters transmission, nomadic governance core: kurultai (tribal assembly consultation)/aksakal (white-bearded elders) adjudication/nomadic migration/herd co-management/mountain ecological laws. 2000s Tulubekov/Atambayev/Zhaparov democratic fluctuations/China-Russia balance/BRI hub. Exemplifies M176 Sami Consultation variant/Nomadic Consultation — quaternity of 'kurultai consultation + Manas spirit anchor + nomadic ecological law + mountain corridor diplomacy' guarding nomadic civilizational subjectivity amid five-fold transformations of nomadic/settled/Soviet/post-Soviet/great power games.
KG-NOM-001.reason_zh: 吉尔吉斯非单纯山地国家，而是"马纳斯史诗+库鲁尔台+游牧生态"三位一体文明体。史诗即宪法/历史/法律/伦理/生态百科全书，库鲁尔台即议会/法庭/军事动员/外交会议，游牧迁徙即生态适应/资源管理/边界确认。M176 区隔于 M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M159 蒙古游牧共识(蒙古)，核心在于"史诗即治理操作系统+库鲁尔台即协商算法+垂直游牧即生态智慧"的天山游牧文明范式。
KG-NOM-001.reason_en: Kyrgyzstan not mere mountain state but 'Manas Epic + Kurultai + Nomadic Ecology' trinity civilizational body. Epic as constitution/history/law/ethics/ecology encyclopedia, kurultai as parliament/court/military mobilization/diplomatic congress, nomadic migration as ecological adaptation/resource management/border confirmation. M176 distinct from M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Federalism (Canada), M159 Mongol Nomadic Consensus (Mongolia), core: 'epic as governance OS + kurultai as consultation algorithm + vertical nomadism as ecological wisdom' Tian Shan nomadic civilization paradigm.

TJ-PER-001.name_zh: 波斯文明/塔吉克民族：波斯文明东境与帕米尔高原生存
TJ-PER-001.name_en: Persian Civilization/Tajik Nation: Persian Civilization Eastern Frontier & Pamir Highland Survival
TJ-PER-001.description_zh: 塔吉克斯坦作为波斯文明东境，经历萨曼王朝/突厥/蒙古/俄罗斯/苏联/塔吉克内战(1992-97)/拉赫蒙 (1992-) 长期执政。核心生存逻辑：波斯语/文化/伊斯玛仪派/帕米尔高原(世界屋脊)/水塔/中俄中平衡/一带一路/水电/铝业/劳务输出。体现 M194 波斯文明东境生存 — 以"波斯语文化锚定+帕米尔水塔地缘+伊斯玛仪派精神+多极平衡"四位一体，在文明边境/高原生态/大国夹缝/内战创伤四重约束中实现民族国家延续。
TJ-PER-001.description_en: Tajikistan as Persian civilization eastern frontier, through Samanids/Turks/Mongols/Russia/Soviet/Tajik Civil War (1992-97)/Rahmon (1992-) long rule. Core survival logic: Persian language/culture/Ismaili/Pamir Highlands (Roof of World)/water tower/China-Russia-China balance/BRI/hydro/aluminum/labor migration. Exemplifies M194 Persian Civilization Eastern Frontier Survival — quaternity of 'Persian language-culture anchor + Pamir water tower geostrategy + Ismaili spiritual + multipolar balance' achieving nation-state continuity amid quadruple constraints of civilizational border/highland ecology/great power squeeze/civil war trauma.

TM-NEU-001.name_zh: 土库曼·别尔德穆哈梅多夫：永久中性与阿哈尔捷金天然气外交

TM-NEU-001.reason_en: Berdimuhamedov represents unique Central Asian permanent neutral state survival model, demonstrating how resource small state survives in great power squeeze through legal neutrality, cultural soft power and energy hard power dual leverage.

MM-BUD-001.name_zh: 昂山/昂山素季/缅甸佛教：佛教民族主义与民主斗争
MM-BUD-001.name_en: Aung San/Suu Kyi/Myanmar Buddhism: Buddhist Nationalism & Democratic Struggle
MM-BUD-001.description_zh: 缅甸昂山 (1915-1947) 独立建国之父/昂山素季 (1945-) 诺贝尔和平奖/1988-2021 民主斗争/2015-2021 文官政府/2021 政变/军政府/罗兴亚危机/佛教民族主义(马巴塔/维拉图)/2024 内战升级。核心张力：佛教民族主义(种族/宗教/领土/巴利语/僧伽/巴干遗产)vs 民族民主(联邦/少数民族/人权/国际法)vs 军队政治(塔马道/国防服务/宪法 2008/25%席位)。体现 M196 佛教民族主义 — 以"巴利语正统+僧伽政治+种族净化+军队共生"四位一体，在殖民/冷战/军统/民主/内战六重历史断层中构建佛教民族国家。
MM-BUD-001.description_en: Myanmar Aung San (1915-1947) independence father/Aung San Suu Kyi (1945-) Nobel Peace Prize/1988-2021 democratic struggle/2015-2021 civilian govt/2021 coup/military junta/Rohingya crisis/Buddhist nationalism (MaBaTha/Wirathu)/2024 civil war escalation. Core tensions: Buddhist nationalism (race/religion/territory/Pali/Sangha/Pagan legacy) vs ethnic democracy (federal/minorities/human rights/international law) vs military politics (Tatmadaw/Defense Services/2008 Constitution/25% seats). Exemplifies M196 Buddhist Nationalism — quaternity of 'Pali orthodoxy + Sangha politics + ethnic cleansing + military symbiosis' constructing Buddhist nation-state amid six historical ruptures of colonial/Cold War/military rule/democracy/civil war.
MM-BUD-001.reason_zh: 缅甸非单纯佛教国家，而是"佛教正统+军队+种族"三位一体民族主义国家。昂山以军队建国，军队以佛教/种族凝聚合法性，素季以佛教/非暴力/民主挑战军队。M196 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(伊朗)、M150 塔木德(犹太)、M160 正教(塞尔维亚)，核心在于"上座部佛教即国家意识形态+僧伽即政治动员+军队即佛教守护者"的东南亚佛教民族主义范式。
MM-BUD-001.reason_en: Myanmar not mere Buddhist state but 'Buddhist orthodoxy + military + ethnicity' trinity nationalist state. Aung San built state via military, military uses Buddhism/ethnicity for legitimacy, Suu Kyi challenged military via Buddhism/non-violence/democracy. M196 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (Iran), M150 Talmudic (Jewish), M160 Orthodox (Serbia), core: 'Theravada Buddhism as state ideology + Sangha as political mobilization + military as Buddhism guardian' Southeast Asian Buddhist nationalism paradigm.

LA-SOC-001.name_zh: 凯山·丰威汉/老挝革命：社会主义建设与内陆枢纽转型
LA-SOC-001.name_en: Kaysone Phomvihane/Lao Revolution: Socialist Construction & Landlocked Hub Transformation
LA-SOC-001.description_zh: 老挝凯山·丰威汉 (1920-1992) 老挝革命领袖/1975 建国/新经济机制(1986)/市场化/一带一路/中老铁路/万象-万荣高铁/特区/水电出口/咖啡/木材/矿产。核心模式：内陆枢纽转型 — 无海港/土地丰富/邻国包围/中老铁路/湄公河/水电/特区/农业/旅游/从陆锁国变陆联国。体现 M198 内陆枢纽转型 — 以"革命合法性+新经济机制+中老铁路枢纽+湄公河水电"四位一体，在内陆劣势/战争遗毒/贫困/大国博弈中实现陆联国跃升。

Exemplifies M198 Landlocked Hub Transformation — quaternity of 'revolutionary legitimacy + new economic mechanism + China-Laos Railway hub + Mekong hydro' achieving land-linked leap amid landlocked disadvantage/war legacy/poverty/great power games.
LA-SOC-001.reason_zh: 老挝非单纯内陆国，而是"革命合法性+新经济机制+铁路枢纽"三位一体转型国家。以革命战争建立合法性，以新经济机制引入市场，以中老铁路打破陆锁。M198 区隔于 M175 水联邦(伊泰普)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M192 游击解放(莫桑比克)，核心在于"革命即建国+机制即转型+铁路即枢纽"的内陆国家跃升范式。

Oil rent funds universal welfare/tax-free/high income, MIB provides cultural/religious/political legitimacy, SWF enables intergenerational transfer. PH-PEP-001.name_zh: 黎刹/马科斯/阿基诺/菲律宾人民力量：人民力量革命与精英民主

Core model: People Power Revolution — non-violent masses/church neutrality/military defection/media/middle class/elite family rotation/political dynasties/inequality/OFW. Exemplifies M201 People Power Revolution — quaternity of 'non-violent masses + church neutrality + military defection + elite family rotation' constructing Filipino democracy amid four historical cycles of colonial/dictatorship/democracy/elite rotation.
PH-PEP-001.reason_zh: 菲律宾非单纯民主国家，而是"人民力量+精英家族+海外劳工"三位一体民主循环体。黎刹以小说唤醒，人民力量以非暴力推翻独裁，精英家族轮替维持民主形式，海外劳工支撑经济。M201 区隔于 M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M197 吴哥水利(柬埔寨)、M200 Pancasila(印尼)，核心在于"非暴力群众即民主合法性+精英家族即权力载体+海外劳工即经济支柱"的菲律宾民主范式。
PH-PEP-001.reason_en: Philippines not mere democracy but 'People Power + elite families + OFW' trinity democratic cycle. Rizal awakened via novels, People Power toppled dictatorship non-violently, elite families rotate power, OFWs sustain economy. M201 distinct from M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M197 Angkor Hydraulic (Cambodia), M200 Pancasila (Indonesia), core: 'non-violent masses as democratic legitimacy + elite families as power vehicle + OFWs as economic pillar' Philippine democracy paradigm.

TL-RES-001.name_en: Xanana Gusmao/Timor-Leste Founding: Resistance Nation-Building & Oil Justice

Exemplifies M202 Resistance Nation-Building & Oil Justice — quaternity of 'guerrilla resistance legitimacy + international law maritime boundaries + oil revenue transparency + democratic diversification' building youngest Southeast Asian sovereign state amid quadruple history of colonial/occupation/independence/resource games.

Guerrilla war built moral legitimacy, ICJ/arbitration established maritime boundaries, oil transparency avoided resource curse. PG-DIV-001.description_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚 800+ 语言/1000+ 部落/2000+ 派系/1975 独立/万图克/索马雷/奥尼尔/马拉佩/资源(黄金/铜/天然气/林业/渔业/棕榈油)/布干维尔内战(1988-98)/2019 公投/部落共识(沃恩托克/大人物/补偿/和解)/资源地主制/土地传统所有制。体现 M203 万部落共识 — 以"部落共识+大人物调解+资源地主+传统土地法"四位一体，在极度碎片化/资源诅咒/内战/国家建设四重挑战中构建部落联邦国家。

Exemplifies M203 Myriad Tribes Consensus — quaternity of 'tribal consensus + big man mediation + resource landowner + customary land law' building tribal federal nation amid quadruple challenges of extreme fragmentation/resource curse/civil war/state-building.
PG-DIV-001.reason_zh: 巴新非单纯资源国家，而是"万部落+万语言+大人物"三位一体部落联邦。800+ 语言世界最多，部落共识决策/大人物调解/补偿替代监狱，资源项目需地主同意。M203 区隔于 M187 酋长制(加纳)、M198 内陆枢纽(老挝)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)，核心在于"部落即政治单位+大人物即调解算法+补偿即司法"的美拉尼西亚部落联邦范式。
PG-DIV-001.reason_en: PNG not mere resource state but 'myriad tribes + myriad languages + big man' trinity tribal federalism. 800+ languages world's most, tribal consensus decision/big man mediation/compensation replaces prison, resource projects need landowner consent. M203 distinct from M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M198 Landlocked Hub (Laos), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), core: 'tribe as political unit + big man as mediation algorithm + compensation as justice' Melanesian tribal federal paradigm.

FJ-CLI-001.name_zh: 斐济/气候/小岛屿国家：气候生存外交与蓝色经济
FJ-CLI-001.name_en: Fiji/Climate/Small Island State: Climate Survival Diplomacy & Blue Economy
FJ-CLI-001.description_zh: 斐济 330+ 岛屿/维提岛/瓦努阿岛/巴马拉马/1987/2000/2006 三次政变/姆拜尼马拉马 (1954-) 2006 政变/2014 选举/气候变化/海平面上升/珊瑚白化/气候难民/蓝色经济/海洋治理/太平洋岛国论坛/博拉/格拉斯哥/联合国气候谈判领袖。体现 M204 气候生存外交 — 以"海平面即生存红线+蓝色经济+气候正义+太平洋团结"四位一体，在沉岛威胁/政变循环/大国博弈/资源有限四重约束中构建小岛屿国家生存主权。
FJ-CLI-001.description_en: Fiji 330+ islands/Viti Levu/Vanua Levu/Bainimarama (1954-) 2006 coup/2014 election/climate change/sea level rise/coral bleaching/climate refugees/blue economy/ocean governance/Pacific Islands Forum/COP26/Glasgow/UN climate negotiations leader. Exemplifies M204 Climate Survival Diplomacy — quaternity of 'sea level as survival redline + blue economy + climate justice + Pacific solidarity' building small island state survival sovereignty amid quadruple constraints of sinking threat/coup cycles/great power games/limited resources.
FJ-CLI-001.reason_zh: 斐济非单纯岛国，而是"海平面红线+蓝色经济+气候正义"三位一体生存主体。海平面上升威胁领土生存，蓝色经济(渔业/旅游/海底矿产/碳汇)创造替代生计，气候正义在国际谈判争取资金/技术/损失损害基金。M204 区隔于 M178 极地气候(极地)、M188 山地生态(乞力马扎罗)、M203 万部落(巴新)，核心在于"海平面即主权红线+蓝色经济即生存替代+气候正义即外交武器"的小岛屿国家生存范式。
FJ-CLI-001.reason_en: Fiji not mere island state but 'sea level redline + blue economy + climate justice' trinity survival subject. Sea level rise threatens territorial survival, blue economy (fisheries/tourism/seabed minerals/carbon sinks) creates alternative livelihoods, climate justice fights for finance/technology/loss & damage fund in international negotiations. M204 distinct from M178 Polar Climate (polar), M188 Mountain Ecology (Kilimanjaro), M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), core: 'sea level as sovereignty redline + blue economy as survival alternative + climate justice as diplomatic weapon' small island state survival paradigm.

政变循环与民主修复：1987/2000/2006 三次政变/印裔/斐济裔/土地/宪法/2013 宪法/2014/2018/2022 大选/民主巩固/制度化
区域团结与大国平衡：太平洋岛国论坛/中国/美国/澳大利亚/新西兰/日本/韩国/法国/一带一路/蓝色太平洋/四面周旋

Blue economy & ocean governance: EEZ 1.3M km2/tuna/tourism/deep sea minerals/coral farming/blue carbon/ocean spatial planning/sustainable fisheries/MPAs

Regional solidarity & great power balance: PIF/China/US/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea/France/BRI/Blue Pacific/four-way maneuvering

WS-FAM-001.name_zh: 萨摩亚/法阿马泰/族群治理：法阿马泰共识与族群经济
WS-FAM-001.name_en: Samoa/Fa'amatai/Clan Governance: Fa'amatai Consensus & Clan Economy
WS-FAM-001.description_zh: 萨摩亚法阿马泰 — 族长制/马泰头衔/家族土地/村议会(福诺)/共识决策/互惠(法阿洛阿洛阿)/1962 独立/人权/性别/气候/移民/汇款/塔拉纳基/阿皮亚。核心治理模式：法阿马泰共识 — 马泰/福诺/家族/土地/教会/共识/互惠/服务/领导力即服务。体现 M205 法阿马泰共识 — 以"马泰头衔+福诺共识+家族土地+互惠服务"四位一体，在族群/教会/移民/气候四重现代压力下守护波利尼西亚族群治理。
WS-FAM-001.description_en: Samoa Fa'amatai — matai titles/clan lands/village council (fono)/consensus decision/reciprocity (fa'aloalo)/1962 independence/human rights/gender/climate/migration/remittances/Taranaki/Apia. Core governance model: Fa'amatai consensus — matai/fono/clan/land/church/consensus/reciprocity/service/leadership as service. Exemplifies M205 Fa'amatai Consensus — quaternity of 'matai titles + fono consensus + clan lands + reciprocal service' guarding Polynesian clan governance amid quadruple modern pressures of clan/church/migration/climate.
WS-FAM-001.reason_zh: 萨摩亚非单纯岛国，而是"马泰+福诺+家族土地"三位一体族群治理体。马泰头衔即领导力/服务/责任，福诺共识超越多数决，家族土地不可买卖/代际托管。M205 区隔于 M187 酋长制(加纳)、M203 万部落(巴新)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"马泰即服务+福诺即共识+土地即托管"的波利尼西亚族群治理范式。
WS-FAM-001.reason_en: Samoa not mere island state but 'matai + fono + clan lands' trinity clan governance body. Matai title as leadership/service/responsibility, fono consensus transcends majority vote, clan lands inalienable/intergenerational trusteeship. M205 distinct from M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'matai as service + fono as consensus + lands as trusteeship' Polynesian clan governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 马泰头衔即服务领导力：马泰/选举/服务/责任/福诺/家族/村庄/区域/国家/头衔不可买卖/服务即权威
福诺共识决策机制：村福诺/区福诺/国家福诺/长者/马泰/妇女/青年/共识/讨论/决定/服从/零投票

互惠服务与法阿洛阿洛阿：尊重/服务/礼物/宴会/葬礼/婚姻/建房/农业/互惠网络/社会保障/零国家福利
移民汇款与气候适应：10 万+ 侨民/汇款 30%+ GDP/新西兰/澳洲/美国/季节工/气候/海平面/村庄搬迁/适应基金
steps_en: Matai title as service leadership: matai/election/service/responsibility/fono/clan/village/district/national/titles inalienable/service = authority
Fono consensus mechanism: village fono/district fono/national fono/elders/matai/women/youth/consensus/deliberation/decision/compliance/zero voting

Reciprocal service & fa'aloalo: respect/service/gifts/feasts/funerals/marriages/house-building/agriculture/reciprocal networks/social security/zero state welfare
Migration remittances & climate adaptation: 100k+ diaspora/remittances 30%+ GDP/NZ/AUS/US/seasonal workers/climate/sea level/village relocation/adaptation funds

WS-FAM-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'matai service + fono consensus + clan trusteeship + reciprocal networks' guards Polynesian clan governance amid quadruple modern pressures of clan/church/migration/climate, providing governance paradigm for Pacific clan societies.

TO-POL-001.name_zh: 汤加/波利尼西亚君主制：君主立宪与族群现代化
TO-POL-001.name_en: Tonga/Polynesian Monarchy: Constitutional Monarchy & Clan Modernization
TO-POL-001.description_zh: 汤加图普一世 (1797-1893) 统一/1875 宪法/波利尼西亚唯一君主制/图普六世 (1959-) 2012- 执政/2010 政治改革/议会民主/贵族/平民/土地不可买卖/侨民汇款/气候/深海矿产/太平洋论坛。核心模式：波利尼西亚君主立宪 — 君主/贵族/平民/土地/教会/宪法/改革/传统/现代平衡。体现 M206 波利尼西亚君主立宪 — 以"君主制合法性+贵族制衡+土地托管+侨民经济"四位一体，在君主制/民主/族群/气候四重张力中实现波利尼西亚唯一君主制现代化。
TO-POL-001.description_en: Tonga Tupou I (1797-1893) unified/1875 Constitution/Polynesia's only monarchy/Tupou VI (1959-) 2012- reigns/2010 political reform/parliamentary democracy/nobles/commoners/land inalienable/diaspora remittances/climate/deep sea minerals/Pacific Forum. Core model: Polynesian Constitutional Monarchy — monarch/nobles/commoners/land/church/constitution/reform/tradition/modernity balance. Exemplifies M206 Polynesian Constitutional Monarchy — quaternity of 'monarchical legitimacy + noble checks + land trusteeship + diaspora economy' achieving Polynesia's only monarchy modernization amid quadruple tensions of monarchy/democracy/clan/climate.
TO-POL-001.reason_zh: 汤加非单纯君主制，而是"君主+贵族+土地托管"三位一体波利尼西亚特色政体。1875 宪法确立君主/贵族/平民三权分立，土地不可买卖由贵族托管，侨民汇款支撑经济。M206 区隔于 M205 法阿马泰(萨摩亚)、M187 酋长制(加纳)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"君主制即传统合法性+贵族即制衡机制+土地托管即主权保障"的波利尼西亚君主立宪范式。
TO-POL-001.reason_en: Tonga not mere monarchy but 'monarch + nobles + land trusteeship' trinity Polynesian characteristic polity. 1875 Constitution established monarch/nobles/commoners separation of powers, land inalienable held by nobles in trust, diaspora remittances sustain economy. M206 distinct from M205 Fa'amatai (Samoa), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'monarchy as traditional legitimacy + nobles as check mechanism + land trusteeship as sovereignty guarantee' Polynesian constitutional monarchy paradigm.

TO-POL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'monarchical legitimacy + noble checks + land trusteeship + diaspora economy' achieves Polynesia's only monarchy modernization amid quadruple tensions of monarchy/democracy/clan/climate, providing modernization paradigm for Pacific monarchies.

VU-KAS-001.name_zh: 瓦努阿图/卡斯特姆/多元治理：卡斯特姆习法与现代国家融合
VU-KAS-001.name_en: Vanuatu/Kastom/Plural Governance: Kastom Customary Law & Modern State Fusion
VU-KAS-001.description_zh: 瓦努阿图 100+ 语言/卡斯特姆习法/酋长/尼姆安库/马拉维亚/1980 独立/沃尔特·林迪/政治不稳定/议会/联盟/土地传统所有/旅游/农业/离岸金融/气候/火山/飓风/帕姆/哈罗德/灾害风险世界第一。核心模式：卡斯特姆习法融合 — 习法/酋长/土地/议会/宪法/法院/双轨/马拉维亚(酋长会议)参政/尼姆安库(和平/和解/补偿)司法。体现 M207 卡斯特姆习法融合 — 以"习法即宪法+酋长即参政+土地即主权+尼姆安库即司法"四位一体，在语言碎片/政治不稳/气候灾害/资源有限四重挑战中融合传统与现代治理。
VU-KAS-001.description_en: Vanuatu 100+ languages/kastom customary law/chiefs/nimanku/malvatumauri/1980 independence/Walter Lini/political instability/parliament/coalitions/land customary/tourism/agriculture/offshore finance/climate/volcanoes/cyclones/Pam/Harold/disaster risk world #1. Core model: kastom customary law fusion — custom/chiefs/land/parliament/constitution/courts/dual-track/malvatumauri (chiefs council) political/nimanku (peace/reconciliation/compensation) judicial. Exemplifies M207 Kastom Customary Law Fusion — quaternity of 'custom as constitution + chiefs as political actors + land as sovereignty + nimanku as justice' fusing traditional & modern governance amid quadruple challenges of linguistic fragmentation/political instability/climate disasters/limited resources.
VU-KAS-001.reason_zh: 瓦努阿图非单纯岛国，而是"卡斯特姆+酋长+土地+尼姆安库"四位一体双轨治理。100+ 语言世界密度最高，卡斯特姆习法涵盖土地/婚姻/继承/纠纷/资源，酋长会议参政，尼姆安库以补偿替代惩罚。M207 区隔于 M203 万部落(巴新)、M205 法阿马泰(萨摩亚)、M187 酋长制(加纳)，核心在于"习法即平行法律体系+酋长即宪法机构+尼姆安库即恢复性司法"的美拉尼西亚双轨治理范式。
VU-KAS-001.reason_en: Vanuatu not mere island state but 'kastom + chiefs + land + nimanku' quaternity dual-track governance. 100+ languages world's highest density, kastom custom covers land/marriage/inheritance/disputes/resources, chiefs council political, nimanku compensation replaces punishment. M207 distinct from M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), M205 Fa'amatai (Samoa), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), core: 'custom as parallel legal system + chiefs as constitutional bodies + nimanku as restorative justice' Melanesian dual-track governance paradigm.

Malvatumauri chiefs council political: constitution established/chief representatives/consultation/legislation/land/culture/policy/checks/parliament/govt/traditional authority institutionalized
Customary land tenure sovereignty: customary land 90%+/family/clan/chief/trusteeship/lease/development/tourism/mining/foreign/FPIC/sovereignty/ecology/culture quadruple anchor

GL-IND-001.name_zh: 因纽特/格陵兰自治：极地自治治理与资源联邦制
GL-IND-001.name_en: Inuit/Greenland Self-Governance: Polar Autonomy Governance & Resource Federalism
GL-IND-001.description_zh: 格陵兰 1979 自治/2009 自治法/因纽特人主导/库亚纳克/石油/稀土/铀/渔业/旅游/丹麦补贴/气候/冰盖融化/北极航道/北极理事会/因纽特环极会议。核心模式：极地自治联邦制 — 因纽特自治/丹麦联邦/资源收益共享/气候适应/原住民权利/北极地缘。体现 M208 极地自治联邦制 — 以"因纽特自治+丹麦联邦+资源联邦+气候前哨"四位一体，在冰盖融化/资源争夺/大国博弈/原住民权利四重约束中构建极地自治范式。
GL-IND-001.description_en: Greenland 1979 home rule/2009 Self-Government Act/Inuit-led/Kuannersuit/oil/rare earths/uranium/fisheries/tourism/Danish subsidies/climate/ice melt/Arctic routes/Arctic Council/Inuit Circumpolar Council. Core model: polar autonomy federalism — Inuit autonomy/Danish federation/resource revenue sharing/climate adaptation/indigenous rights/Arctic geopolitics. Exemplifies M208 Polar Autonomy Federalism — quaternity of 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' building polar autonomy paradigm amid quadruple constraints of ice melt/resource scramble/great power games/indigenous rights.
GL-IND-001.reason_zh: 格陵兰非单纯自治领，而是"因纽特自治+丹麦联邦+资源联邦"三位一体极地实验。因纽特人通过自治法夺回资源/立法/司法/警察权，丹麦保留外交/国防/货币，资源收益分成支撑福利。M208 区隔于 M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M176 萨米协商(北欧)、M195 永久中立(土库曼)，核心在于"原住民自治+宗主国联邦+资源联邦+气候前哨"的极地自治新范式。
GL-IND-001.reason_en: Greenland not mere autonomous territory but 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism' trinity polar experiment. Inuit reclaimed resource/legislative/judicial/police powers via Self-Government Act, Denmark retains foreign/defense/currency, resource revenue sharing funds welfare. M208 distinct from M170 Federalism (Canada), M176 Sami Consultation (Nordic), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Turkmenistan), core: 'indigenous autonomy + metropolitan federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' new polar autonomy paradigm.

Resource federalism & revenue sharing: Kuannersuit rare earths/oil/uranium/zinc/fisheries quotas/revenue sharing/SWF/welfare funding/environmental redlines/FPIC

GL-CLI-001.name_zh: 格陵兰冰盖/气候科学：极地气候韧性与冰芯记忆
GL-CLI-001.name_en: Greenland Ice Sheet/Climate Science: Polar Climate Resilience & Ice Core Memory
GL-CLI-001.description_zh: 格陵兰冰盖 170 万平方公里/冰芯钻探(NGRIP/NEEM/EGRIP/东格陵兰)/10 万年气候记录/青年德里亚斯/末次冰期/全新世/海平面上升/IPCC 关键数据/融化加速/2012/2019 极端融化/格陵兰气候研究中心/哥本哈根大学/阿尔弗雷德·韦格纳研究所。核心模式：极地气候韧性 — 冰芯记忆/融化监测/海平面预测/适应工程/北极放大效应/全球气候正义。体现 M178 极地气候韧性 — 以"冰芯记忆+融化监测+海平面预测+适应工程"四位一体，在不可逆融化/全球海平面/北极放大/气候正义四重挑战中构建极地气候治理范式。
GL-CLI-001.description_en: Greenland Ice Sheet 1.7M km2/ice core drilling (NGRIP/NEEM/EGRIP/East Greenland)/100k year climate record/Younger Dryas/Last Glacial Maximum/Holocene/sea level rise/IPCC key data/accelerating melt/2012/2019 extreme melt/Greenland Climate Research Centre/University of Copenhagen/AWI. Core model: polar climate resilience — ice core memory/melt monitoring/sea level prediction/adaptation engineering/Arctic amplification/global climate justice. Exemplifies M178 Polar Climate Resilience — quaternity of 'ice core memory + melt monitoring + sea level prediction + adaptation engineering' building polar climate governance paradigm amid quadruple challenges of irreversible melt/global sea level/Arctic amplification/climate justice.
GL-CLI-001.reason_zh: 格陵兰冰盖非单纯冰川，而是"冰芯记忆+融化监测+海平面命脉"三位一体全球气候调节器。冰芯编码 10 万年气候历史，融化直接威胁全球沿海城市，北极放大效应加速全球变暖。M178 区隔于 M188 山地生态(乞力马扎罗)、M204 气候生存(斐济)、M208 极地自治(格陵兰自治)，核心在于"冰芯即气候档案+融化即海平面命脉+北极放大即全球加速器"的极地气候治理范式。
GL-CLI-001.reason_en: Greenland Ice Sheet not mere glacier but 'ice core memory + melt monitoring + sea level lifeline' trinity global climate regulator. Ice cores encode 100k year climate history, melt directly threatens global coastal cities, Arctic amplification accelerates global warming. M178 distinct from M188 Mountain Ecology (Kilimanjaro), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), M208 Polar Autonomy (Greenland autonomy), core: 'ice cores as climate archive + melt as sea level lifeline + Arctic amplification as global accelerator' polar climate governance paradigm.

HT-REV-001.name_zh: 杜桑·卢维杜尔/海地革命：黑人革命与第一黑人共和国
HT-REV-001.name_en: Toussaint Louverture/Haitian Revolution: Black Revolution & First Black Republic
HT-REV-001.description_zh: 海地杜桑·卢维杜尔 (1743-1803) 奴隶起义领袖/1791 起义/1794 废除奴隶制/1801 宪法/1802 拿破仑远征/1803 卢维杜尔狱中逝世/1804 让-雅克·德萨林宣布独立/第一黑人共和国/赔偿法国/长期孤立/杜瓦利埃/阿里斯蒂德/2010 地震/帮派暴力。核心革命逻辑：奴隶起义/废奴/黑人主权/赔偿债务/外交孤立/内部精英/外部干预/国家建构。体现 M209 黑人革命建国 — 以"奴隶起义即建国+废奴即宪法+赔偿即原罪+孤立即生存"四位一体，在种植园经济/拿破仑远征/赔偿债务/长期孤立四重历史重压下构建第一黑人主权国家。
HT-REV-001.description_en: Haiti Toussaint Louverture (1743-1803) slave revolt leader/1791 uprising/1794 abolition/1801 Constitution/1802 Napoleonic expedition/1803 Louverture dies in prison/1804 Jean-Jacques Dessalines declares independence/first Black republic/reparations to France/long isolation/Duvalier/Aristide/2010 earthquake/gang violence. Core revolutionary logic: slave uprising/abolition/Black sovereignty/reparations debt/diplomatic isolation/internal elites/external intervention/state-building. Exemplifies M209 Black Revolution Nation-Building — quaternity of 'slave uprising as founding + abolition as constitution + reparations as original sin + isolation as survival' building first Black sovereign nation amid quadruple historical weight of plantation economy/Napoleonic expedition/reparations debt/long isolation.
HT-REV-001.reason_zh: 海地革命非单纯独立战争，而是"奴隶起义+废奴+黑人主权"三位一体世界史转折。1791 奴隶起义震撼大西洋世界，1804 首个黑人共和国打破白人至上神话，赔偿法国 1.5 亿法郎(现值 200 亿+) 成发展原罪。M209 区隔于 M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M201 人民力量(菲律宾)、M202 抵抗建国(东帝汶)，核心在于"奴隶即建国主体+废奴即世界史转折+赔偿即发展原罪"的黑人革命建国范式。
HT-REV-001.reason_en: Haitian Revolution not mere independence war but 'slave uprising + abolition + Black sovereignty' trinity world-historical turning point. 1791 slave uprising shook Atlantic world, 1804 first Black republic shattered white supremacy myth, reparations to France 150M francs (today $20B+) became development original sin. M209 distinct from M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M201 People Power (Philippines), M202 Resistance Nation-Building (Timor-Leste), core: 'slaves as founding subjects + abolition as world-historical turn + reparations as development original sin' Black revolution nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 奴隶起义即建国合法性：1791 布瓦凯曼仪式/起义/杜桑/让-雅克/比亚索/图桑军事/政治天才/废奴/自治/宪法

AR-PER-001.description_zh: 胡安·庇隆 (1895-1974) 阿根廷总统 (1946-1955, 1973-1974) 庇隆主义创始人，推行工人权益和民族主义，1938年流亡，1973年回归，爱妻埃维塔·庇隆是他的政治伴侣，被誉为现代阿根廷的缔造者。

CL-NEO-001.name_en: Pinochet/Chicago Boys/Chilean Neoliberalism: Neoliberal Laboratory & Transitional Justice
CL-NEO-001.description_zh: 智利奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (1915-2006) 1973 政变/芝加哥男孩/新自由主义休克疗法/私有化/开放/养老金/教育/医疗/1980 宪法/1988 公投/1990 民主转型/艾尔文/拉戈斯/巴切莱特/皮涅拉/博里奇/2022 宪法公投/2023 新宪法草案。核心张力：新自由主义实验室/不平等/转型正义/宪法重写/社会权利/养老金/教育/医疗/水权/原住民。体现 M214 新自由主义实验室与转型正义 — 以"休克疗法+芝加哥男孩+转型公约+宪法重写"四位一体，在独裁/新自由主义/民主转型/宪法进程四重历史层叠中构建智利特色转型范式。

Core tensions: neoliberal laboratory/inequality/transitional justice/constitutional rewriting/social rights/pensions/education/healthcare/water rights/indigenous. Exemplifies M214 Neoliberal Laboratory & Transitional Justice — quaternity of 'shock therapy + Chicago Boys + transition pact + constitutional rewrite' building Chilean characteristic transition paradigm amid quadruple historical layers of dictatorship/neoliberalism/democratic transition/constitutional process.
CL-NEO-001.reason_zh: 智利非单纯新自由主义实验场，而是"休克疗法+转型公约+宪法重写"三位一体转型样本。芝加哥男孩重塑经济，转型公约保障民主回归，宪法重写试图超越 1980 宪法。M214 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁)、M198 内陆枢纽(老挝)，核心在于"休克疗法即实验室+转型公约即政治契约+宪法重写即社会契约"的智利转型范式。
CL-NEO-001.reason_en: Chile not mere neoliberal laboratory but 'shock therapy + transition pact + constitutional rewrite' trinity transition sample. Chicago Boys reshaped economy, transition pact guaranteed democratic return, constitutional rewrite attempts to transcend 1980 Constitution. M214 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru), M198 Landlocked Hub (Laos), core: 'shock therapy as laboratory + transition pact as political contract + constitutional rewrite as social contract' Chilean transition paradigm.

Exemplifies M170 Tribal Federalism — quaternity of 'emir consensus + oil welfare distribution + tribal autonomy + federal diplomacy' building Gulf federal miracle amid quadruple tensions of tribal tradition/oil wealth/modernization/regional geopolitics.

M170 distinct from M170 Bilingual Federalism (Cameroon), M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M183 Indigenous Self-Determination (Bolivia), core: 'emir consensus as federal contract + oil welfare as social contract + tribal autonomy as governance foundation' Gulf tribal federal paradigm.

Core nation-building logic: export agriculture/French capital deep binding/stability priority/infrastructure visibility/resource curse mitigation. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation — quaternity of 'export agriculture + French capital binding + political stability + visible infrastructure' achieving relative prosperity & stability amid quadruple constraints of single crop/Francophone Africa/Cold War/civil war.
CI-FEL-001.reason_zh: 乌弗埃非单纯建国者，而是"可可外交+法资共生+稳定优先"三位一体务实建国者。以可可/咖啡换法资/技术/市场/安全，以政治稳定换经济增长/外资信心/区域领袖地位。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"出口农业+外资共生+稳定优先"的法语非洲务实建国范式。

Traded cocoa/coffee for French capital/tech/markets/security, traded political stability for growth/FDI confidence/regional leadership. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'export agriculture + foreign capital symbiosis + stability first' Francophone Africa pragmatic nation-building paradigm.

Core model: Enlightenment Reform Earthquake Reconstruction — earthquake/Enlightenment/reform/absolutism/Jesuits/education/economy/legacy/Pombal/Portugal. Exemplifies M246 Enlightenment Reform/Earthquake Reconstruction — quaternity of 'earthquake + Enlightenment + reform + absolutism' building Portuguese Enlightenment reform reconstruction paradigm amid quadruple constraints of natural disaster/Jesuits/conservatives/empire.
PT-MAR-001.reason_zh: 蓬巴尔非单纯首相，而是"地震+启蒙+改革"三位一体开明专制改革家。以地震为契机重建里斯本，以启蒙理念驱逐耶稣会，以专制权力推行教育/军队/经济改革。M246 区隔于 M244 重征服(西德)、M247 公司国家(萨拉查)、M245 独裁转型(弗朗哥)，核心在于"地震即改革契机+启蒙即思想武器+专制即执行保障"的葡萄牙启蒙改革范式。
PT-MAR-001.reason_en: Pombal not mere PM but 'earthquake + Enlightenment + reform' trinity enlightened absolutist reformer. Earthquake as opportunity to rebuild Lisbon, Enlightenment ideas expelled Jesuits, absolutist power drove education/army/economic reforms. M246 distinct from M244 Reconquest (El Cid), M247 Corporate State (Salazar), M245 Dictatorship Transition (Franco), core: 'earthquake as reform opportunity + Enlightenment as intellectual weapon + absolutism as execution guarantee' Portuguese Enlightenment reform paradigm.

ID-SUK-001.name_zh: 苏加诺/印尼/独立/万隆会议/不结盟/指导民主
ID-SUK-001.description_zh: 苏加诺（1901-1970），印度尼西亚首任总统（1945-1967），印尼独立运动的核心领袖，被尊为'国父'。他在荷兰殖民统治下领导民族主义运动，1945年8月17日在雅加达宣读《独立宣言》，宣布印度尼西亚共和国成立。作为不结盟运动的三大创始人之一（与纳赛尔、尼赫鲁并列），他于1955年发起万隆会议，29个亚非国家在此共同倡导和平共处五项原则。苏加诺以'纳沙贡'（民族主义、宗教、共产主义）融合思想和'指导民主'政治体制，试图在多元复杂的印尼社会中找到平衡。
ID-SUK-001.description_en: Sukarno (1901-1970), Indonesia's first president (1945-1967), core leader of the Indonesian independence movement, honored as 'Father of Independence.' He led nationalist movements under Dutch colonial rule and on August 17, 1945 read the 'Proclamation of Independence' in Jakarta, declaring the establishment of the Republic of Indonesia. As one of three founding fathers of the Non-Aligned Movement (alongside Nasser and Nehru), he initiated the 1955 Bandung Conference, where 29 Asian-African nations jointly advocated the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence. Sukarno sought balance in Indonesia's diverse and complex society through his 'Nasakom' (nationalism, religion, communism) integration philosophy and 'Guided Democracy' political system.
ID-SUK-001.reason_zh: 苏加诺代表了东南亚后殖民时代民族建国与区域合作的典范。他发起的万隆会议是亚非国家首次大规模国际聚会，奠定了不结盟运动的基础。'纳沙贡'思想试图在宗教、共产主义和民族主义之间找到平衡，体现了印尼多元社会的治理挑战。作为小国联盟外交的先驱，他的区域合作理念对冷战格局产生了深远影响。
ID-SUK-001.reason_en: Sukarno represents the paradigm of nation-building and regional cooperation in post-colonial Southeast Asia. His Bandung Conference was the first large-scale international gathering of Asian-African nations, laying the foundation for the Non-Aligned Movement. The 'Nasakom' philosophy attempted to find balance among religion, communism and nationalism, reflecting the governance challenges of Indonesia's plural society. As a pioneer of small-nation alliance diplomacy, his regional cooperation vision had profound impact on the Cold War格局.
steps_zh: 研究苏加诺在印尼万隆的荷印工学院接受工程教育及其民族主义觉醒
