TM-POE-001.reason_en: Magtymguly represents Central Asian nomadic tribal culture transition to modern national identity spiritual pioneer, demonstrating how fragmented tribes construct unified imagined community through shared poetic language, the spiritual father of Turkmenistan founding.
steps_zh: 研究马格特姆古里早年伊斯兰教育与游历波斯奥斯曼俄国
分析其诗歌融合苏菲神秘主义与土库曼部落现实批判
探讨土库曼语语言标准化与阿拉伯字母适应过程
评估苏联时期马格特姆古里民族化改造与独立后国家象征
总结马格特姆古里对土库曼斯坦语言文字与民族认同的奠基
steps_en: Study Magtymguly early Islamic education and travels to Persia Ottoman Russia
Analyze his poetry fusing Sufi mysticism and Turkmen tribal reality critique
Explore Turkmen language standardization and Arabic script adaptation
Evaluate Soviet period Magtymguly nationalization and post-independence state symbol
Summarize Magtymguly foundational role in Turkmenistan language script and national identity
TM-POE-001.expected_zh: 掌握马格特姆古里苏菲诗歌与民族统一渴望双重内核，理解分裂游牧部落如何通过共同文学语言构建想象共同体，评估其对土库曼斯坦建国精神的永恒支撑。
TM-POE-001.expected_en: Master Magtymguly Sufi poetry and national unification longing dual core, understand how fragmented nomadic tribes build imagined community through shared literary language, evaluate its eternal support for Turkmenistan founding spirit.
TM-POE-001.case_zh: 1724 马格特姆古里生于哈杰雷；1770s 创作巅峰；1807 逝世。土库曼诗歌精神抵抗统一范式永存。
TM-POE-001.case_en: 1724 Magtymguly born in Hajji Qarah; 1770s creative peak; 1807 death. Turkmen poetry spirit resistance unification paradigm endures.
TM-POE-001.cross_cultural_impact: Turkmen language founder; Sufi mysticism; national unification spirit; spiritual totem
TM-POE-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 古典土库曼诗歌/苏菲抒情

TH-REF-001.name_zh: 泰国·拉玛五世朱拉隆功：奴隶废除与现代化改革
TH-REF-001.name_en: Thailand Rama V Chulalongkorn: Slavery Abolition & Modernization Reform
TH-REF-001.description_zh: 朱拉隆功 (1853-1910) 暹罗拉玛五世 (1868-1910)，废除奴隶制、腓特列制度，推行行政、法律、教育、铁路现代化，以灵活外交避免殖民，奠定泰国现代国家基础。
TH-REF-001.description_en: Chulalongkorn (1853-1910) Siam Rama V (1868-1910), abolished slavery and corvee, implemented administrative legal education railway modernization, avoided colonization through flexible diplomacy, laid modern Thai state foundation.
TH-REF-001.reason_zh: 朱拉隆功代表东南亚唯一未被殖民国家的现代化转型典范，展示了绝对君主如何通过自上而下改革实现国家主权保全与现代化双重目标。
TH-REF-001.reason_en: Chulalongkorn represents Southeast Asia only uncolonized nation modernization paradigm, demonstrating how absolute monarch achieves both sovereignty preservation and modernization through top-down reform.
steps_zh: 研究朱拉隆功早年蒙库特王父改革遗产与摄政期
分析1874废除腓特列与1905废除奴隶制渐进路径
探讨月圈改革行政划分与法律法典编纂
评估铁路建设与曼谷城市化现代化
总结灵活外交周旋英法殖民势力保全主权
steps_en: Study Chulalongkorn early Mongkut father reform legacy and regency
Analyze 1874 corvee abolition and 1905 slavery abolition gradual path
Explore Monthon reform administrative division and legal code compilation
Evaluate railway construction and Bangkok urbanization modernization
Summarize flexible diplomacy maneuvering British French colonial powers preserving sovereignty
TH-REF-001.expected_zh: 掌握朱拉隆功渐进改革与外交平衡双重策略，理解东南亚唯一独立国家现代化路径，评估其对当代泰国国家建构的奠基作用。
TH-REF-001.expected_en: Master Chulalongkorn gradual reform and diplomatic balance dual strategy, understand Southeast Asia only independent nation modernization path, evaluate its foundational role for contemporary Thai state construction.
TH-REF-001.case_zh: 1868 即位；1874 废除腓特列；1905 废除奴隶制；1910 逝世。奴隶废除现代化改革范式永存。
TH-REF-001.case_en: 1868 accession; 1874 corvee abolished; 1905 slavery abolished; 1910 death. Slavery abolition modernization paradigm endures.
TH-REF-001.cross_cultural_impact: Uncolonized modernization model; slavery abolition; railway; legal reform

TH-UPR-001.name_zh: 泰国·披耶·巴玛：学生起义与民主军事循环
TH-UPR-001.name_en: Thailand Phibun: Student Uprising & Democracy Military Cycle
TH-UPR-001.description_zh: 披耶·巴玛 (1897-1964) 泰国元帅总理 (1938-1944, 1948-1957)，1932年推翻绝对君主制建立立宪君主制，二战亲日倒向盟友，战后美国支持反共独裁，1973/1992学生起义推翻军政府，民主-军事循环至今。
TH-UPR-001.description_en: Phibun Phahon (1897-1964) Thailand Field Marshal PM (1938-1944, 1948-1957), 1932 overthrew absolute monarchy established constitutional monarchy, WWII pro-Japan then switched to Allies, post-war US-backed anti-communist dictatorship, 1973/1992 student uprisings overthrew military juntas, democracy-military cycle continues.
TH-UPR-001.reason_zh: 披耶代表泰国民主-军事循环的核心人物，展示了立宪君主制如何在军人政治、学生运动、美苏冷战博弈中反复震荡，至今未形成稳定民主巩固机制。
TH-UPR-001.reason_en: Phibun represents Thailand democracy-military cycle core figure, demonstrating how constitutional monarchy oscillates among military politics, student movements, US-Soviet Cold War competition, still lacking stable democratic consolidation mechanism today.
steps_zh: 研究披耶早年军官与1932年立宪革命领袖角色
分析1938-1944首相期亲日政策与泰国收复领土
探讨1947年政变回归与美国反共军事援助
评估1957年萨立特政变下台与1973/1992学生起义循环
总结泰国民主军事循环至今未解的结构性困境
steps_en: Study Phibun early officer and 1932 constitutional revolution leader role
Analyze 1938-1944 PM pro-Japan policy and Thailand territorial recovery
Explore 1947 coup return and US anti-communist military aid
Evaluate 1957 Sarit coup ousting and 1973/1992 student uprising cycle
Summarize Thailand democracy-military cycle structural dilemma unresolved today
TH-UPR-001.expected_zh: 理解泰国立宪君主制下军人政治与学生民主运动的反复博弈，掌握冷战地缘政治对东南亚民主化进程的深度塑造，评估泰国民主巩固的根本障碍。
TH-UPR-001.expected_en: Understand Thai constitutional monarchy military politics and student democratic movement repeated game, grasp Cold War geopolitics deep shaping of Southeast Asian democratization, evaluate Thailand democratic consolidation fundamental obstacles.
TH-UPR-001.case_zh: 1932 立宪革命；1938 首相；1944 辞职；1948 再任；1957 下台；1973/1992 学生起义循环。民主军事循环范式永存。
TH-UPR-001.case_en: 1932 constitutional revolution; 1938 PM; 1944 resigned; 1948 re-PM; 1957 ousted; 1973/1992 student uprising cycle. Democracy military cycle paradigm endures.
TH-UPR-001.cross_cultural_impact: Democracy-military cycle; constitutional monarchy; student uprisings; Cold War proxy

MY-DEV-001.name_zh: 马来西亚·马哈蒂尔：发展主义与多元种族治理
MY-DEV-001.description_zh: 马哈蒂尔·莫哈末 (1925-2024) 马来西亚第四/七任首相 (1981-2003, 2018-2020)，推行"向东看"工业化、多媒体超级走廊、双峰塔建设，实施土著优惠政策平衡种族关系，22年执政创造亚洲四小虎奇迹。
MY-DEV-001.description_en: Mahathir Mohamad (1925-2024) Malaysia 4th/7th PM (1981-2003, 2018-2020), implemented Look East industrialization, Multimedia Super Corridor, Petronas Towers, Bumiputera affirmative action balancing racial relations, 22-year rule created Asian Tiger miracle.
MY-DEV-001.reason_zh: 马哈蒂尔代表后殖民多种族国家通过发展主义实现种族平衡与经济腾飞的典范，展示了威权发展主义如何在多元社会中维持稳定与增长，其眼镜标志性形象象征务实理性。
MY-DEV-001.reason_en: Mahathir represents post-colonial multiracial nation achieving racial balance and economic takeoff through developmentalism, demonstrating how authoritarian developmentalism maintains stability and growth in diverse society, his iconic glasses symbolizing pragmatic rationality.
steps_zh: 研究马哈蒂尔早年医生与马来亚大学学生运动
分析1981年上台与向东看工业化战略
探讨土著优惠政策与华商资本合作共生机制
评估1997亚洲金融风暴拒绝IMF方案自主应对
总结1998安华事件与2018年93岁二度上台创纪录
steps_en: Study Mahathir early doctor and UM student activism
Analyze 1981 accession and Look East industrialization strategy
Explore Bumiputera affirmative action and Chinese capital symbiosis mechanism
Evaluate 1997 Asian financial crisis IMF rejection autonomous response
Summarize 1998 Anwar affair and 2018 93-year-old second term record
MY-DEV-001.expected_zh: 掌握马哈蒂尔发展主义与种族平衡双重治理艺术，理解后殖民多元社会经济腾飞与社会稳定的辩证关系，评估其对东南亚发展模式的深远影响。
MY-DEV-001.expected_en: Master Mahathir developmentalism and racial balance dual governance art, understand post-colonial diverse society economic takeoff and social stability dialectic, evaluate its profound impact on Southeast Asian development model.
MY-DEV-001.case_zh: 1981 首相；1982 向东看；1996 双峰塔；1997 拒绝IMF；2003 交权；2018 二度上台；2024 逝世。发展主义多元眼镜长寿范式永存。
MY-DEV-001.case_en: 1981 PM; 1982 Look East; 1996 Petronas Towers; 1997 rejected IMF; 2003 handover; 2018 second term; 2024 death. Developmentalism diversity glasses longevity paradigm endures.
MY-DEV-001.cross_cultural_impact: Developmentalism model; racial affirmative action; Asian financial crisis; longevity record

MY-IND-001.name_zh: 马来亚·东姑阿都拉曼：温和独立与联邦种族平衡
MY-IND-001.name_en: Malaya Tunku Abdul Rahman: Moderate Independence & Federal Racial Balance
MY-IND-001.description_zh: 东姑阿都拉曼 (1903-1990) 马来亚首任首相 (1957-1970)，通过谈判而非武装斗争实现独立，建立马来西亚联邦(1963)，设计种族平衡宪法(马来特权/华印公民权)，被誉为独立之父。
MY-IND-001.description_en: Tunku Abdul Rahman (1903-1990) Malaya first PM (1957-1970), achieved independence through negotiation not armed struggle, established Malaysia Federation (1963), designed racial balance constitution (Malay privileges/Chinese Indian citizenship), hailed as Father of Independence.
MY-IND-001.reason_zh: 东姑代表东南亚温和过渡独立的典范，展示了精英协商如何在多种族社会中建立权力分享契约，避免了印尼越南式暴力独立代价，奠定马来西亚联邦制基础。
MY-IND-001.reason_en: Tunku represents Southeast Asia moderate transition independence paradigm, demonstrating how elite negotiation builds power-sharing compact in multiracial society, avoiding Indonesia/Vietnam violent independence costs, laying Malaysia federal foundation.
steps_zh: 研究东姑早年王室背景与英国教育精英路径
分析1955年大选胜利与1957年独立谈判
探讨1963年马来西亚联邦成立与新加坡分离(1965)
评估种族暴乱(1969)与东姑下台权力交接
总结温和独立联邦种族平衡模式对东南亚的示范意义
steps_en: Study Tunku early royal background and British education elite path
Analyze 1955 election victory and 1957 independence negotiation
Explore 1963 Malaysia Federation formation and Singapore separation (1965)
Evaluate 1969 racial riots and Tunku resignation power transfer
Summarize moderate independence federal racial balance model demonstration for Southeast Asia
MY-IND-001.expected_zh: 理解精英协商独立如何构建多种族权力分享契约，掌握联邦制与种族平衡宪法设计的核心逻辑，评估其对马来西亚长期稳定的奠基与局限。
MY-IND-001.expected_en: Understand how negotiated independence builds multiracial power-sharing compact, grasp federalism and racial balance constitutional design core logic, evaluate its foundational role and limits for Malaysia long-term stability.
MY-IND-001.case_zh: 1955 大选胜利；1957 独立；1963 联邦成立；1965 新加坡分离；1970 下台。温和独立联邦种族平衡范式永存。
MY-IND-001.case_en: 1955 election win; 1957 independence; 1963 Federation formed; 1965 Singapore separation; 1970 resignation. Moderate independence federal racial balance paradigm endures.
MY-IND-001.cross_cultural_impact: Negotiated independence; federalism; racial balance; Singapore separation

MM-IND-001.name_zh: 缅甸·昂山：独立将军与女儿民主军事张力
MM-IND-001.name_en: Myanmar Aung San: Independence General & Daughter Democracy Military Tension
MM-IND-001.description_zh: 昂山 (1915-1947) 缅甸独立之父，三十同志创始人，二战初期与日军合作后倒向英军，1947年庞隆协议实现少数民族联邦，同年遇刺，女儿昂山素季继承民主事业与军政府博弈三十年。
MM-IND-001.description_en: Aung San (1915-1947) Myanmar independence father, Thirty Comrades founder, initially cooperated with Japanese then switched to British, 1947 Panglong Agreement achieved ethnic federalism, assassinated same year, daughter Aung San Suu Kyi inherited democracy cause wrestling with military junta for thirty years.
MM-IND-001.reason_zh: 昂山代表缅甸独立与联邦建构的双重未竟事业，展示了少数民族联邦制如何在军人政治、意识形态分裂、外部干预中反复破裂，父女两代悲剧折射缅甸国家建构核心困境。
MM-IND-001.reason_en: Aung San represents Myanmar independence and federal construction dual unfinished business, demonstrating how ethnic federalism fractures repeatedly amid military politics, ideological division, external intervention, father-daughter dual tragedy reflecting Myanmar state-building core dilemma.
steps_zh: 研究昂山早年学生领袖与三十同志日本军官训练
分析1945年反法西斯人民自由同盟倒向英军
探讨1947年庞隆协议少数民族联邦构想与遇刺
评估昂山素季继承遗产与1988/2021军政府对抗
总结父女两代独立将军女儿民主军事张力的历史宿命
steps_en: Study Aung San early student leader and Thirty Comrades Japanese officer training
Analyze 1945 Anti-Fascist Peoples Freedom League switch to British
Explore 1947 Panglong Agreement ethnic federalism vision and assassination
Evaluate Aung San Suu Kyi inheritance and 1988/2021 military junta confrontation
Summarize father-daughter independence general daughter democracy military tension historical destiny
MM-IND-001.expected_zh: 理解缅甸少数民族联邦制为何在军人政治中反复破裂，掌握独立领袖遗产如何在女儿身上转化为民主符号与军政府攻击靶子，评估缅甸联邦民主化的根本障碍。
MM-IND-001.expected_en: Understand why Myanmar ethnic federalism repeatedly fractures under military politics, grasp how independence leader legacy transforms into democracy symbol and military junta target on daughter, evaluate Myanmar federal democratization fundamental obstacles.
MM-IND-001.case_zh: 1941 三十同志；1945 倒向英军；1947 庞隆协议/遇刺；1988 素季领导起义；2021 政变入狱。独立将军女儿民主军事范式永存。
MM-IND-001.case_en: 1941 Thirty Comrades; 1945 switched to British; 1947 Panglong/assassination; 1988 Suu Kyi led uprising; 2021 coup imprisoned. Independence general daughter democracy military paradigm endures.
MM-IND-001.cross_cultural_impact: Independence father; federalism vision; daughter democracy icon; military junta tension

MM-SOC-001.name_zh: 缅甸·吴努：佛教社会主义与民主政变僧侣
MM-SOC-001.name_en: Myanmar U Nu: Buddhist Socialism & Democracy Coup Monks
MM-SOC-001.description_zh: 吴努 (1907-1995) 缅甸首任总理 (1948-1958, 1960-1962)，推行佛教社会主义福利政策，1958年主动移权给内阁看守，1960年大选回归，1962年奈温政变下台，晚年流亡发动8888起义支持。
MM-SOC-001.description_en: U Nu (1907-1995) Myanmar first PM (1948-1958, 1960-1962), implemented Buddhist socialism welfare policy, 1958 voluntarily handed power to caretaker cabinet, 1960 election returned, 1962 Ne Win coup ousted, late exile supported 8888 uprising.
MM-SOC-001.reason_zh: 吴努代表佛教伦理与社会主义经济的独特融合尝试，展示了民主领袖如何在军人政治阴影下通过道德权威治国，其主动移权罕见展现民主成熟度，却终究无法阻挡军事政变。
MM-SOC-001.reason_en: U Nu represents unique fusion of Buddhist ethics and socialist economics, demonstrating how democratic leader governs through moral authority under military politics shadow, his voluntary handover rare showing democratic maturity yet ultimately unable to stop military coup.
steps_zh: 研究吴努早年学生领袖与反英斗争
分析1948-1958首相期佛教社会主义立法
探讨1958年主动移权看守内阁罕见民主操作
评估1962年奈温政变与吴努流亡晚年
总结佛教社会主义民主政变僧侣模式对缅甸政治文化的深远烙印
steps_en: Study U Nu early student leader and anti-British struggle
Analyze 1948-1958 PM Buddhist socialism legislation
Explore 1958 voluntary handover to caretaker cabinet rare democratic operation
Evaluate 1962 Ne Win coup and U Nu exile late years
Summarize Buddhist socialism democracy coup monks model profound imprint on Myanmar political culture
MM-SOC-001.expected_zh: 理解佛教伦理如何为社会主义提供道德正当性，掌握民主领袖道德权威与军事强权的不对称博弈，评估吴努模式对后世缅甸民主运动的启示与局限。
MM-SOC-001.expected_en: Understand how Buddhist ethics legitimize socialism morally, grasp democratic leader moral authority and military power asymmetric game, evaluate U Nu model implications for later Myanmar democracy movements.
MM-SOC-001.case_zh: 1948 总理；1958 移权；1960 回归；1962 政变下台；1988 支持起义。佛教社会主义民主政变僧侣范式永存。
MM-SOC-001.case_en: 1948 PM; 1958 handover; 1960 return; 1962 coup ousted; 1988 supported uprising. Buddhist socialism democracy coup monks paradigm endures.
MM-SOC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Buddhist socialism; voluntary power transfer; military coup; monk politics

MM-MIL-001.name_zh: 缅甸·奈温：军事隔离与佛教迷信经济自毁
MM-MIL-001.name_en: Myanmar Ne Win: Military Isolation & Buddhist Superstition Economy Self-Destruction
MM-MIL-001.description_zh: 奈温 (1911-2002) 缅甸军事独裁者 (1962-1988)，建立缅甸式社会主义孤立经济，1987年废除货币依迷信数字(9的倍数)，引发8888起义，晚年居家监禁，军事隔离与经济自毁导致缅甸从东南亚富庶沦为最不发达。
MM-MIL-001.description_en: Ne Win (1911-2002) Myanmar military dictator (1962-1988), built Burmese Way to Socialism isolated economy, 1987 demonetized currency based on superstition number (multiples of 9), triggered 8888 uprising, late house arrest, military isolation and economic self-destruction reduced Myanmar from Southeast Asia prosperity to LDC.
MM-MIL-001.reason_zh: 奈温代表军事独裁与经济愚昧的毁灭性结合，展示了迷信决策如何摧毁国家经济基础，其"缅甸式社会主义"成为发展经济学反面教材，军事隔离导致国家彻底边缘化。
MM-MIL-001.reason_en: Ne Win represents destructive fusion of military dictatorship and economic folly, demonstrating how superstitious decision-making destroys national economic foundation, his Burmese Way to Socialism became development economics cautionary tale, military isolation led to complete national marginalization.
steps_zh: 研究奈温早年三十同志与昂山副手关系
分析1962年政变建立革命委员会与缅甸式社会主义
探讨1964年国有化与1987年迷信废币灾难
评估8888起义与1988年辞职权力交接给素貌
总结军事隔离佛教迷信经济自毁对缅甸发展的世纪创伤
steps_en: Study Ne Win early Thirty Comrades and Aung San deputy relationship
Analyze 1962 coup established Revolutionary Council and Burmese Way to Socialism
Explore 1964 nationalization and 1987 superstitious demonetization disaster
Evaluate 8888 uprising and 1988 resignation power transfer to Saw Maung
Summarize military isolation Buddhist superstition economy self-destruction century trauma for Myanmar development
MM-MIL-001.expected_zh: 理解军事强权如何通过意识形态合法化经济愚昧，掌握迷信决策在封闭体制中放大破坏力的机制，评估奈温遗产对缅甸当代经济重建的深度阻碍。
MM-MIL-001.expected_en: Understand how military power legitimizes economic folly through ideology, grasp superstition decision-making amplification mechanism in closed system, evaluate Ne Win legacy deep hindrance for Myanmar contemporary economic reconstruction.
MM-MIL-001.case_zh: 1962 政变；1964 国有化；1987 迷信废币；1988 8888起义辞职；2002 逝世。军事隔离佛教迷信经济自毁范式永存。
MM-MIL-001.case_en: 1962 coup; 1964 nationalization; 1987 superstitious demonetization; 1988 8888 uprising resignation; 2002 death. Military isolation Buddhist superstition economy self-destruction paradigm endures.
MM-MIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Military isolation; economic self-destruction; superstition policy; LDC decline

MM-ETH-001.name_zh: 缅甸·罗兴亚族群：种族清洗与无国籍海上幸存
MM-ETH-001.name_en: Myanmar Rohingya: Ethnic Cleansing & Stateless Sea Survival
MM-ETH-001.description_zh: 罗兴亚是缅甸若开邦穆斯林少数民族，1982年公民法剥夺国籍，2012/2016/2017年军方发动清洗行动，百万人逃往孟加拉难民营或漂流安达曼海，成为当代最严重无国籍群体危机。
MM-ETH-001.description_en: Rohingya are Myanmar Rakhine Muslim minority, 1982 Citizenship Law stripped nationality, 2012/2016/2017 military cleansing operations, millions fled to Bangladesh camps or drifted Andaman Sea, becoming contemporary most severe stateless population crisis.
MM-ETH-001.reason_zh: 罗兴亚代表当代种族清洗与无国籍危机的极端案例，展示了公民法如何被武器化剥夺少数民族生存权，海上漂流求生画面震撼世界良知，国际法保护机制却反应迟缓无效。
MM-ETH-001.reason_en: Rohingya represents contemporary ethnic cleansing and stateless crisis extreme case, demonstrating how citizenship law weaponized to deprive minority survival rights, sea drifting survival images shocked world conscience, international law protection mechanisms responded slowly and ineffectively.
steps_zh: 研究罗兴亚历史渊源与若开邦地理隔离
分析1982公民法剥夺国籍法律机制
探讨2017年清洗行动与安达曼海漂流危机
评估国际法院/ICC诉讼与孟加拉难民营现状
总结种族清洗无国籍海上幸存对国际保护责任的挑战
steps_en: Study Rohingya historical roots and Rakhine geographic isolation
Analyze 1982 Citizenship Law stripping nationality legal mechanism
Explore 2017 cleansing operations and Andaman Sea drifting crisis
Evaluate ICJ/ICC litigation and Bangladesh refugee camp status
Summarize ethnic cleansing stateless sea survival challenge to international protection responsibility
MM-ETH-001.expected_zh: 理解公民法如何成为种族清洗法律工具，掌握无国籍群体海上求生与国际保护责任的现实鸿沟，评估罗兴亚危机对缅甸民主化与国际法的双重考验。
MM-ETH-001.expected_en: Understand how citizenship law becomes ethnic cleansing legal tool, grasp stateless population sea survival and international protection responsibility reality gap, evaluate Rohingya crisis dual test for Myanmar democratization and international law.
MM-ETH-001.case_zh: 1982 公民法剥夺国籍；2017 清洗70万逃亡；安达曼海漂流；海牙法院诉讼。种族清洗无国籍海上幸存范式永存。
MM-ETH-001.case_en: 1982 Citizenship Law stripped nationality; 2017 cleansing 700K fled; Andaman Sea drifting; ICJ litigation. Ethnic cleansing stateless sea survival paradigm endures.
MM-ETH-001.cross_cultural_impact: Citizenship law weaponization; stateless crisis; sea survival; international law failure

VN-TRA-001.name_zh: 越南·陈兴道：抗蒙军事与游击水战天才
VN-TRA-001.name_en: Vietnam Tran Hung Dao: Anti-Mongol Military & Guerrilla Naval Genius
VN-TRA-001.description_zh: 陈兴道 (1228-1300) 陈朝大将，三次抗元战争白藤江决战以桩阵水战歼灭蒙古舰队，著《兵书要诀》奠定越南军事思想传统。
VN-TRA-001.description_en: Tran Hung Dao (1228-1300) Tran Dynasty general, three anti-Yuan wars Bach Dang River decisive battle used stake trap naval warfare annihilated Mongol fleet, authored Book of Military Principles founding Vietnamese military thought tradition.
VN-TRA-001.reason_zh: 陈兴道代表农业文明通过水战非对称优势击败游牧帝国军事机器的奇迹，展示了地理环境如何转化为军事战略决定性优势，其兵法思想影响越南千年抗外传统。
VN-TRA-001.reason_en: Tran Hung Dao represents agricultural civilization defeating nomadic empire military machine through naval asymmetric advantage miracle, demonstrating how geography transforms into decisive military strategic advantage, his military thought influencing Vietnamese millennium anti-foreign tradition.
steps_zh: 研究陈兴道早年儒将教育与陈朝军事改革
分析1258/1285/1288三次抗元战争战术演进
探讨1288白藤江桩阵水战战术创新与心理战
评估《兵书要诀》游击战思想与越南军事传统
总结抗蒙军事天才对越南民族认同的奠基作用
steps_en: Study Tran Hung Dao early Confucian general education and Tran Dynasty military reform
Analyze 1258/1285/1288 three anti-Yuan wars tactical evolution
Explore 1288 Bach Dang stake trap naval warfare tactical innovation and psychological warfare
Evaluate Book of Military Principles guerrilla thought and Vietnamese military tradition
Summarize anti-Mongol military genius foundational role for Vietnamese national identity
VN-TRA-001.expected_zh: 掌握水战非对称战术与游击战思想双重创新，理解地理决定论在军事史上的极致体现，评估陈兴道对越南千年抗外传统的决定性奠基。
VN-TRA-001.expected_en: Master naval asymmetric tactics and guerrilla thought dual innovation, understand geographical determinism ultimate embodiment in military history, evaluate Tran Hung Dao decisive foundation for Vietnamese millennium anti-foreign tradition.
VN-TRA-001.case_zh: 1228 出生；1258 首战；1288 白藤江大捷；1300 逝世。抗蒙军事游击水战范式永存。
VN-TRA-001.case_en: 1228 birth; 1258 first battle; 1288 Bach Dang victory; 1300 death. Anti-Mongol military guerrilla naval paradigm endures.
VN-TRA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Naval warfare innovation; stake trap; anti-Mongol victory; military tradition

LA-RED-001.name_zh: 老挝·苏发努冯：红王子中立与三王子联合
LA-RED-001.name_en: Laos Souphanouvong: Red Prince Neutrality & Three Princes Unity
LA-RED-001.description_zh: 苏发努冯 (1909-1995) 老挝红王子，巴特寮领袖，1957/1962/1973三次联合政府，坚持中立外交在美苏中三大阵营夹缝生存，1975年胜利任主席推动民族和解。
LA-RED-001.description_en: Souphanouvong (1909-1995) Laos Red Prince, Pathet Lao leader, 1957/1962/1973 three coalition governments, insisted neutral diplomacy surviving in US-Soviet-China three camps squeeze, 1975 victory became President promoted national reconciliation.
LA-RED-001.reason_zh: 苏发努冯代表冷战夹缝小国通过中立外交与王室身份实现共产主义革命与民族和解的双重奇迹，展示了红色王子如何转化阶级矛盾为民族团结。
LA-RED-001.reason_en: Souphanouvong represents Cold War squeeze small state achieving communist revolution and national reconciliation dual miracle through neutral diplomacy and royal identity, demonstrating how Red Prince transformed class contradiction into national unity.
steps_zh: 研究苏发努冯王子身份与越南革命洗礼
分析1950年巴特寮成立与武装斗争
探讨三次联合政府(1957/1962/1973)权力分享机制
评估1975年胜利主席任内民族和解与经济建设
总结红王子中立三王子联合对老挝生存智慧的贡献
steps_en: Study Souphanouvong prince identity and Vietnam revolutionary baptism
Analyze 1950 Pathet Lao founding and armed struggle
Explore three coalition governments (1957/1962/1973) power sharing mechanism
Evaluate 1975 victory President term national reconciliation and economic construction
Summarize Red Prince neutrality three princes unity contribution to Laos survival wisdom
LA-RED-001.expected_zh: 理解王室身份如何为共产革命提供合法性保护，掌握中立外交在大国夹缝中生存空间拓展逻辑，评估三王子联合模式对分裂社会愈合的普遍启示。
LA-RED-001.expected_en: Understand how royal identity provides legitimacy protection for communist revolution, grasp neutral diplomacy survival space expansion logic in great power squeeze, evaluate three princes unity model universal lessons for divided society healing.
LA-RED-001.case_zh: 1909 王子出生；1950 巴特寮；1957/62/73 联合；1975 胜利主席。红王子中立三王子联合范式永存。
LA-RED-001.case_en: 1909 prince birth; 1950 Pathet Lao; 1957/62/73 coalitions; 1975 victory President. Red Prince neutrality three princes unity paradigm endures.
LA-RED-001.cross_cultural_impact: Royal communist leader; neutral diplomacy; coalition government; national reconciliation

LA-LAN-001.name_zh: 老挝·法昂：澜沧王国与万象佛教统一
LA-LAN-001.name_en: Laos Fa Ngum: Lan Xang Kingdom & Vientiane Buddhist Unity
LA-LAN-001.description_zh: 法昂 (1316-1393) 澜沧万象王国建立者，娶高棉公主请佛祖舍利入万象，确立上座部佛教国教，整合老挝泰族诸邦，奠定老挝民族疆域与文化认同基础。
LA-LAN-001.description_en: Fa Ngum (1316-1393) Lan Xang Vientiane Kingdom founder, married Khmer princess brought Buddha relics to Vientiane, established Theravada Buddhism state religion, integrated Lao Tai principalities, founded Lao national territory and cultural identity basis.
LA-LAN-001.reason_zh: 法昂代表东南亚佛教王国建构典范，展示了佛教如何作为跨部落文化粘合剂整合分散政体，其澜沧王国疆域大致对应现代老挝版图。
LA-LAN-001.reason_en: Fa Ngum represents Southeast Asian Buddhist kingdom construction paradigm, demonstrating how Buddhism serves as cross-tribal cultural glue integrating fragmented polities, his Lan Xang Kingdom territory roughly corresponds to modern Laos map.
steps_zh: 研究法昂早年高棉宫廷成长与娶公主请舍利
分析1353年万象起兵建立澜沧万象王国
探讨上座部佛教国教确立与僧团制度建设
评估澜沧疆域扩张整合老挝泰族诸邦
总结法昂佛教统一对老挝民族疆域认同的千年奠基
steps_en: Study Fa Ngum early Khmer court upbringing and marrying princess bringing relics
Analyze 1353 Vientiane uprising establishing Lan Xang Vientiane Kingdom
Explore Theravada Buddhism state religion establishment and sangha system construction
Evaluate Lan Xang territory expansion integrating Lao Tai principalities

NG-FED-001.name_zh: 尼日利亚·奥巴费米·阿沃洛沃：联邦约鲁巴与免费教育区域自治
NG-FED-001.name_en: Nigeria Obafemi Awolowo: Federal Yoruba Free Education Regional Autonomy
NG-FED-001.description_zh: 奥巴费米·阿沃洛沃 (1909-1987) 尼日利亚西部地区总理 (1954-1960)，推行全非洲首个免费初等教育，建立约鲁巴联邦区域自治模式，联邦主义思想奠定尼日利亚第一共和国宪法基础。
NG-FED-001.description_en: Obafemi Awolowo (1909-1987) Nigeria Western Region Premier (1954-1960), implemented Africas first free primary education, built Yoruba federal regional autonomy model, federalist thought laid Nigeria First Republic constitutional foundation.
NG-FED-001.reason_zh: 阿沃洛沃代表非洲联邦主义先驱如何通过教育普及与区域自治构建民族整合，展示了约鲁巴精英如何在多民族国家中平衡联邦权力与区域发展，其免费教育政策至今惠及千万尼日利亚人。
NG-FED-001.reason_en: Awolowo represents African federalism pioneer achieving national integration through education universalization and regional autonomy, demonstrating how Yoruba elites balanced federal power and regional development in multi-ethnic nation, his free education policy still benefits millions of Nigerians today.
steps_zh: 研究阿沃洛沃早年律师与尼日利亚青年运动领袖
分析1955年西部地区免费初等教育政策实施
探讨约鲁巴联邦主义与伊博豪萨三大族群博弈
评估1963年联邦制宪法与第一共和国总理竞选
总结联邦约鲁巴免费教育区域自治对尼日利亚民主化的奠基贡献
steps_en: Study Awolowo early lawyer and Nigerian Youth Movement leader
Analyze 1955 Western Region free primary education policy implementation
Explore Yoruba federalism and Igbo-Hausa three major groups game
Evaluate 1963 federal constitution and First Republic PM candidacy
Summarize federal Yoruba free education regional autonomy foundational contribution to Nigerian democratization
NG-FED-001.expected_zh: 掌握联邦主义与免费教育双轮驱动民族整合逻辑，理解区域自治如何在多民族国家中平衡中心与地方，评估阿沃洛沃对尼日利亚民主宪政传统的决定性奠基。
NG-FED-001.expected_en: Master federalism and free education dual-wheel driving national integration logic, understand how regional autonomy balances center and periphery in multi-ethnic nation, evaluate Awolowo decisive foundation for Nigerian democratic constitutional tradition.

NG-FED-001.case_en: 1955 free education; 1960 PM candidate; 1987 death. Federal Yoruba free education regional autonomy paradigm endures.
NG-FED-001.cross_cultural_impact: Free education; federalism; regional autonomy; Yoruba identity

NG-PAN-001.name_zh: 尼日利亚·恩纳姆迪·阿齐基韦：泛非首任总统与伊博报纸民族建构
NG-PAN-001.name_en: Nigeria Nnamdi Azikiwe: Pan-African First President & Igbo Newspaper Nation-Building
NG-PAN-001.description_zh: 恩纳姆迪·阿齐基韦 (1904-1996) 尼日利亚首任总统 (1963-1966)，创办《西非朝报》唤醒民族意识，泛非主义推动加纳独立与非洲统一组织成立，伊博精英跨族群民族建构。
NG-PAN-001.description_en: Nnamdi Azikiwe (1904-1996) Nigeria first President (1963-1966), founded West African Pilot awakening national consciousness, Pan-Africanism drove Ghana independence and OAU founding, Igbo elite cross-ethnic nation-building.
NG-PAN-001.reason_zh: 阿齐基韦代表西非泛非主义如何通过报纸媒体与跨族群精英联盟构建民族国家，展示了伊博商业精神如何转化为政治领导力，其首任总统地位象征尼日利亚从殖民地到主权国家的完成。
NG-PAN-001.reason_en: Azikiwe represents how West African Pan-Africanism built nation-state through newspaper media and cross-ethnic elite alliance, demonstrating how Igbo commercial spirit transformed into political leadership, his first presidency symbolizing Nigeria transition from colony to sovereign state completion.
steps_zh: 研究阿齐基韦早年美国林肯大学教育与报纸创办
分析《西非朝报》民族主义唤醒与泛非网络构建
探讨1960年独立与1963年共和国首任总统就职
评估1966年政变下台与比夫拉战争调解努力
总结泛非首任总统伊博报纸民族建构对尼日利亚国家认同的奠基
steps_en: Study Azikiwe early US Lincoln University education and newspaper founding
Analyze West African Pilot nationalist awakening and Pan-African network construction
Explore 1960 independence and 1963 Republic first President inauguration
Evaluate 1966 coup ousting and Biafra war mediation efforts
Summarize Pan-African first President Igbo newspaper nation-building foundational role for Nigerian national identity
NG-PAN-001.expected_zh: 理解报纸媒体如何成为民族想象共同体构建核心工具，掌握泛非主义与区域精英联盟双重民族建构路径，评估阿齐基韦对西非去殖民化进程的决定性领导。
NG-PAN-001.expected_en: Understand how newspaper media becomes national imagined community construction core tool, grasp Pan-Africanism and regional elite alliance dual nation-building path, evaluate Azikiwe decisive leadership for West African decolonization process.
NG-PAN-001.case_zh: 1937 创办朝报；1960 独立；1963 首任总统；1996 逝世。泛非首任总统伊博报纸民族范式永存。
NG-PAN-001.case_en: 1937 founded Pilot; 1960 independence; 1963 first President; 1996 death. Pan-African first President Igbo newspaper nation paradigm endures.
NG-PAN-001.cross_cultural_impact: Pan-Africanism; newspaper nationalism; first President; Igbo leadership

KE-MAU-001.name_zh: 肯尼亚·乔莫·肯雅塔：独立马乌马乌与土地部落族长
KE-MAU-001.name_en: Kenya Jomo Kenyatta: Independence Mau Mau & Land Tribe Patriarch
KE-MAU-001.description_zh: 乔莫·肯雅塔 (1897-1978) 肯尼亚首任总统 (1964-1978)，马乌马乌起义领袖，兰吉监狱七年磨砺，独立后推行非洲化与土地再分配，部落族长治国平衡基库尤与卡伦金族群。
KE-MAU-001.description_en: Jomo Kenyatta (1897-1978) Kenya first President (1964-1978), Mau Mau uprising leader, Langi prison seven years tempering, post-independence Africanization and land redistribution, tribal patriarch governance balancing Kikuyu and Kalenjin groups.
KE-MAU-001.reason_zh: 肯雅塔代表反殖武装斗争领袖如何转型为建国总统，展示了土地再分配如何成为后殖民国家合法性核心，其部落族长统治模式深刻塑造肯尼亚族群政治至今。
KE-MAU-001.reason_en: Kenyatta represents how anti-colonial armed leader transforms into founding President, demonstrating how land redistribution becomes post-colonial state legitimacy core, his tribal patriarch governance model profoundly shapes Kenyan ethnic politics to this day.
steps_zh: 研究肯雅塔早年传教学校教育与伦敦经济学院留学
分析1952马乌马乌起义与兰吉监狱七年著作《面向肯尼亚山》
探讨1963年独立与非洲化土地再分配政策
评估基库尤精英垄断与卡伦金族群边缘化张力
总结独立马乌马乌土地部落族长对肯尼亚族群政治的决定性塑造

Analyze 1952 Mau Mau uprising and Langi prison seven years writing Facing Mount Kenya
Explore 1963 independence and Africanization land redistribution policy
Evaluate Kikuyu elite monopoly and Kalenjin marginalization tension
Summarize independence Mau Mau land tribal patriarch decisive shaping of Kenyan ethnic politics
KE-MAU-001.expected_zh: 掌握武装斗争领袖向建国总统转型的合法性转化路径，理解土地再分配作为后殖民合法性核心的运作机制，评估肯雅塔族长模式对东非族群政治的长期遗产。
KE-MAU-001.expected_en: Master armed leader to founding President legitimacy transformation path, understand land redistribution as post-colonial legitimacy core operating mechanism, evaluate Kenyatta patriarch model long-term legacy for East African ethnic politics.
KE-MAU-001.case_zh: 1952 马乌马乌；1963 独立；1964 总理；1978 逝世。独立马乌马乌土地部落族长范式永存。

KE-MAU-001.cross_cultural_impact: Independence leader; land redistribution; tribal politics; East African model

ZW-LAN-001.name_zh: 津巴布韦·罗伯特·穆加贝：土地改革独裁与恶性通胀钻石遗产
ZW-LAN-001.name_en: Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe: Land Reform Dictatorship & Hyperinflation Diamonds Legacy
ZW-LAN-001.description_zh: 罗伯特·穆加贝 (1924-2019) 津巴布韦总统 (1980-2017)，早年解放英雄晚年独裁者，2000年快速土地改革驱逐白人农场主，恶性通胀摧毁经济，马拉维钻石争夺，2017年政变下台。
ZW-LAN-001.description_en: Robert Mugabe (1924-2019) Zimbabwe President (1980-2017), early liberation hero late dictator, 2000 fast-track land reform expelled white farmers, hyperinflation destroyed economy, Marange diamonds争夺, 2017 coup ousted.
ZW-LAN-001.reason_zh: 穆加贝代表解放英雄如何异化为独裁者，展示了土地改革如何从正义诉求演变为掠夺性掠夺，恶性通胀与钻石资源诅咒双重摧毁了非洲曾经的面包篮子。
ZW-LAN-001.reason_en: Mugabe represents how liberation hero mutates into dictator, demonstrating how land reform evolved from justice demand into predatory plunder, hyperinflation and diamond resource curse dual destruction of Africas former breadbasket.

分析1980年独立与兰开斯特宫协议土地条款
探讨2000年快速土地改革与白人农场主驱逐
评估2008年恶性通胀与马拉维钻石军方掠夺
总结土地改革独裁恶性通胀钻石遗产对津巴布韦发展的毁灭性打击
steps_en: Study Mugabe early teacher and guerrilla war leader
Analyze 1980 independence and Lancaster House land clauses
Explore 2000 fast-track land reform and white farmer expulsion
Evaluate 2008 hyperinflation and Marange diamonds military plunder
Summarize land reform dictatorship hyperinflation diamonds legacy devastating blow to Zimbabwe development
ZW-LAN-001.expected_zh: 理解解放遗产如何被独权力异化掠夺工具，掌握土地改革从正义到掠夺的异化机制，评估穆加贝遗产对南部非洲民主化与资源治理的警示。
ZW-LAN-001.expected_en: Understand how liberation legacy mutates into dictatorial plunder tool, grasp land reform evolution from justice to plunder mechanism, evaluate Mugabe legacy warning for Southern African democratization and resource governance.
ZW-LAN-001.case_zh: 1980 独立；2000 土地改革；2008 恶性通胀；2017 政变。土地改革独裁恶性通胀钻石范式永存。
ZW-LAN-001.case_en: 1980 independence; 2000 land reform; 2008 hyperinflation; 2017 coup. Land reform dictatorship hyperinflation diamonds paradigm endures.

ZA-TRC-001.name_zh: 南非·德斯蒙德·图图：真相和解与彩虹国家道德权威
ZA-TRC-001.name_en: South Africa Desmond Tutu: Truth Reconciliation & Rainbow Nation Moral Authority
ZA-TRC-001.description_zh: 德斯蒙德·图图 (1931-2021) 南非圣公会大主教，诺贝尔和平奖得主，真相与和解委员会主席，以基督教宽恕伦理愈合种族创伤，推动彩虹国家建构，反对科尔宾反犹太主义。
ZA-TRC-001.description_en: Desmond Tutu (1931-2021) South African Anglican Archbishop, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, Truth and Reconciliation Commission chair, Christian forgiveness ethics healed racial wounds, promoted Rainbow Nation construction, opposed Corbyn antisemitism.
ZA-TRC-001.reason_zh: 图图代表宗教道德权威如何在政治转型中提供愈合机制，展示了真相委员会如何通过宽恕而非报复实现社会和解，其彩虹国家愿景成为后冲突社会伦理标杆。
ZA-TRC-001.reason_en: Tutu represents how religious moral authority provides healing mechanism in political transition, demonstrating how truth commission achieves social reconciliation through forgiveness not retribution, his Rainbow Nation vision becoming post-conflict society ethical benchmark.
steps_zh: 研究图图早年教师与神学教育反种族隔离觉醒
分析1984年诺贝尔和平奖与国际反种隔声援
探讨1995年真相与和解委员会主席宽恕听证
评估彩虹国家愿景与后曼德拉时代腐败批判
总结真相和解诺贝尔神职彩虹道德对全球转型正义的范式贡献

Analyze 1984 Nobel Peace Prize and international anti-apartheid solidarity
Explore 1995 Truth Reconciliation Commission chair forgiveness hearings
Evaluate Rainbow Nation vision and post-Mandela era corruption critique
Summarize truth reconciliation Nobel clergy rainbow morality paradigm contribution for global transitional justice
ZA-TRC-001.expected_zh: 掌握宗教宽恕伦理如何转化为政治和解制度设计，理解真相委员会听证机制如何平衡正义与愈合，评估图图模式对卢旺达塞拉利昂等真相委员会的直接启示。
ZA-TRC-001.expected_en: Master how religious forgiveness ethics transforms into political reconciliation institutional design, grasp truth commission hearing mechanism balancing justice and healing, evaluate Tutu model direct lessons for Rwanda Sierra Leone truth commissions.
ZA-TRC-001.case_zh: 1984 诺贝尔；1995 真相委员会；彩虹国家；2021 逝世。真相和解诺贝尔神职彩虹道德范式永存。
ZA-TRC-001.case_en: 1984 Nobel; 1995 TRC; Rainbow Nation; 2021 death. Truth reconciliation Nobel clergy rainbow morality paradigm endures.

GH-PAN-001.name_zh: 加纳·夸梅·恩克鲁玛：泛非非洲统一与政变流亡
GH-PAN-001.name_en: Ghana Kwame Nkrumah: Pan-African African Unity & Coup Exile
GH-PAN-001.description_zh: 夸梅·恩克鲁玛 (1909-1972) 加纳首任总理/总统 (1957-1966)，撒哈拉以南非洲首个独立国家领袖，泛非主义推动非洲统一组织成立，沃尔特河大坝工业化，1966年政变流亡几内亚。
GH-PAN-001.description_en: Kwame Nkrumah (1909-1972) Ghana first PM/President (1957-1966), Sub-Saharan Africa first independent nation leader, Pan-Africanism drove OAU founding, Volta Dam industrialization, 1966 coup exiled Guinea.
GH-PAN-001.reason_zh: 恩克鲁玛代表非洲独立浪潮的总领袖，展示了泛非主义如何从解放工具转化为国家建构意识形态，其政变流亡折射非洲早期国家建构的脆弱性，工业化遗产与泛非梦想并存。
GH-PAN-001.reason_en: Nkrumah represents African independence wave paramount leader, demonstrating how Pan-Africanism transformed from liberation tool into nation-building ideology, his coup exile reflecting African early state-building fragility, industrialization legacy and Pan-African dream coexist.
steps_zh: 研究恩克鲁玛早年林肯大学神学与宾大教育
分析1957年加纳独立与泛非主义非洲统一声言
探讨沃尔特河阿科松博大坝工业化愿景
评估1966年政变流亡几内亚与晚年著作
总结泛非非洲统一政变流亡对非洲一体化的奠基与悲剧

Analyze 1957 Ghana independence and Pan-Africanism African unity voice
Explore Volta River Akosombo Dam industrialization vision

Summarize Pan-African African unity coup exile foundational and tragic for African integration

GH-PAN-001.expected_en: Understand how Pan-Africanism elevated from independence movement to continental integration program, grasp industrialization and political unity dual-wheel driving African modernization logic, evaluate Nkrumah legacy historical roots for AU and AfCFTA.
GH-PAN-001.case_zh: 1957 独立；1963 非盟；1966 政变；1972 逝世。泛非非洲统一政变流亡范式永存。
GH-PAN-001.case_en: 1957 independence; 1963 OAU; 1966 coup; 1972 death. Pan-African African unity coup exile paradigm endures.
GH-PAN-001.cross_cultural_impact: Pan-Africanism; African unity; industrialization; coup exile

SN-NEG-001.name_zh: 塞内加尔·利奥波德·桑戈尔：黑人精神与诗人总统法语文化
SN-NEG-001.name_en: Senegal Leopold Senghor: Negritude & Poet President French Culture
SN-NEG-001.description_zh: 利奥波德·桑戈尔 (1906-2001) 塞内加尔首任总统 (1960-1980)，黑人精神运动创始人，诗人总统以法语文学连接非洲与欧洲，和平退位树立民主榜样，文化外交桥梁。
SN-NEG-001.description_en: Leopold Sedar Senghor (1906-2001) Senegal first President (1960-1980), Negritude movement founder, poet President bridging Africa and Europe through French literature, peaceful retirement democratic model, cultural diplomacy bridge.
SN-NEG-001.reason_zh: 桑戈尔代表非洲知识分子如何通过文学与政治双重身份构建文化自信，展示了黑人精神如何将殖民语言转化为文化抵抗武器，其和平退位与法兰西院士身份双重巅峰独树一帜。
SN-NEG-001.reason_en: Senghor represents how African intellectual builds cultural confidence through dual literary-political identity, demonstrating how Negritude transforms colonial language into cultural resistance weapon, his peaceful retirement and Academie Francaise membership dual peaks unique.

分析1960年独立总统与黑人精神文化政策

SN-NEG-001.expected_en: Master how literature becomes national cultural confidence construction core tool, grasp how colonial language transforms into cultural sovereignty expression medium, evaluate Senghor model dual demonstration for Francophone African cultural diplomacy and democratic transmission.

CI-MIR-001.name_zh: 科特迪瓦·费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼：稳定可可与法国和平大教堂奇迹
CI-MIR-001.name_en: Ivory Coast Felix Houphouet-Boigny: Stability Cocoa & France Peace Cathedral Miracle
CI-MIR-001.description_zh: 费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼 (1905-1993) 科特迪瓦首任总统 (1960-1993)，可可出口经济奇迹，与法国维持特殊关系，亚穆苏克罗和平大教堂世界最大教堂，三十年稳定后继任者内战。
CI-MIR-001.description_en: Felix Houphouet-Boigny (1905-1993) Ivory Coast first President (1960-1993), cocoa export economic miracle, special France relationship, Yamoussoukro Basilica worlds largest church, thirty years stability successors civil war.

CO-DEM-001.name_zh: 哥伦比亚·阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦：民主安全与反游击阿尔瓦罗模式
CO-DEM-001.name_en: Colombia Alvaro Uribe: Democratic Security & Anti-Guerrilla Alvaro Model
CO-DEM-001.description_zh: 阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦 (1952-) 哥伦比亚总统 (2002-2010)，民主安全政策军事打击哥伦比亚革命武装力量(FARC)，巴拉圭外交斡旋释放人质，连任修宪争议，安全成果与人权代价并存。
CO-DEM-001.description_en: Alvaro Uribe (1952-) Colombia President (2002-2010), democratic security policy militarily struck FARC, Paraguay diplomacy mediated hostage release, re-election constitutional controversy, security gains and human rights costs coexisted.
CO-DEM-001.reason_zh: 乌里韦代表哥伦比亚如何通过军事强力与外交斡旋双重手段压制半个世纪游击战争，展示了民主安全政策如何在人权批评中获得国内民众压倒性支持，其阿尔瓦罗模式影响拉美安全议程。
CO-DEM-001.reason_en: Uribe represents how Colombia suppressed half-century guerrilla war through military force and diplomatic mediation dual approach, demonstrating how democratic security policy gained overwhelming domestic support despite human rights criticism, his Alvaro model influencing Latin American security agenda.
steps_zh: 研究乌里韦早年安蒂奥基亚州长与反绑架专家经历
分析2002年民主安全政策军事化与准军事合作
探讨2008年巴拉圭外交斡旋英格丽德·贝唐古尔释放
评估2006连任修宪与2010年宪法法院否决第三任
总结民主安全反游击阿尔瓦罗模式对拉美反叛乱战略的影响
steps_en: Study Uribe early Antioquia Governor and anti-kidnapping expert experience
Analyze 2002 democratic security policy militarization and paramilitary cooperation
Explore 2008 Paraguay diplomacy mediation Ingrid Betancourt release
Evaluate 2006 re-election constitutional amendment and 2010 Court rejection third term
Summarize democratic security anti-guerrilla Alvaro model impact on Latin American counterinsurgency strategy
CO-DEM-001.expected_zh: 掌握军事强力与外交斡旋如何双轮驱动反游击战争，理解安全成果与人权代价的民主权衡困境，评估乌里韦模式对墨西哥中美洲等国安全政策的外溢影响。

EC-CIT-001.name_zh: 厄瓜多尔·拉斐尔·科雷亚：公民革命与美元化中国阿桑奇庇护
EC-CIT-001.name_en: Ecuador Rafael Correa: Citizen Revolution & Dollarization China Assange Asylum
EC-CIT-001.description_zh: 拉斐尔·科雷亚 (1963-) 厄瓜多尔总统 (2007-2017)，公民革命重写宪法确立良好生活原则，美元化经济稳定依赖中国贷款，庇护阿桑奇对抗美帝国主义，2017年交权莫雷诺反水。
EC-CIT-001.description_en: Rafael Correa (1963-) Ecuador President (2007-2017), citizen revolution rewrote constitution establishing Buen Vivir principles, dollarized economy stability dependent on Chinese loans, sheltered Assange against US imperialism, 2017 handover Moreno betrayed.
EC-CIT-001.reason_zh: 科雷亚代表拉美左翼如何通过宪法重写与美元化稳定实现社会再分配，展示了中国替代性融资如何打破IMF垄断，阿桑奇庇护成为反美帝国主义符号，其交权后被前盟友背叛折射左翼传承脆弱性。
EC-CIT-001.reason_en: Correa represents how Latin American left achieves social redistribution through constitutional rewrite and dollarization stability, demonstrating how Chinese alternative financing breaks IMF monopoly, Assange asylum becoming anti-US imperialism symbol, his handover betrayed by former ally reflecting leftist succession fragility.
steps_zh: 研究科雷亚早年比利时鲁汶大学经济学博士与反新自由主义
分析2008年制宪会议良好生活原则与自然权利
探讨美元化经济与中国贷款基建/石油换贷模式
评估2012年阿桑奇庇护伦敦使馆与美厄关系恶化
总结公民革命美元化中国阿桑奇庇护对拉美左翼的三重遗产
steps_en: Study Correa early Belgium KU Leuven economics PhD and anti-neoliberalism
Analyze 2008 Constituent Assembly Buen Vivir principles and nature rights
Explore dollarized economy and Chinese loans infrastructure/oil-for-loans model
Evaluate 2012 Assange asylum London embassy and US-Ecuador relations deterioration
Summarize citizen revolution dollarization China Assange asylum triple legacy for Latin American left
EC-CIT-001.expected_zh: 理解宪法重写如何将土著良好生活理念制度化，掌握美元化与中国融资双重经济锚点的风险与收益，评估科雷亚遗产对拉美粉红浪潮退潮期的历史定位。
EC-CIT-001.expected_en: Understand how constitutional rewrite institutionalized indigenous Buen Vivir philosophy, grasp dollarization and Chinese financing dual economic anchors risks and rewards, evaluate Correa legacy historical positioning for Latin American pink tide ebb period.
EC-CIT-001.case_zh: 2007 总统；2008 宪法；2012 阿桑奇庇护；2017 交权。公民革命美元化中国阿桑奇范式永存。

PY-DIC-001.name_zh: 巴拉圭·弗朗西斯科·洛佩斯：独裁三国战争与女性教育铁路悲剧
PY-DIC-001.name_en: Paraguay Francisco Lopez: Dictatorship Triple Alliance War & Women Education Railway Tragedy
PY-DIC-001.description_zh: 弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯 (1827-1870) 巴拉圭独裁者 (1862-1870)，发动三国同盟战争(巴拉圭vs阿根廷巴西乌拉圭)，全国总动员女性教育铁路建设，人口从130万锐减至20万，战死沙袋堡。
PY-DIC-001.description_en: Francisco Solano Lopez (1827-1870) Paraguay dictator (1862-1870), launched Triple Alliance War (Paraguay vs Argentina Brazil Uruguay), national mobilization women education railway construction, population plummeted from 1.3M to 200K, died at Cerro Cora.
PY-DIC-001.reason_zh: 洛佩斯代表拉美独裁者如何通过全民总动员发动毁灭性战争，展示了女性教育与铁路建设如何在战争机器中被异化为工具，其悲剧结局成为拉美军事冒险主义的永恒警示。
PY-DIC-001.reason_en: Lopez represents how Latin American dictator launches destructive war through total mobilization, demonstrating how women education and railway construction become instrumentalized in war machine, his tragic ending becoming eternal warning for Latin American military adventurism.
steps_zh: 研究洛佩斯早年独裁者之子与欧洲军事考察
分析1864年三国同盟战争发动与巴拉圭全民动员
探讨女性教师铁路建设与儿童兵役战争机器
评估1870年沙袋堡战死与巴拉圭人口灾难
总结独裁三国战争女性教育铁路悲剧对拉美军国主义的警示
steps_en: Study Lopez early dictator son and European military inspection
Analyze 1864 Triple Alliance War launch and Paraguay total mobilization
Explore women teachers railway construction and child soldiers war machine
Evaluate 1870 Cerro Cora death and Paraguay demographic catastrophe
Summarize dictatorship triple alliance war women education railway tragedy warning for Latin American militarism
PY-DIC-001.expected_zh: 理解独裁战争动员如何吞噬社会建设成果，掌握女性教育与基建在全面战争中的工具化异化机制，评估洛佩斯悲剧对拉美文职控制军队原则的奠基作用。
PY-DIC-001.expected_en: Understand how dictatorial war mobilization devours social construction achievements, grasp women education and infrastructure instrumentalization alienation in total war mechanism, evaluate Lopez tragedy foundational role for Latin American civilian control of military principle.
PY-DIC-001.case_zh: 1862 独裁；1864 战争；1870 战死。独裁三国战争女性教育铁路悲剧范式永存。
PY-DIC-001.case_en: 1862 dictator; 1864 war; 1870 death. Dictatorship triple alliance war women education railway tragedy paradigm endures.
PY-DIC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Triple Alliance War; demographic catastrophe; women mobilization; railway

UY-ONC-001.name_zh: 乌拉圭·塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯：肿瘤医生总统与癌症烟草合法健康
UY-ONC-001.name_en: Uruguay Tabare Vazquez: Oncologist President & Cancer Tobacco Legal Health
UY-ONC-001.description_zh: 塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯 (1940-2020) 乌拉圭首位左翼总统 (2005-2010, 2015-2020)，肿瘤科医生推动严格烟草控制法案，世界首个全面禁烟国家，癌症治疗公共化，2014年合法化大麻国家管控。
UY-ONC-001.description_en: Tabare Vazquez (1940-2020) Uruguay first leftist President (2005-2010, 2015-2020), oncologist pushed strict tobacco control law, world first comprehensive smoke-free nation, cancer treatment publicized, 2014 legalized marijuana state control.
UY-ONC-001.reason_zh: 巴斯克斯代表医生总统如何将医学专业知识转化为公共卫生政策，展示了烟草控制与大麻合法化双重公共卫生创新如何在小国实现，其肿瘤医生身份为政策提供了不可置疑的专业权威。
UY-ONC-001.reason_en: Vazquez represents how doctor President transforms medical expertise into public health policy, demonstrating how tobacco control and marijuana legalization dual public health innovation achieved in small nation, his oncologist identity providing unquestionable professional authority for policy.
steps_zh: 研究巴斯克斯早年肿瘤医生与广阔阵线创建
分析2006年烟草控制法案世界首个全面禁烟
探讨癌症治疗纳入公共医疗体系与筛查普及
评估2014年大麻合法化国家管控模式创新
总结肿瘤医生总统癌症烟草合法健康对全球公共卫生治理的示范
steps_en: Study Vazquez early oncologist and Broad Front founding
Analyze 2006 tobacco control law world first comprehensive smoke-free
Explore cancer treatment public healthcare integration and screening普及
Evaluate 2014 marijuana legalization state control model innovation
Summarize oncologist president cancer tobacco legal health demonstration for global public health governance
UY-ONC-001.expected_zh: 掌握医学专业权威如何转化为公共政策立法动力，理解烟草禁令与大麻管控双重公共卫生创新的互补逻辑，评估巴斯克斯模式对智利阿根廷等邻国卫生政策的外溢影响。
UY-ONC-001.expected_en: Master how medical professional authority transforms into public policy legislative drive, grasp tobacco ban and marijuana control dual public health innovation complementary logic, evaluate Vazquez model spillover impact on Chile Argentina neighbors health policies.
UY-ONC-001.case_zh: 2005 总统；2006 禁烟；2014 大麻合法；2020 逝世。肿瘤医生总统癌症烟草合法范式永存。
UY-ONC-001.case_en: 2005 President; 2006 smoke-free; 2014 marijuana legal; 2020 death. Oncologist president cancer tobacco legal paradigm endures.
UY-ONC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tobacco control; marijuana legalization; cancer care; doctor politician

AR-NEO-001.name_zh: 阿根廷·卡洛斯·梅内姆：改革货币板与私有化赦免里奥哈腐败
AR-NEO-001.name_en: Argentina Carlos Menem: Reform Currency Board & Privatization Amnesty Rioja Corruption
AR-NEO-001.description_zh: 卡洛斯·梅内姆 (1930-2021) 阿根廷总统 (1989-1999)，货币板制度1比1锚定美元遏制恶性通胀，大规模私有化国企，赦免军政府/庇隆主义者罪行，里奥哈家族腐败丑闻，1999年交权德拉鲁阿。
AR-NEO-001.description_en: Carlos Menem (1930-2021) Argentina President (1989-1999), currency board 1-to-1 dollar peg tamed hyperinflation, massive privatization, pardoned junta/Peronists crimes, Rioja family corruption scandal, 1999 handover De la Rua.
AR-NEO-001.reason_zh: 梅内姆代表新自由主义如何通过货币板与私有化快速稳定经济，展示了赦免过去暴行如何为转型提供政治润滑剂却埋下腐败种子，其货币板崩溃引发2001年阿根廷最大危机。
AR-NEO-001.reason_en: Menem represents how neoliberalism rapidly stabilizes economy through currency board and privatization, demonstrating how pardoning past atrocities provides political lubricant for transition but seeds corruption, his currency board collapse triggered 2001 Argentina worst crisis.
steps_zh: 研究梅内姆早年里奥哈州长与庇隆主义者身份
分析1991年可兑换法货币板1比1锚定美元
探讨石油/电信/航空私有化与赦免法案通过
评估里奥哈家族腐败与1999年交权德拉鲁阿
总结改革货币板私有化赦免里奥哈腐败对阿根廷2001危机的根源铺垫
steps_en: Study Menem early La Rioja Governor and Peronist identity
Analyze 1991 Convertibility Law currency board 1-to-1 dollar peg
Explore oil/telecom/aviation privatization and pardon laws passage
Evaluate Rioja family corruption and 1999 handover De la Rua
Summarize reform currency board privatization amnesty Rioja corruption root cause for Argentina 2001 crisis
AR-NEO-001.expected_zh: 理解货币板如何作为通胀止痛药掩盖结构性失衡，掌握赦免与私有化双重转型代价的长期累积，评估梅内姆遗产对阿根廷周期性危机的深度历史责任。
AR-NEO-001.expected_en: Understand how currency board as inflation painkiller masks structural imbalances, grasp pardon and privatization dual transition costs long-term accumulation, evaluate Menem legacy deep historical responsibility for Argentine cyclical crises.
AR-NEO-001.case_zh: 1989 总统；1991 货币板；1999 交权；2021 逝世。改革货币板私有化赦免腐败范式永存。
AR-NEO-001.case_en: 1989 President; 1991 currency board; 1999 handover; 2021 death. Reform currency board privatization amnesty corruption paradigm endures.
AR-NEO-001.cross_cultural_impact: Currency board; privatization; pardon; hyperinflation cure; 2001 crisis root

CL-SOC-001.name_zh: 智利·萨尔瓦多·阿连德：社会主义选举与政变自杀新自由主义开端
CL-SOC-001.name_en: Chile Salvador Allende: Socialist Election & Coup Suicide Neoliberal Dawn
CL-SOC-001.description_zh: 萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (1908-1973) 智利总统 (1970-1973)，拉美首位民选社会主义总统，人民团结联盟推行国有化改革，1973年皮诺切特政变空军轰炸总统府，阿连德自杀殉道，新自由主义实验开始。
CL-SOC-001.description_en: Salvador Allende (1908-1973) Chile President (1970-1973), Latin America first democratically elected socialist President, Popular Unity coalition implemented nationalization reforms, 1973 Pinochet coup air force bombed La Moneda, Allende suicide martyrdom, neoliberal experiment began.
CL-SOC-001.reason_zh: 阿连德代表民主道路通向社会主义的拉美尝试与美帝国主义干预的悲剧性终结，展示了民选政府如何在经济战与军事政变双重绞杀下崩溃，其自杀殉道成为拉美左翼永恒精神图腾，政变开启智利新自由主义实验室。
CL-SOC-001.reason_en: Allende represents Latin American democratic road to socialism tragic ending and US imperialist intervention, demonstrating how democratically elected government collapses under economic warfare and military coup dual stranglehold, his suicide martyrdom becoming Latin American left eternal spiritual totem, coup inaugurating Chilean neoliberal laboratory.
steps_zh: 研究阿连德早年医生与社会党参议员生涯
分析1970年人民团结联盟当选与铜矿国有化
探讨美国ITT/中央情报局经济战与卡车司机罢工
评估1973年9月11日政变拉莫内达宫自杀殉道
总结社会主义选举政变自杀新自由主义开端对拉美左翼的永恒创伤与警示
steps_en: Study Allende early doctor and Socialist Senator career
Analyze 1970 Popular Unity election and copper nationalization
Explore US ITT/CIA economic warfare and truckers strike
Evaluate 1973 Sep 11 coup La Moneda bombing suicide martyrdom
Summarize socialist election coup suicide neoliberal dawn eternal trauma and warning for Latin American left
CL-SOC-001.expected_zh: 理解民主社会主义如何在帝国主义干预与国内右翼联盟下崩溃，掌握政变如何为新自由主义实验铺平道路，评估阿连德遗产对智利转型正义与拉美左翼复兴的双重指引。
CL-SOC-001.expected_en: Understand how democratic socialism collapses under imperialist intervention and domestic right-wing alliance, grasp how coup paves way for neoliberal experiment, evaluate Allende legacy dual guidance for Chilean transitional justice and Latin American left revival.
CL-SOC-001.case_zh: 1970 总统；1973 政变自杀；皮诺切特17年；2023年宪法公投。社会主义选举政变自杀新自由范式永存。
CL-SOC-001.case_en: 1970 President; 1973 coup suicide; Pinochet 17 years; 2023 constitutional referendum. Socialist election coup suicide neoliberal paradigm endures.
CL-SOC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Democratic socialism; CIA coup; neoliberalism; suicide martyrdom; constitutional reform

MX-OIL-001.name_zh: 墨西哥·拉萨罗·卡德纳斯：石油国有化与土地改革卡德纳斯主义
MX-OIL-001.name_en: Mexico Lazaro Cardenas: Oil Nationalization & Land Reform Cardenismo
MX-OIL-001.description_zh: 拉萨罗·卡德纳斯 (1895-1970) 墨西哥总统 (1934-1940)，1938年石油国有化建立墨西哥石油公司(PEMEX)，大规模土地改革分配埃希多集体用地，奠定墨西哥革命制度化基础。
MX-OIL-001.description_en: Lazaro Cardenas (1895-1970) Mexico President (1934-1940), 1938 oil nationalization established PEMEX, large-scale land reform distributed ejido collective lands, founded Mexican Revolution institutionalization basis.
MX-OIL-001.reason_zh: 卡德纳斯代表墨西哥革命如何通过资源民族化与土地再分配实现制度化，展示了石油主权与农民利益双重合法性如何构建革命政党长期执政基础，其卡德纳斯主义影响拉美资源民族主义至今。
MX-OIL-001.reason_en: Cardenas represents how Mexican Revolution achieved institutionalization through resource nationalization and land redistribution dual legitimacy, demonstrating how oil sovereignty and peasant interests built revolutionary party long-term rule foundation, his Cardenismo influencing Latin American resource nationalism today.
steps_zh: 研究卡德纳斯早年革命将领与卡列斯冲突
分析1938年石油国有化与美英石油公司博弈
探讨埃希多集体土地分配与农民动员
评估1940年交权阿维拉·卡马乔与革命制度党建立
总结石油国有化土地改革卡德纳斯主义对墨西哥政治的永恒定型
steps_en: Study Cardenas early revolutionary general and Calles conflict
Analyze 1938 oil nationalization and US-UK oil companies game
Explore ejido collective land distribution and peasant mobilization

GL-AUT-001.description_en: Kuupik Kleist (1958-) Greenland Self-Government PM (2009-2013), promoted Self-Government Act expanding legislative powers, fisheries dominant economy seeking rare earth diversification, climate change ice melt opening shipping lanes resource competition, negotiating independence timeline with Denmark.
GL-AUT-001.reason_zh: 克努森代表北极原住民如何通过自治法律框架与资源主权争取独立主体性，展示了气候变化如何同时成为生存威胁与资源机遇双重悖论，其独立博弈重塑北极地缘政治版图。
GL-AUT-001.reason_en: Kleist represents how Arctic indigenous people pursue independent subjectivity through autonomy legal framework and resource sovereignty, demonstrating how climate change becomes both existential threat and resource opportunity paradox, his independence game reshaping Arctic geopolitical map.
steps_zh: 研究克努森早年哥本哈根教育与因纽特文化根基
分析2009年自治法案通过与立法司法权扩大
探讨渔业垄断经济与稀土矿产/铀矿开发争议
评估气候融冰开辟西北航道与美中俄北极博弈
总结自治渔业稀土气候冰盖独立丹麦博弈对北极原住民主权的前沿探索
steps_en: Study Kleist early Copenhagen education and Inuit cultural roots
Analyze 2009 Self-Government Act passage and legislative judicial powers expansion
Explore fisheries monopoly economy and rare earth/uranium mining controversy
Evaluate climate melt opening Northwest Passage and US-China-Russia Arctic game
Summarize autonomy fisheries rare earth climate ice independence Denmark game frontier exploration for Arctic indigenous sovereignty
GL-AUT-001.expected_zh: 理解自治法律框架如何为原住民独立提供制度路径，掌握气候变化作为生存威胁与资源机遇双重悖论的北极特殊性，评估格陵兰模式对努纳武特萨米等北极原住民自治的示范。
GL-AUT-001.expected_en: Understand how autonomy legal framework provides institutional path for indigenous independence, grasp climate change as existential threat and resource opportunity dual paradox Arctic specificity, evaluate Greenland model demonstration for Nunavut Sami Arctic indigenous autonomy.
GL-AUT-001.case_zh: 2009 自治法案；2013 卸任；稀土/气候/独立。自治渔业稀土气候独立范式永存。
GL-AUT-001.case_en: 2009 Self-Government Act; 2013 retirement; rare earth/climate/independence. Autonomy fisheries rare earth climate independence paradigm endures.
GL-AUT-001.intellectual_tradition: Inuit Self-Determination / Arctic Resource Sovereignty / Climate Justice
GL-AUT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Greenland autonomy; rare earth; climate change; Arctic geopolitics; indigenous sovereignty

JP-MIT-001.name_zh: 石田三成/关原/三成判断/三敬茶/大名平衡
JP-MIT-001.name_en: Ishida Mitsunari/Sekigahara/Mitsunari Judgment/Three Bowls Tea/Daimyo Balance
JP-MIT-001.description_zh: 石田三成 (1560-1600) 丰臣政权五奉行之首，关原之战西军主帅。早年以'三敬茶'侍奉秀吉展现极致观察力与共情，推行'太阁检地'与'三成判断'确立行政理性，关原之战虽败犹显大名平衡术与情报决策。
JP-MIT-001.description_en: Ishida Mitsunari (1560-1600) Head of Toyotomi's Five Commissioners, Western Army commander at Sekigahara. Early 'Three Bowls of Tea' serving Hideyoshi demonstrated supreme observational empathy; implemented Taiko Land Survey and 'Mitsunari Judgments' establishing administrative rationality; Sekigahara defeat still revealed daimyo balance mastery and intelligence-driven decision-making.
JP-MIT-001.reason_zh: 三成代表'技术官僚型武将'如何通过极致观察共情(三敬茶)、制度建设(检地/判断)、情报博弈(关原布局)在乱世构建秩序。其悲剧性失败反而证明：纯理性行政在非理性武力面前的结构性脆弱，以及'三敬茶'式微观共情如何成为宏观决策的认知基石。
JP-MIT-001.reason_en: Mitsunari represents how 'technocratic warrior' built order through supreme observational empathy (Three Bowls Tea), institutional engineering (land survey/judgments), and intelligence games (Sekigahara layout). His tragic failure proves structural fragility of pure rational administration facing irrational force, and how 'Three Bowls Tea' micro-empathy becomes cognitive foundation for macro decisions.
steps_zh: 复盘三敬茶：热/温/凉三杯茶背后的体温感知与需求预判
解析太阁检地：从土地生产力测算到税制标准化的制度理性
研读三成判断：以证据为中心的行政裁决如何确立程序正义
推演关原布局：情报收集/大名劝说/地形选择的博弈树与风险对冲
总结三成模式：微观共情→制度理性→情报决策的认知闭环，及其在非理性武力面前的结构性失效
steps_en: Review Three Bowls Tea: body temp sensing & need anticipation behind hot/warm/cool tea
Analyze Taiko Land Survey: from productivity measurement to tax standardization institutional rationality
Study Mitsunari Judgments: evidence-centered administrative adjudication establishing procedural justice
Reenact Sekigahara Layout: intelligence gathering/daimyo persuasion/terrain selection game tree & risk hedging
Summarize Mitsunari Pattern: micro-empathy → institutional rationality → intelligence decision cognitive loop, and its structural failure against irrational force
JP-MIT-001.expected_zh: 掌握'三敬茶式观察共情'如何转化为'检地式制度理性'与'关原式情报决策'的认知升级路径；理解技术官僚在乱世中的建构性贡献与结构性悲剧；评估三成模式对现代行政裁决、情报决策、组织共情文化的双重启示。
JP-MIT-001.expected_en: Master cognitive upgrade path from 'Three Bowls Tea observational empathy' to 'Land Survey institutional rationality' to 'Sekigahara intelligence decision'; understand technocrat's constructive contribution and structural tragedy in chaos; evaluate Mitsunari pattern's dual lessons for modern administrative adjudication, intelligence decision-making, and organizational empathy culture.
JP-MIT-001.case_zh: 1590 三敬茶得秀吉赏识；1594 太阁检地确立税制；1598 三成判断确立程序正义；1600 关原之战败亡。三敬茶-检地-判断-关原认知闭环永存。
JP-MIT-001.case_en: 1590 Three Bowls Tea won Hideyoshi's favor; 1594 Taiko Land Survey established tax system; 1598 Mitsunari Judgments established procedural justice; 1600 Sekigahara defeat. Three Bowls Tea-Survey-Judgment-Sekigahara cognitive loop endures.
JP-MIT-001.intellectual_tradition: Sengoku Technocratic Administration / Japanese Bureaucratic Rationality
JP-MIT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Three Bowls Tea empathy; land survey institutionalization; evidence-based administrative judgment; intelligence-driven strategic decision; technocrat tragedy

JP-SOS-001.name_zh: 夏目漱石/明治/文豪/近代自我/猫视角/心理剖析
JP-SOS-001.name_en: Natsume Soseki/Meiji/Literary Master/Modern Self/Cat Perspective/Psychological Anatomy
JP-SOS-001.description_zh: 夏目漱石 (1867-1916) 日本近代文学奠基人，《我是猫》《心》《坊津》作者。以'猫视角'拟人化讽刺明治文明病理，'心'完成近代自我心理解剖，留学英国反思文明冲突，提出'then-and-now'文明批评框架，确立私小说心理实验传统。
JP-SOS-001.description_en: Natsume Soseki (1867-1916) Founder of modern Japanese literature, author of I Am a Cat, Kokoro, Botchan. Used 'cat perspective' anthropomorphic satire on Meiji civilization pathology; Kokoro completed modern self psychological anatomy; UK study reflected civilization clash; proposed 'then-and-now' civilization critique framework; established shishosetsu psychological experiment tradition.
JP-SOS-001.reason_zh: 漱石代表'近代自我'如何在文明剧变中通过文学实验完成心理解剖。其'猫视角'将读者置于旁观者位置重审文明荒谬；'心'以师生/父子/夫妻三重背叛完成近代伦理解体图谱；留学反思确立'文明批评'作为知识分子核心使命。私小说传统至今影响村上春树、东野圭吾等。
JP-SOS-001.reason_en: Soseki represents how 'modern self' completes psychological anatomy through literary experiment amid civilization upheaval. 'Cat perspective' places reader as observer re-examining civilization absurdity; Kokoro maps modern ethics disintegration via teacher-student/father-son/husband-wife triple betrayal; UK reflection established 'civilization critique' as intellectuals' core mission. Shishosetsu tradition influences Murakami, Higashino today.
steps_zh: 解构《我是猫》：拟人化讽刺如何将读者置于旁观位置解构文明荒谬
剖析《心》：师生/父子/夫妻三重背叛如何完成近代伦理解体图谱
追溯留学反思：伦敦两年'神经衰弱'如何转化为'then-and-now'文明批评框架
确立私小说：心理实验与自传融合如何开创'我小说'传统
总结漱石模式：猫视角解构→心理剖析解体→文明批评框架→私小说传承的文学认知闭环
steps_en: Deconstruct I Am a Cat: how anthropomorphic satire places reader as observer deconstructing civilization absurdity
Analyze Kokoro: how teacher-student/father-son/husband-wife triple betrayal maps modern ethics disintegration
Trace UK reflection: how two years London 'neurasthenia' transformed into 'then-and-now' civilization critique framework
Establish Shishosetsu: how psychological experiment + autobiography fusion created 'I-novel' tradition
Summarize Soseki pattern: cat perspective deconstruction → psychological anatomy disintegration → civilization critique framework → I-novel tradition cognitive loop
JP-SOS-001.expected_zh: 掌握'猫视角'如何作为文学手术刀解剖文明病理；理解'心'式心理剖析如何完成近代自我伦理拓扑；评估漱石文明批评框架对当代知识分子公共介入的方法论启示。
JP-SOS-001.expected_en: Master how 'cat perspective' serves as literary scalpel dissecting civilization pathology; understand how Kokoro-style psychological anatomy completes modern self ethical topology; evaluate Soseki civilization critique framework's methodological lessons for contemporary intellectuals' public engagement.
JP-SOS-001.case_zh: 1905 《我是猫》连载；1914 《心》发表；1916 病逝未完《明暗》。猫视角-心理剖析-文明批评-私小说范式永存。
JP-SOS-001.case_en: 1905 I Am a Cat serialized; 1914 Kokoro published; 1916 died unfinished Light and Darkness. Cat perspective-psychological anatomy-civilization critique-I-novel paradigm endures.
JP-SOS-001.intellectual_tradition: Modern Japanese Literature / Shishosetsu / Civilization Critique
JP-SOS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Cat perspective satire; psychological anatomy; civilization critique; I-novel tradition; modern self
JP-SOS-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 小说/文学批评/私小说传统

NL-WIL-001.name_zh: 威廉一世/荷兰/奥兰治/独立战争/东印度公司/海上马车夫
NL-WIL-001.name_en: William I/Netherlands/Orange/Independence War/East India Company/Sea Carrier
NL-WIL-001.description_zh: 威廉一世 (1772-1843) 荷兰首任国王，奥兰治-拿骚家族首领，领导荷兰独立战争摆脱法国统治，建立联合王国，扩张东印度公司 (VOC) 亚洲贸易网络，确立荷兰海上马车夫地位，加尔文主义宽容传统奠定国家基因。
NL-WIL-001.description_en: William I (1772-1843) Netherlands first king, Orange-Nassau family head, led Dutch independence war against French rule, established United Kingdom, expanded VOC Asian trade network, established Dutch sea carrier status, Calvinist tolerance tradition founded national genes.
NL-WIL-001.reason_zh: 威廉一世代表小国如何通过海上贸易与殖民网络成为全球经济枢纽，展示了加尔文主义宽容传统如何转化为商业竞争优势，其东印度公司模式开创了跨国公司先河。
NL-WIL-001.reason_en: William I represents how small nation becomes global economic hub through maritime trade and colonial network, demonstrating how Calvinist tolerance tradition transforms into commercial competitive advantage, his VOC model pioneering multinational corporation prototype.
steps_zh: 研究威廉早年奥兰治家族/流亡英国/普鲁士军官
分析1813年独立战争/1815年维也纳会议/联合王国建立
探讨VOC亚洲贸易网络/香料垄断/巴达维亚总督府
评估加尔文主义宽容/宗教自由/商业自由传统
总结奥兰治精神/东印度公司/海上马车夫/加尔文宽容四重遗产
steps_en: Study William early Orange family/British exile/Prussian officer
Analyze 1813 independence war/1815 Vienna Congress/United Kingdom founding
Explore VOC Asian trade network/spice monopoly/Batavia Governor-General
Evaluate Calvinist tolerance/religious freedom/commercial freedom tradition
Summarize Orange spirit/VOC/sea carriage/Calvinist tolerance quadruple legacy
NL-WIL-001.expected_zh: 掌握小国如何通过海上贸易殖民网络跃升全球枢纽，理解加尔文主义宽容如何转化为商业竞争力，评估威廉一世对荷兰黄金时代与现代跨国公司的奠基贡献。
NL-WIL-001.expected_en: Master how small nation becomes global hub via maritime trade, grasp Calvinist tolerance transforming into commercial advantage, evaluate William I foundational contribution to Dutch Golden Age and modern MNCs.
NL-WIL-001.case_zh: 1813 独立战争；1815 维也纳会议/国王；1824 英荷条约；1840 退位。奥兰治精神/东印度公司/海上马车夫/加尔文宽容范式永存。
NL-WIL-001.case_en: 1813 independence war; 1815 Vienna Congress/king; 1824 Anglo-Dutch treaty; 1840 abdication. Orange spirit/VOC/sea carriage/Calvinist tolerance paradigm endures.
NL-WIL-001.intellectual_tradition: Dutch Republicanism / Calvinist Capitalism / Maritime Trade
NL-WIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Dutch independence; VOC; maritime trade; Calvinist tolerance; constitutional monarchy

NL-GRO-001.name_zh: 格劳秀斯/荷兰/国际法/海洋自由/自然法/阿姆斯特丹/法学之父
NL-GRO-001.name_en: Grotius/Netherlands/International Law/Freedom of Seas/Natural Law/Amsterdam/Father of International Law
NL-GRO-001.description_zh: 雨果·格劳秀斯 (1583-1645) 国际法奠基人，《战争与和平法》确立海洋自由原则，自然法理论超越教权构建世俗法理体系，阿姆斯特丹法学家为荷兰东印度公司辩护奠定海洋法基础，流亡巴黎撰写巨著影响至今。
NL-GRO-001.description_en: Hugo Grotius (1583-1645) Father of International Law, De Jure Belli ac Pacis established freedom of seas principle, natural law theory transcending ecclesiastical authority constructing secular legal system, Amsterdam jurist defending VOC laid maritime law foundation, Paris exile writing magnum opus influencing today.
NL-GRO-001.reason_zh: 格劳秀斯代表法学如何通过理性推演超越神权与主权界限，展示了海洋自由原则如何保护弱小国家贸易权利，其自然法体系为现代国际法/人道法/海洋法提供了共同语言基础。
NL-GRO-001.reason_en: Grotius represents how jurisprudence transcends divine right and sovereignty boundaries through rational deduction, demonstrating how freedom of seas protects weak nations trade rights, his natural law system providing common language basis for modern international law/humanitarian law/maritime law.
steps_zh: 研究格劳秀斯早年天才少年/莱顿大学/律师/东印度公司顾问
分析《自由海》海洋自由原则/自由贸易/无主物先占
探讨《战争与和平法》自然法/正义战争/国际法体系
评估流亡巴黎/瑞典/外交/法学巨著/法学之父
总结国际法/海洋自由/自然法/战争法/主权平等五重遗产
steps_en: Study Grotius early prodigy/Leiden University/lawyer/VOC counsel
Analyze Mare Liberum freedom of seas/free trade/res nullius
Explore De Jure Belli ac Pacis natural law/just war/international law system
Evaluate Paris exile/Sweden diplomacy/legal magnum opus/father of intl law
Summarize international law/freedom of seas/natural law/war law/sovereign equality quintuple legacy
NL-GRO-001.expected_zh: 掌握自然法如何构建超越主权的普世法理，理解海洋自由如何保护弱国生存空间，评估格劳秀斯对现代国际法/人道法/海洋法的奠基性贡献。
NL-GRO-001.expected_en: Master how natural law constructs universal jurisprudence transcending sovereignty, grasp freedom of seas protecting weak nations survival space, evaluate Grotius foundational contribution to modern intl law/humanitarian law/maritime law.
NL-GRO-001.case_zh: 1609 自由海；1625 战争与和平法；1645 流亡逝世。国际法/海洋自由/自然法/主权平等范式永存。
NL-GRO-001.case_en: 1609 Mare Liberum; 1625 De Jure Belli ac Pacis; 1645 death in exile. International law/freedom of seas/natural law/sovereign equality paradigm endures.
NL-GRO-001.intellectual_tradition: Natural Law / International Law / Maritime Law
NL-GRO-001.cross_cultural_impact: International law; freedom of seas; natural law; just war; maritime law

NL-TOB-001.name_zh: 托贝/荷兰/三角洲工程/水利民主/北海防洪/水管理/气候适应
NL-TOB-001.name_en: Toebes/Netherlands/Delta Works/Water Democracy/North Sea Flood/Water Management/Climate Adaptation
NL-TOB-001.description_zh: 约汉·范·托贝 (1903-1989) 荷兰水利工程师，1953年北海大洪水后主导三角洲工程，建立水利民主决策模式，与水共生而非对抗，荷兰成为全球水管理/气候适应标杆，三角洲工程被誉为现代世界七大奇迹之一。
NL-TOB-001.description_en: Johan van Toebes (1903-1989) Dutch hydraulic engineer, led Delta Works after 1953 North Sea Flood, established water democracy decision model, living with water not against it, Netherlands became global water management/climate adaptation benchmark, Delta Works hailed as modern world seven wonders.
NL-TOB-001.reason_zh: 托贝代表低地国家如何通过技术工程与民主决策双重手段实现国家生存，展示了与水共生理念如何超越单纯工程对抗，其水利民主模式为全球沿海城市气候适应提供了治理范式。
NL-TOB-001.reason_en: Toebes represents how lowland nation achieves national survival through technical engineering and democratic decision dual approach, demonstrating how living-with-water philosophy transcends pure engineering confrontation, his water democracy model providing governance paradigm for global coastal cities climate adaptation.
steps_zh: 研究托贝早年代尔夫特理工/水利工程师/祖伊德海工程
分析1953年北海大洪水/1836死/三角洲委员会成立
探讨三角洲工程/拦海大坝/风暴潮屏障/可移动屏障
评估水利民主/利益相关者参与/共识决策/技术民主
总结三角洲工程/水利民主/与水共生/气候适应/国家生存五重遗产
steps_en: Study Toebes early Delft Tech/hydraulic engineer/Zuiderzee Works
Analyze 1953 North Sea Flood/1836 deaths/Delta Committee founded
Explore Delta Works/storm surge barriers/movable barriers
Evaluate water democracy/stakeholder participation/consensus decision/technical democracy
Summarize Delta Works/water democracy/living with water/climate adaptation/national survival quintuple legacy
NL-TOB-001.expected_zh: 掌握技术工程如何与民主决策结合实现国家生存，理解与水共生理念如何超越工程对抗思维，评估荷兰水利民主模式对全球沿海城市气候适应的治理范式意义。
NL-TOB-001.expected_en: Master how technical engineering combines with democratic decision for national survival, grasp living-with-water philosophy transcending engineering confrontation, evaluate Dutch water democracy model governance paradigm for global coastal cities climate adaptation.
NL-TOB-001.case_zh: 1953 北海大洪水；1958 三角洲法案；1997 完成；1989 逝世。三角洲工程/水利民主/与水共生/气候适应范式永存。
NL-TOB-001.case_en: 1953 North Sea Flood; 1958 Delta Act; 1997 completion; 1989 death. Delta Works/water democracy/living with water/climate adaptation paradigm endures.
NL-TOB-001.intellectual_tradition: Dutch Hydraulic Engineering / Technical Democracy / Climate Adaptation
NL-TOB-001.cross_cultural_impact: Delta Works; flood protection; water democracy; climate adaptation; technical democracy
NL-TOB-001.scientific_contribution: 是: 水利工程/气候适应

NL-PHIL-001.name_zh: 菲利普斯/荷兰/电子/灯泡/医疗/研发/家族企业/埃因霍温
NL-PHIL-001.description_zh: 杰拉德·菲利普斯 (1858-1942) 与儿子安东，从灯泡起家建立电子帝国，埃因霍温研发基地孵化医疗/照明/消费电子创新，家族企业治理平衡技术理想与商业现实，二战期间保护犹太员工，战后重建欧洲电子工业基石。
NL-PHIL-001.description_en: Gerard Philips (1858-1942) and son Anton, built electronics empire from lightbulbs, Eindhoven R&D base incubated medical/lighting/consumer electronics innovations, family enterprise governance balanced tech ideals and commercial reality, WWII protected Jewish employees, postwar rebuilt European electronics industry foundation.
NL-PHIL-001.reason_zh: 菲利普斯代表家族企业如何通过持续研发投入实现技术代际传承，展示了埃因霍温模式如何将城市转化为创新生态系统，其二战保护犹太员工展现企业社会责任，战后重建奠定欧洲电子工业基石。
NL-PHIL-001.reason_en: Philips represents how family enterprise achieves intergenerational tech inheritance through sustained R&D investment, demonstrating how Eindhoven model transforms city into innovation ecosystem, WWII Jewish employee protection demonstrating corporate social responsibility, postwar rebuilding European electronics foundation.
steps_zh: 研究杰拉德早年灯泡/安东/埃因霍温/纳特实验室

DE-ADO-001.name_zh: 阿登纳/德国/西德建国/欧洲一体化/大西洋主义/奥斯汀
DE-ADO-001.description_zh: 康拉德·阿登纳 (1876-1967) 西德首任总理 (1949-1963)，推动西德融入西方阵营，巴黎条约/罗马条约奠定欧洲共同体基础，大西洋主义锚定美德关系，社会市场经济确立战后经济奇迹基础，年过七十仍执政十四年。
DE-ADO-001.description_en: Konrad Adenauer (1876-1967) West Germany first Chancellor (1949-1963), drove West Germany integration into Western bloc, Paris/Rome Treaties founded European Community basis, Atlanticism anchored US-Germany relations, social market economy established post-war economic miracle foundation, governed fourteen years past age seventy.
DE-ADO-001.reason_zh: 阿登纳代表战败国如何通过主动西向融入重塑国家身份，展示了社会市场经济如何平衡资本效率与社会公正，其大西洋主义与欧洲一体化双轮驱动奠定现代德国外交基石。
DE-ADO-001.reason_en: Adenauer represents how defeated nation reshapes national identity through proactive Western integration, demonstrating how social market economy balances capitalist efficiency and social justice, his Atlanticism and European integration dual-wheel driving modern German diplomacy foundation.

总结西德建国/欧洲一体化/大西洋主义/社会市场经济四重遗产

DE-BIS-001.name_zh: 俾斯麦/德国/铁血宰相/统一/保险/同盟
DE-BIS-001.description_zh: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦 (1815-1898) 普鲁士首相、德意志帝国首任铁血宰相，通过三次战争完成德意志统一，建立三帝同盟体系，创立世界首个社会保险体系（医疗/工伤/养老），实行铁血现实politik平衡欧洲大陆势力。
DE-BIS-001.description_en: Otto von Bismarck (1815-1898) Prussian Minister President, first Iron Chancellor of German Empire, achieved German unification through three wars, established Three Emperors League system, created world's first social insurance system (health/workers' comp/pension), practiced Realpolitik balancing European continental powers.
DE-BIS-001.reason_zh: 俾斯麦代表现实主义外交如何通过战争与外交双重手段完成民族统一，展示了社会保险如何作为国家整合工具安抚工人阶级，其均势外交体系维持欧洲和平四十年，铁血宰相模式影响现代地缘政治。
DE-BIS-001.reason_en: Bismarck represents how realist diplomacy achieves national unification through war and diplomacy dual approach, demonstrating how social insurance serves as state integration tool appeasing working class, his balance-of-power system maintained European peace for forty years, Iron Chancellor model influencing modern geopolitics.

总结铁血现实politik/社会保险/均势外交三重遗产

Summarize Realpolitik/social insurance/balance-of-power triple legacy

DE-BIS-001.expected_en: Master war-diplomacy dual-wheel driving national unification logic, understand social insurance as state integration tool operating mechanism, evaluate Bismarck balance-of-power diplomacy profound impact on modern geopolitics.

DE-BRA-001.name_zh: 勃兰特/德国/东方政策/跪地谢罪/诺贝尔/社民党
DE-BRA-001.description_zh: 维利·勃兰特 (1913-1992) 西德总理 (1969-1974)，东方政策缓和与东欧关系，华沙跪地谢罪成为历史和解象征，诺贝尔和平奖肯定和解努力，社民党现代化确立福利国家新阶段，1974年因间谍案辞职。
DE-BRA-001.description_en: Willy Brandt (1913-1992) West German Chancellor (1969-1974), Ostpolitik detente with Eastern Europe, Warsaw kneeling apology became historical reconciliation symbol, Nobel Peace Prize affirmed reconciliation efforts, SPD modernization established welfare state new stage, 1974 resigned over spy scandal.
DE-BRA-001.reason_zh: 勃兰特代表战败国如何通过主动承认历史罪责实现道德重生，展示了东方政策如何通过接触而非隔离化解冷战对抗，其跪地谢罪成为转型正义全球范式，诺贝尔和平奖加冕道德权威。
DE-BRA-001.reason_en: Brandt represents how defeated nation achieves moral rebirth through proactive historical guilt admission, demonstrating how Ostpolitik resolves Cold War confrontation through engagement not isolation, his kneeling apology becoming transitional justice global paradigm, Nobel Peace Prize crowning moral authority.

DE-BRA-001.expected_en: Master how moral courage transforms into diplomatic breakthrough, grasp engagement policy resolving Cold War deadlock, evaluate Brandt kneeling decisive contribution for German reunification/European integration/transitional justice.

DE-ENE-001.name_zh: 能源转型/德国/核退出/可再生/储能/氢能/工业脱碳
DE-ENE-001.description_zh: 德国能源转型 (Energiewende) 2000年可再生能源法 (EEG) 启动，2011福岛后加速核电退出 (2023年最后三座关闭)，可再生能源占电力比超 50%，储能/氢能/电网数字化支撑间歇性电源，工业脱碳推动钢铁/化工/水泥绿色转型，目标 2045 碳中和。
DE-ENE-001.description_en: German Energiewende launched 2000 Renewable Energy Act (EEG), 2011 Fukushima accelerated nuclear phase-out (2023 last three closed), renewables exceed 50% electricity share, storage/hydrogen/grid digitalization support intermittent sources, industrial decarbonization drives steel/chemicals/cement green transition, target 2045 carbon neutrality.
DE-ENE-001.reason_zh: 德国能源转型代表工业强国如何通过政策设计实现能源系统根本性重构，展示了核电退出如何与可再生能源扩张协同而非对立，其储能/氢能/电网三位一体模式为全球能源转型提供了系统性范式。
DE-ENE-001.reason_en: German Energiewende represents how industrial power achieves fundamental energy system restructuring through policy design, demonstrating how nuclear phase-out synergizes with renewables expansion not opposition, its storage-hydrogen-grid trinity model providing systemic paradigm for global energy transition.

DE-HAB-001.name_zh: 哈贝马斯/德国/公共领域/交往理性/宪法爱国/法兰克福
DE-HAB-001.description_zh: 于尔根·哈贝马斯 (1929-) 法兰克福学派第二代核心，《公共领域的结构转型》奠基媒介理论，交往理性超越工具理性构建批判理论新范式，宪法爱国主义超越民族主义构建后民族国家认同，介入德国统一/欧盟/公共辩论六十年公共知识分子典范。
DE-HAB-001.description_en: Jürgen Habermas (1929-) Frankfurt School second generation core, Structural Transformation of the Public Sphere founded media theory, communicative rationality transcending instrumental reason constructed critical theory new paradigm, constitutional patriotism transcending nationalism constructing post-nation-state identity, intervening German reunification/EU/public debate sixty years public intellectual paradigm.
DE-HAB-001.reason_zh: 哈贝马斯代表批判理论如何从工具理性批判转向交往理性建构，展示了公共领域如何作为民主合法性来源而非舆论操纵场所，其宪法爱国主义为后民族主义时代提供了超越血缘/文化的政治认同方案。
DE-HAB-001.reason_en: Habermas represents how critical theory shifts from instrumental reason critique to communicative rationality construction, demonstrating how public sphere serves as democratic legitimacy source not opinion manipulation venue, his constitutional patriotism providing post-nationalism era political identity solution transcending blood/culture.

Summarize public sphere/communicative rationality/constitutional patriotism/critical theory/dialogue ethics quintuple legacy

DE-HAB-001.expected_en: Master how instrumental reason critique transforms into communicative rationality construction, grasp public sphere as democratic legitimacy source theoretical-practical tension, evaluate Habermas sixty years public engagement profound impact on German democracy/EU/global public sphere.

DE-HEG-001.name_zh: 黑格尔/德国/辩证法/绝对精神/历史哲学/普鲁士国家
DE-HEG-001.description_zh: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔 (1770-1831) 德国古典哲学集大成者，辩证法三段论（正-反-合）奠定现代哲学基础，绝对精神自我展开构建历史哲学体系，普鲁士国家作为理性实现的最高形式，影响马克思/海德格尔/哈贝马斯百年传承。
DE-HEG-001.description_en: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel (1770-1831) German classical philosophy culminator, dialectical triad (thesis-antithesis-synthesis) founded modern philosophy basis, absolute spirit self-unfolding constructed philosophy of history system, Prussian state as highest form of reason realization, influenced Marx/Heidegger/Habermas century-long inheritance.
DE-HEG-001.reason_zh: 黑格尔代表哲学如何通过辩证法将历史纳入理性体系，展示了国家作为伦理实体如何超越个人主观性，其辩证法成为马克思历史唯物主义与西方现代哲学的共同母体。
DE-HEG-001.reason_en: Hegel represents how philosophy incorporates history into rational system through dialectic, demonstrating how state as ethical entity transcends individual subjectivity, his dialectic becoming common matrix for Marx historical materialism and Western modern philosophy.
steps_zh: 研究黑格尔早年图宾根/耶拿/海德堡教授生涯
分析《精神现象学》主奴辩证与绝对知识
探讨《法哲学原理》国家伦理与公民社会
评估黑格尔左派/右派分化与马克思继承
总结辩证法/绝对精神/国家理性三重哲学遗产
steps_en: Study Hegel early Tübingen/Jena/Heidelberg professorship
Analyze Phenomenology of Spirit master-slave dialectic and absolute knowledge
Explore Philosophy of Right state ethics and civil society
Evaluate Hegelian Left/Right split and Marx inheritance
Summarize dialectic/absolute spirit/state reason triple philosophical legacy
DE-HEG-001.expected_zh: 掌握辩证三段论如何将历史纳入理性必然性，理解国家作为客观精神的伦理实体地位，评估黑格尔哲学对马克思主义/存在主义/批判理论的决定性奠基。
DE-HEG-001.expected_en: Master how dialectical triad incorporates history into rational necessity, grasp state as objective spirit ethical entity status, evaluate Hegel philosophy decisive foundation for Marxism/existentialism/critical theory.
DE-HEG-001.case_zh: 1807 精神现象学；1821 法哲学原理；1831 霍乱逝世。辩证法/绝对精神/国家理性范式永存。
DE-HEG-001.case_en: 1807 Phenomenology; 1821 Philosophy of Right; 1831 cholera death. Dialectic/absolute spirit/state reason paradigm endures.
DE-HEG-001.intellectual_tradition: German Idealism / Dialectics / Philosophy of History
DE-HEG-001.cross_cultural_impact: Dialectic; absolute spirit; philosophy of history; Marxism; critical theory

EG-MUB-001.case_en: Mubarak led 埃及 historical important events, demonstrating Long-term Stability/Arab Spring/Taliban Square/Power Succession/Military Relations and other thinking modes.
