EG-MUB-001.description_zh: 埃及/埃及/埃及长期统治者/阿拉伯之春领袖/塔利班广场领导者/权力交接者/军政关系建立者

PK-JIN-001.name_zh: 真纳：巴基斯坦建国/两国论/伊斯兰宪政/穆斯林联盟/真纳精神
PK-JIN-001.name_en: Jinnah: Pakistan Independence/Two-Nation Theory/Islamic Constitutionalism/Muslim League/Jinnah Spirit
PK-JIN-001.description_zh: 真纳是巴基斯坦的国父，1876-1948年，他领导印度次大陆上的穆斯林人民争取独立，提出了著名的"两国论", 主张印度教徒和穆斯林是两个不同的民族，应在地理上分割，建立独立的国家。1947年，英属印度分裂为印度和巴基斯坦，真纳成为巴基斯坦的首任总督。真纳推动了伊斯兰宪政建设，建立了民主制度，为巴基斯坦的独立和现代化奠定了基础。
PK-JIN-001.description_en: Jinnah was the founding father of Pakistan, from 1876 to 1948, he led the Muslim people of the Indian subcontinent to fight for independence, proposing the famous "Two-Nation Theory," arguing that Hindus and Muslims were two distinct nations and should be geographically divided into independent states. In 1947, British India was partitioned into India and Pakistan, with Jinnah becoming the first Governor-General of Pakistan. Jinnah promoted Islamic constitutionalism, established democratic systems, and laid the foundation for Pakistan's independence and modernization.
PK-JIN-001.reason_zh: 真纳领导印度次大陆上的穆斯林人民赢得独立，建立了巴基斯坦国，推动了伊斯兰宪政和民主制度建设，但他的国家分裂主张导致印巴冲突持续。他的精神成为巴基斯坦国家身份的重要组成部分。
PK-JIN-001.reason_en: Jinnah led the Muslim people of the Indian subcontinent to win independence and establish Pakistan, promoted Islamic constitutionalism and democratic systems, but his partition of India led to ongoing India-Pakistan conflicts. His spirit remains a crucial part of Pakistan's national identity.
steps_zh: 学习真纳的领导艺术和外交策略，理解国家建国的历史必然性
研究印巴分治的历史背景和谈判过程，掌握殖民时代民族解放的外交策略
分析真纳的宪政建设和民主制度，探索伊斯兰国家的现代化道路
探讨真纳的精神和遗产，理解领导者在国家建设中的作用
总结真纳的经验教训，阐述国家统一与分裂的辩证关系
steps_en: Study Jinnah's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, understand the historical inevitability of national independence
Study the historical background and negotiation process of the India-Pakistan partition, master diplomatic strategies for national liberation during colonial times
Analyze Jinnah's constitutional construction and democratic systems, explore paths for Islamic state modernization
Explore Jinnah's spirit and legacy, understand the role of leaders in national construction
Summarize Jinnah's experiences and the dialectical relationship between national unity and division
PK-JIN-001.expected_zh: 掌握真纳的国家建国领导艺术和外交策略，熟悉印巴分治的历史背景和谈判过程，理解伊斯兰宪政和民主制度的建设，分析真纳的精神和遗产，培养学生对国家建国历史和领导者责任的认识。
PK-JIN-001.expected_en: Master Jinnah's national independence leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with the historical background and negotiation process of the India-Pakistan partition, understand the construction of Islamic constitutionalism and democratic systems, analyze Jinnah's spirit and legacy, cultivate students' understanding of national construction history and leadership responsibilities.
PK-JIN-001.case_zh: 1947年，真纳领导巴基斯坦人民赢得独立，建立了巴基斯坦国，成为首任总督。印巴分治导致大量人口迁移和宗教冲突，但真纳的领导确保了巴基斯坦的顺利建国和初期稳定。
PK-JIN-001.case_en: In 1947, Jinnah led the Pakistani people to win independence and establish the state of Pakistan, becoming the first Governor-General. The India-Pakistan partition caused significant population migration and religious conflicts, but Jinnah's leadership ensured Pakistan's smooth establishment and initial stability.
PK-JIN-001.cross_cultural_impact: South Asian partition model, Islamic constitutionalism, Pakistan state-building template

PK-BHU-001.name_zh: 布托：伊斯兰社会主义/民粹动员/核威慑/妇女权利/布托主义
PK-BHU-001.name_en: Bhutto: Islamic Socialism/Populist Mobilization/Nuclear Deterrence/Women's Rights/Bhuttoism
PK-BHU-001.description_zh: 布托是巴基斯坦的伟大领导人，1928-2007年，他领导巴基斯坦实现独立，建立了民主制度。布托推行了伊斯兰社会主义政策，动员了广大民众的支持。他领导巴基斯坦获得了核武器，建立了强大的国防力量。布托重视妇女权利，推动了女性赋权，为巴基斯坦的现代化和民主化做出了重要贡献。他的政治遗产至今仍影响着巴基斯坦政治。
PK-BHU-001.description_en: Bhutto was a great Pakistani leader from 1928 to 2007, who led Pakistan to independence and established a democratic system. Bhutto implemented Islamic socialist policies and mobilized widespread popular support. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons and established a strong defense capability. Bhutto emphasized women's rights and promoted female empowerment, making significant contributions to Pakistan's modernization and democratization. His political legacy continues to influence Pakistani politics today.
PK-BHU-001.reason_zh: 布托推行伊斯兰社会主义和民粹动员，赢得了民众支持，但他的激进政策导致政治动荡。他领导巴基斯坦获得核武器，但这也引发了地区紧张局势。他的妇女权利运动推动了进步，但也引发了社会争议。他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
PK-BHU-001.reason_en: Bhutto implemented Islamic socialism and populist mobilization, winning popular support, but his radical policies caused political turmoil. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons, which also triggered regional tensions. His women's rights movement promoted progress but also caused social controversy. His political legacy remains highly controversial today.
steps_zh: 学习布托的领导艺术和政治动员能力，理解在殖民时代国家建国的历史必然性
研究巴基斯坦核武器获得的历史背景和国际影响，掌握核政策的制定和实施
分析布托的妇女权利运动和民粹主义政策，探索在专制环境下推动进步的有效途径
探讨布托的伊斯兰社会主义政策，理解意识形态在政治中的作用
总结布托的经验教训，阐述在专制环境下推动民主和进步的挑战
steps_en: Study Bhutto's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, understand the historical inevitability of national independence during colonial times
Study the historical background and international impact of Pakistan obtaining nuclear weapons, master the formulation and implementation of nuclear policies
Analyze Bhutto's women's rights movement and populist policies, explore effective paths for promoting progress in authoritarian environments
Explore Bhutto's Islamic socialist policies, understand the role of ideology in politics
Summarize Bhutto's experiences and the challenges of promoting democracy and progress in authoritarian environments
PK-BHU-001.expected_zh: 掌握布托的领导艺术和政治动员能力，熟悉巴基斯坦核武器获得的历史背景，理解伊斯兰社会主义和妇女权利运动的重要性，分析布托的民粹主义政策，培养学生对专制环境下推动民主和进步的理解和认识。
PK-BHU-001.expected_en: Master Bhutto's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, be familiar with the historical background of Pakistan obtaining nuclear weapons, understand the significance of Islamic socialism and women's rights movements, analyze Bhutto's populist policies, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of promoting democracy and progress in authoritarian environments.
PK-BHU-001.case_zh: 1971年，布托领导巴基斯坦人民赢得独立，成为首任总理。他推行了伊斯兰社会主义和民粹动员，赢得了广泛支持。他领导巴基斯坦获得了核武器，但这也引发了地区紧张局势。他的妇女权利运动推动了进步，但也引发了社会争议。他于2007年遇刺身亡，他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
PK-BHU-001.case_en: In 1971, Bhutto led the Pakistani people to win independence and became the first Prime Minister. He implemented Islamic socialism and populist mobilization, winning widespread support. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons, which also triggered regional tensions. His women's rights movement promoted progress but also caused social controversy. He was assassinated in 2007, and his political legacy remains highly controversial today.
PK-BHU-001.cross_cultural_impact: Islamic socialist model, women's rights movement, nuclear proliferation in South Asia

PK-ZIA-001.name_zh: 齐亚：伊斯兰化/阿富汗圣战/军政/沙里亚法制/军情局/核计划
PK-ZIA-001.name_en: Zia-ul-Haq: Islamization/Afghan Jihad/Military-Government/Sharia Law/Military Intelligence/Nuclear Program
PK-ZIA-001.description_zh: 齐亚是巴基斯坦的长期领导人，1924-1988年，他领导巴基斯坦实施了全面的伊斯兰化改革，建立了军事政府，加强了国家安全。齐亚支持阿富汗圣战组织，输出了大量武器和资金，帮助阿富汗人民抵抗苏联占领。齐亚建立了强大的军事情报机构，控制了巴基斯坦的政治和经济。他领导巴基斯坦获得了核武器，成为核国家。
PK-ZIA-001.description_en: Zia-ul-Haq was a long-term Pakistani leader from 1924 to 1988, who led Pakistan to implement comprehensive Islamicization reforms and establish a military government, strengthening national security. Zia supported the Afghan Mujahideen, providing substantial weapons and funding to help the Afghan people resist Soviet occupation. Zia established a powerful military intelligence agency that controlled Pakistan's politics and economy. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons, becoming a nuclear state.
PK-ZIA-001.reason_zh: 齐亚领导巴基斯坦实施伊斯兰化改革，但他的军事独裁统治引发了国内反对。他支持阿富汗圣战，但这也引发了地区紧张局势。他的军事情报机构控制了政治，导致权力滥用。他的核计划引发了国际社会的担忧。他的统治结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-ZIA-001.reason_en: Zia led Pakistan to implement Islamicization reforms, but his military dictatorship sparked domestic opposition. He supported the Afghan Mujahideen but also triggered regional tensions. His military intelligence agency controlled politics, leading to power abuses. His nuclear program raised international concerns. After his rule ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习齐亚的领导艺术和军事策略，理解在冷战背景下国家安全的必要性
研究巴基斯坦伊斯兰化改革的历史背景和实施过程，掌握在专制环境下推行意识形态改革的方法
分析阿富汗圣战的历史背景和国际影响，掌握区域安全合作的复杂性
探讨齐亚的军事情报机构和权力控制，理解权力机构的风险
总结齐亚的经验教训，阐述在专制环境下推行改革的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Zia-ul-Haq's leadership art and military strategies, understand the necessity of national security during the Cold War
Study the historical background and implementation process of Pakistan's Islamicization reforms, master methods for implementing ideological reforms in authoritarian environments
Study the historical background and international impact of the Afghan Mujahideen, master the complexity of regional security cooperation
Explore Zia-ul-Haq's military intelligence agency and power control, understand the risks of power institutions
Summarize Zia-ul-Haq's experiences and the challenges of implementing reforms in authoritarian environments
PK-ZIA-001.expected_zh: 掌握齐亚的领导艺术和军事策略，熟悉巴基斯坦伊斯兰化改革的历史背景和实施过程，理解阿富汗圣战的复杂性，分析军事情报机构和权力控制的风险，培养学生对在专制环境下推行改革的理解和认识。
PK-ZIA-001.expected_en: Master Zia-ul-Haq's leadership art and military strategies, be familiar with the historical background and implementation process of Pakistan's Islamicization reforms, understand the complexity of the Afghan Mujahideen, analyze the risks of military intelligence agency and power control, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms in authoritarian environments.
PK-ZIA-001.case_zh: 1980年，齐亚领导巴基斯坦向阿富汗圣战组织提供武器和资金，支持其抵抗苏联占领。巴基斯坦还建立了强大的军事情报机构，控制了政治和经济。齐亚推行了全面的伊斯兰化改革，建立了军事政府。1988年，齐亚在飞机失事中遇害，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-ZIA-001.case_en: In 1980, Zia-ul-Haq led Pakistan to provide weapons and funding to the Afghan Mujahideen, supporting their resistance against Soviet occupation. Pakistan also established a powerful military intelligence agency that controlled politics and the economy. Zia-ul-Haq implemented comprehensive Islamicization reforms and established a military government. In 1988, Zia-ul-Haq was killed in a plane crash, and Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-ZIA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Afghan Mujahideen support, nuclear proliferation in South Asia, Islamic governance models

PK-MUS-001.name_zh: 穆沙拉夫：军政转型/反恐同盟/核扩散管控/卡吉尔/民主倒退
PK-MUS-001.name_en: Musharraf: Military-Political Transition/Anti-Terror Alliance/Nuclear Proliferation Control/Kargil/Democratic Regression
PK-MUS-001.description_zh: 穆沙拉夫是巴基斯坦的长期领导人，1944-2023年，他领导巴基斯坦从军事独裁走向民主转型，推行了反恐合作政策，与美国建立了紧密合作，共同打击恐怖主义。在卡吉尔地区，巴基斯坦和印度爆发了冲突，穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦进行了军事行动。穆沙拉夫推行了核扩散控制政策，但也引发了国际社会的担忧。他的统治结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-MUS-001.description_en: Musharraf was a long-term Pakistani leader from 1944 to 2023, who led Pakistan from military dictatorship to democratic transition, implementing anti-terrorist cooperation policies and establishing close cooperation with the United States to combat terrorism. In the Kargil region, Pakistan and India engaged in armed conflict, and Musharraf led Pakistan in military actions. Musharraf implemented nuclear proliferation control policies but also raised international concerns. After his rule ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-MUS-001.reason_zh: 穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦实现了从军事独裁到民主的过渡，但他的反恐政策引发了国内反对。他的军事行动导致地区紧张局势加剧。他的核政策引发了国际社会的担忧。他的统治结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-MUS-001.reason_en: Musharraf led Pakistan to achieve a transition from military dictatorship to democracy, but his anti-terrorist policies sparked domestic opposition. His military actions triggered regional tensions. His nuclear policies raised international concerns. After his rule ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习穆沙拉夫的领导艺术和外交策略，理解在冷战结束后国家安全的必要性
研究巴基斯坦的反恐政策和国际合作，掌握在全球反恐背景下的外交策略
分析卡吉尔冲突的历史背景和国际影响，掌握区域安全合作的复杂性
探讨穆沙拉夫的核扩散控制政策，理解在国际环境下推行核政策的挑战
总结穆沙拉夫的经验教训，阐述在专制环境下推行改革的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Musharraf's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, understand the necessity of national security after the Cold War
Study Pakistan's anti-terrorist policies and international cooperation, master diplomatic strategies in the global anti-terror context
Analyze the historical background and international impact of the Kargil conflict, master the complexity of regional security cooperation
Explore Musharraf's nuclear proliferation control policies, understand the challenges of implementing nuclear policies in the international context
Summarize Musharraf's experiences and the challenges of implementing reforms in authoritarian environments
PK-MUS-001.expected_zh: 掌握穆沙拉夫的领导艺术和外交策略，熟悉巴基斯坦的反恐政策和国际合作，理解卡吉尔冲突的复杂性，分析核扩散控制政策的风险，培养学生对在冷战结束后推行改革的理解和认识。
PK-MUS-001.expected_en: Master Musharraf's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with Pakistan's anti-terrorist policies and international cooperation, understand the complexity of the Kargil conflict, analyze the risks of nuclear proliferation control policies, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms after the Cold War.
PK-MUS-001.case_zh: 2001年，穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦与美国建立了紧密合作，共同打击恐怖主义。2001年至2005年，巴基斯坦在国内实施了反恐行动，但也引发了国内反对。2004年，巴基斯坦和印度在卡吉尔地区爆发了冲突，穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦进行了军事行动。2008年，穆沙拉夫在国内政治动荡中下台，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-MUS-001.case_en: In 2001, Musharraf led Pakistan to establish close cooperation with the United States to combat terrorism. From 2001 to 2005, Pakistan implemented anti-terrorist actions domestically but also sparked domestic opposition. In 2004, Pakistan and India engaged in armed conflict in the Kargil region, and Musharraf led Pakistan in military actions. In 2008, Musharraf was forced to step down in the face of domestic political turmoil, and Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-MUS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Anti-terrorist cooperation, nuclear proliferation control, military-led political transitions

PK-KHA-001.name_zh: 伊姆兰汗：体育名流入政/慈善国家/反腐民粹/不信任投票/军政博弈
PK-KHA-001.name_en: Imran Khan: Sports Star Turned Politician/Charity State/Anti-Corruption Populism/No-Confidence Vote/Military-Political Game
PK-KHA-001.description_zh: 伊姆兰汗是巴基斯坦的著名板球运动员，2007-2022年，他从体育明星转型为政治家，领导巴基斯坦实施了多项改革。他推行了反腐运动，赢得了广泛支持。他在2022年面临不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。他执政期间，巴基斯坦的体育和政治关系得到了加强。他领导巴基斯坦在国际事务中发挥了重要作用。
PK-KHA-001.description_en: Imran Khan was a famous Pakistani cricket player from 2007 to 2022, who transitioned from sports star to politician, leading Pakistan to implement multiple reforms. He implemented an anti-corruption movement and won widespread support. In 2022, he faced a no-confidence vote but successfully retained power. During his tenure, the relationship between sports and politics in Pakistan was strengthened. He led Pakistan to play an important role in international affairs.
PK-KHA-001.reason_zh: 伊姆兰汗从体育明星转型为政治家，但他的反腐运动引发了国内反对。他的执政期间，巴基斯坦的政治和经济关系得到了加强。他的领导艺术得到了广泛认可，但他的政治生涯充满争议。他的执政结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-KHA-001.reason_en: Imran Khan transitioned from sports star to politician but faced domestic opposition to his anti-corruption movement. During his tenure, the relationship between sports and politics in Pakistan was strengthened, and his leadership art was widely recognized. However, his political career was full of controversy. After his tenure ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习伊姆兰汗的领导艺术和政治动员能力，理解在现代社会中推动改革的必要性
研究巴基斯坦的反腐运动和政治改革，掌握在专制环境下推行改革的方法
分析伊姆兰汗的不信任投票和政治生存能力，掌握政治风险管理
探讨伊姆兰汗的体育明星转型，理解体育和政治关系的复杂性
总结伊姆兰汗的经验教训，阐述在现代社会中推行改革的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Imran Khan's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, understand the necessity of promoting reforms in modern society
Study Pakistan's anti-corruption movement and political reforms, master methods for推行改革 in authoritarian environments
Analyze Imran Khan's no-confidence vote and political survival abilities, master political risk management
Explore Imran Khan's sports star transition, understand the complexity of sports and political relationships
Summarize Imran Khan's experiences and the challenges of implementing reforms in modern society
PK-KHA-001.expected_zh: 掌握伊姆兰汗的领导艺术和政治动员能力，熟悉巴基斯坦的反腐运动和政治改革，理解政治生存和风险管理，分析体育明星转型和政治关系，培养学生对在现代社会中推行改革的理解和认识。
PK-KHA-001.expected_en: Master Imran Khan's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, be familiar with Pakistan's anti-corruption movement and political reforms, understand political survival and risk management, analyze sports star transition and political relationships, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms in modern society.
PK-KHA-001.case_zh: 2022年，伊姆兰汗领导巴基斯坦实施了反腐运动，赢得了广泛支持。他在2022年面临不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。他的领导艺术得到了广泛认可，但他的政治生涯充满争议。他的执政结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-KHA-001.case_en: In 2022, Imran Khan led Pakistan to implement an anti-corruption movement and win widespread support. He faced a no-confidence vote in 2022 but successfully retained power. His leadership art was widely recognized, but his political career was full of controversy. After his tenure ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-KHA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Anti-corruption movement, sports star turned politician, Pakistani political transformation

BD-RAH-001.name_zh: 拉赫曼：语言民族主义/世俗建国/解放战争/谢赫精神/孟加拉身份
BD-RAH-001.name_en: Rahman: Language Nationalism/Secular Nation-Building/Liberation War/Sheikh Spirit/Bangladeshi Identity
BD-RAH-001.description_zh: 拉赫曼是孟加拉国的国父，1903-1975年，他领导孟加拉国人民争取独立。拉赫曼推动了语言民族主义运动，领导了孟加拉语解放运动。拉赫曼推动了世俗建国，领导了孟加拉国解放战争，建立了独立国家。他倡导谢赫精神，强调文明多样性和宗教和谐。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想为孟加拉国独立和现代化奠定了基础。
BD-RAH-001.description_en: Rahman was the father of Bangladesh from 1903 to 1975, who led the Bangladeshi people to fight for independence. Rahman promoted language nationalism and led the Bengali language liberation movement. Rahman promoted secular nation-building and led the Bangladesh Liberation War, establishing an independent country. He advocated Sheikh spirit and emphasized civilizational diversity and religious harmony. His leadership art and nationalist thought laid the foundation for Bangladesh's independence and modernization.
BD-RAH-001.reason_zh: 拉赫曼领导孟加拉国人民赢得独立，建立了独立国家，推动了语言民族主义和世俗建国。他的谢赫精神倡导文明多样性和宗教和谐，但他的领导艺术和民族主义思想也引发了宗教冲突。他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
BD-RAH-001.reason_en: Rahman led the Bangladeshi people to win independence and establish an independent country, promoting language nationalism and secular nation-building. His Sheikh spirit advocated civilizational diversity and religious harmony, but his leadership art and nationalist thought also sparked religious conflicts. His political legacy remains highly controversial today.
steps_zh: 学习拉赫曼的领导艺术和民族主义思想，理解在殖民时代国家建国的历史必然性
研究孟加拉语解放运动的历史背景和过程，掌握语言民族主义的外交策略
分析孟加拉国解放战争的背景和过程，掌握在殖民时代国家建国的外交策略
探讨拉赫曼的谢赫精神和文明多样性，理解在多宗教环境下推行和谐的必要性
总结拉赫曼的经验教训，阐述在殖民时代国家建国的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Rahman’s leadership art and nationalist thought, understand the historical inevitability of national independence during colonial times
Study the historical background and process of the Bengali language liberation movement, master diplomatic strategies for language nationalism
Study the background and process of the Bangladesh Liberation War, master diplomatic strategies for national independence during colonial times
Explore Rahman’s Sheikh spirit and civilizational diversity, understand the necessity of promoting harmony in multi-religious environments
Summarize Rahman’s experiences and the challenges of national independence during colonial times
BD-RAH-001.expected_zh: 掌握拉赫曼的领导艺术和民族主义思想，熟悉孟加拉语解放运动和孟加拉国解放战争的历史背景，理解谢赫精神和文明多样性的重要性，培养学生对在殖民时代国家建国的理解和认识。
BD-RAH-001.expected_en: Master Rahman’s leadership art and nationalist thought, be familiar with the historical background of the Bengali language liberation movement and Bangladesh Liberation War, understand the importance of Sheikh spirit and civilizational diversity, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of national independence during colonial times.
BD-RAH-001.case_zh: 1952年，拉赫曼领导孟加拉人民开展了语言革命，要求使用孟加拉语进行官方文件和教育。1956年，拉赫曼领导孟加拉国人民赢得独立，建立了孟加拉国。他倡导谢赫精神，强调文明多样性和宗教和谐。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想为孟加拉国独立和现代化奠定了基础。
BD-RAH-001.case_en: In 1952, Rahman led the Bengali people to launch the language revolution, demanding the use of Bengali for official documents and education. In 1956, Rahman led the Bangladeshi people to win independence and establish Bangladesh. He advocated Sheikh spirit and emphasized civilizational diversity and religious harmony. His leadership art and nationalist thought laid the foundation for Bangladesh's independence and modernization.
BD-RAH-001.cross_cultural_impact: Language nationalism movement, liberation war model, civilizational diversity advocacy

BD-YUN-001.name_zh: 尤努斯：微金融赋能/女性经济/社会企业/诺贝尔/格莱珉模式
BD-YUN-001.name_en: Yunus: Financial Inclusion/Women's Economic Empowerment/Social Business/Nobel/Pioneer Banking
BD-YUN-001.description_zh: 尤努斯是孟加拉国的银行家和企业家，1940-至今，他领导孟加拉国建立了格莱珉银行，推行了微金融服务，赋能了广大妇女。他推行了社会企业模式，倡导企业在追求利润的同时承担社会责任。尤努斯赢得了诺贝尔和平奖，他的微金融理念被世界广泛认可。他的领导艺术和创新思维为孟加拉国的经济发展和妇女赋权做出了重要贡献。
BD-YUN-001.description_en: Yunus is a Bangladeshi banker and entrepreneur from 1940 to the present, who led Bangladesh to establish Grameen Bank and implement microfinance services, empowering a large number of women. He implemented a social business model, advocating that businesses should pursue profits while assuming social responsibilities. Yunus won the Nobel Peace Prize, and his microfinance concept is widely recognized worldwide. His leadership art and innovative thinking have made significant contributions to Bangladesh's economic development and women's empowerment.
BD-YUN-001.reason_zh: 尤努斯推行了微金融和妇女赋权，但他的创新银行模式引发了国际社会的争议。他的社会企业模式虽然得到了广泛认可，但其可持续性仍受到质疑。他的诺贝尔奖获奖为孟加拉国赢得了国际声誉，但也引发了国内争议。他的领导艺术和创新思维为孟加拉国的经济发展做出了重要贡献。
BD-YUN-001.reason_en: Yunus implemented microfinance and women's empowerment, but his innovative banking model sparked international controversy. His social business model, while widely recognized, faces sustainability challenges. His Nobel Prize win brought international acclaim to Bangladesh but also sparked domestic debate. His leadership art and innovative thinking have significantly contributed to Bangladesh's economic development.

研究格莱珉银行的建立和微金融服务，掌握在贫困地区推行金融服务的创新方法
分析尤努斯的社会企业模式和妇女赋权，掌握在商业中推行社会责任的必要性
探讨尤努斯的诺贝尔奖获奖和国际影响，理解在国际环境下推行创新方案的风险
总结尤努斯的经验教训，阐述在发展中国家推行创新金融方案的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Yunus’s leadership art and innovative thinking, understand the necessity of推行微金融 in developing countries
Study the establishment of Grameen Bank and microfinance services, master innovative methods for推行金融服务 in impoverished areas
Analyze Yunus’s social business model and women’s empowerment, master the necessity of推行 social responsibility in business
Explore Yunus’s Nobel Prize win and international impact, understand the risks of推行 innovative solutions in the international context

BD-YUN-001.expected_zh: 掌握尤努斯的领导艺术和创新思维，熟悉格莱珉银行和微金融服务，理解社会企业模式和妇女赋权的重要性，分析诺贝尔奖获奖和国际影响，培养学生对在发展中国家推行创新金融方案的理解和认识。
BD-YUN-001.expected_en: Master Yunus’s leadership art and innovative thinking, be familiar with Grameen Bank and microfinance services, understand the significance of social business model and women’s empowerment, analyze Nobel Prize win and international impact, cultivate students’ understanding and awareness of推行 innovative financial solutions in developing countries.
BD-YUN-001.case_zh: 1983年，尤努斯创立了格莱珉银行，推行了微金融服务，赋能了孟加拉国广大妇女。尤努斯的微金融理念被世界广泛认可，赢得了诺贝尔和平奖。他的社会企业模式得到了广泛认可，推动了孟加拉国的经济发展和妇女赋权。他的领导艺术和创新思维为孟加拉国的经济发展和妇女赋权做出了重要贡献。
BD-YUN-001.case_en: In 1983, Yunus established Grameen Bank and implemented microfinance services, empowering a large number of Bangladeshi women. Yunus’s microfinance concept is widely recognized globally and he won the Nobel Peace Prize. His social business model gained widespread recognition and promoted economic development and women’s empowerment in Bangladesh. His leadership art and innovative thinking have made significant contributions to Bangladesh’s economic development and women’s empowerment.

BD-HAS-001.name_zh: 哈西娜：数字孟加拉/气候脆弱/罗兴亚难民/强人政治/女性领袖
BD-HAS-001.name_en: Hasina: Digital Bangladesh/Climate Vulnerability/Rohingya Refugees/Strongman Politics/Female Leader
BD-HAS-001.description_zh: 哈西娜是孟加拉国的长期领导人，1947-至今。她领导孟加拉国实施了多项改革，包括数字孟加拉计划，推动了孟加拉国的数字化转型。哈西娜在执政期间面临了气候变化带来的挑战，包括海平面上升和极端天气事件。2017年，发生了罗兴亚难民危机，约100万罗兴亚难民逃到了孟加拉国。哈西娜在执政期间被称为"强人政治"，但她也推动了女性赋权和民主制度。
BD-HAS-001.description_en: Hasina is a long-term Bangladeshi leader from 1947 to the present. She led Bangladesh to implement multiple reforms, including the Digital Bangladesh Plan, promoting the country's digital transformation. Hasina faced challenges from climate change during her tenure, including sea level rise and extreme weather events. In 2017, a Rohingya refugee crisis occurred, with approximately 1 million Rohingya refugees fleeing to Bangladesh. Hasina has been referred to as a "strongwoman" during her tenure, but she also promoted women's empowerment and democratic systems.
BD-HAS-001.reason_zh: 哈西娜领导孟加拉国实施了多项改革，但她的强人政治引发了国内反对。2017年罗兴亚难民危机引发了国际社会的关注。气候变化带来的挑战也威胁着孟加拉国的稳定。她的执政结束了，孟加拉国陷入了政治动荡。
BD-HAS-001.reason_en: Hasina led Bangladesh to implement multiple reforms, but her strongwoman politics sparked domestic opposition. The 2017 Rohingya refugee crisis drew international attention. Climate change challenges also threatened Bangladesh's stability. After her tenure ended, Bangladesh descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习哈西娜的领导艺术和改革思维，理解在发展中国家推动数字转型的必要性
研究孟加拉国的气候变化挑战和应对措施，掌握在发展中国家应对气候变化的方法
分析罗兴亚难民危机的历史背景和国际影响，掌握在难民危机中的外交策略
探讨哈西娜的强人政治和女性赋权，理解在专制环境下推行改革的必要性
总结哈西娜的经验教训，阐述在发展中国家推行改革的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Hasina's leadership art and reform thinking, understand the necessity of promoting digital transformation in developing countries
Study Bangladesh's climate change challenges and response measures, master methods for addressing climate change in developing countries
Analyze the historical background and international impact of the Rohingya refugee crisis, master diplomatic strategies in refugee crises
Explore Hasina's strongwoman politics and women's empowerment, understand the necessity of implementing reforms in authoritarian environments
Summarize Hasina's experiences and the challenges of implementing reforms in developing countries
BD-HAS-001.expected_zh: 掌握哈西娜的领导艺术和改革思维，熟悉孟加拉国的气候变化挑战和应对措施，了解罗兴亚难民危机的影响，分析强人政治和女性赋权，培养学生对在发展中国家推行改革的理解和认识。
BD-HAS-001.expected_en: Master Hasina's leadership art and reform thinking, be familiar with Bangladesh's climate change challenges and response measures, understand the impact of the Rohingya refugee crisis, analyze strongwoman politics and women's empowerment, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms in developing countries.
BD-HAS-001.case_zh: 2017年，发生了罗兴亚难民危机，约100万罗兴亚难民逃到了孟加拉国。哈西娜领导孟加拉国实施了多项改革，包括数字孟加拉计划，推动了孟加拉国的数字化转型。2019年，哈西娜面临了不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。2024年，哈西娜在政治动荡中下台，孟加拉国陷入了政治动荡。
BD-HAS-001.case_en: In 2017, a Rohingya refugee crisis occurred, with approximately 1 million Rohingya refugees fleeing to Bangladesh. Hasina led Bangladesh to implement multiple reforms, including the Digital Bangladesh Plan, promoting the country's digital transformation. In 2019, Hasina faced a no-confidence vote but successfully retained power. In 2024, Hasina stepped down in the face of political turmoil, and Bangladesh descended into political turmoil.
BD-HAS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Digital transformation model, climate change response, refugee crisis management

AF-KAR-001.name_zh: 卡尔扎伊：阿富汗建国/部落联邦/美国盟友/选举政治/塔利班回归
AF-KAR-001.name_en: Karzai: Afghanistan Independence/Tribal Federation/American Ally/Electoral Politics/Taliban Return
AF-KAR-001.description_zh: 卡尔扎伊是阿富汗的长期领导人，1960-至今，他领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。卡尔扎伊推行了部落联邦制，尊重了阿富汗的部落传统。卡尔扎伊与美国建立了密切的同盟关系，但这也引发了国内争议。卡尔扎伊推行了选举政治，但这也引发了国内政治动荡。他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
AF-KAR-001.description_en: Karzai was a long-term Afghan leader from 1960 to the present, who led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. Karzai implemented tribal federation systems, respecting Afghanistan's traditional tribal structures. Karzai established close alliances with the United States but this also sparked domestic controversy. Karzai implemented electoral politics but this also sparked domestic political turmoil. After his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
AF-KAR-001.reason_zh: 卡尔扎伊领导阿富汗赢得独立，但他的美国盟友政策引发了国内争议。他的选举政治导致国内政治动荡。他的部落联邦制虽然尊重了传统，但也引发了争议。他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
AF-KAR-001.reason_en: Karzai led Afghanistan to win independence but his American alliance policy sparked domestic controversy. His electoral politics led to domestic political turmoil. His tribal federation system, while respecting tradition, also sparked controversy. After his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
steps_zh: 学习卡尔扎伊的领导艺术和外交策略，理解在独立后国家建设的必要性
研究阿富汗的部落联邦制和民族融合，掌握在多元文化环境下推行和谐的必要性
分析卡尔扎伊与美国的同盟关系，理解在国际环境下推行改革的必要性
探讨卡尔扎伊的选举政治和民主制度，理解在传统社会中推行现代化的挑战
总结卡尔扎伊的经验教训，阐述在独立后国家建设的风险和挑战

Study Afghanistan's tribal federation system and ethnic integration, master the necessity of promoting harmony in multicultural environments
Analyze Karzai's alliance with the United States, understand the necessity of推行改革 in the international context

AF-KAR-001.expected_zh: 掌握卡尔扎伊的领导艺术和外交策略，熟悉阿富汗的部落联邦制和民族融合，理解与美国的同盟关系和选举政治的重要性，培养学生对在独立后国家建设的理解和认识。
AF-KAR-001.expected_en: Master Karzai's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with Afghanistan's tribal federation system and ethnic integration, understand the significance of the alliance with the United States and electoral politics, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of推行国家建设 in post-independence contexts.
AF-KAR-001.case_zh: 2001年，卡尔扎伊领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。他推行了部落联邦制，尊重了阿富汗的部落传统。卡尔扎伊与美国建立了密切的同盟关系，但这也引发了国内争议。卡尔扎伊推行了选举政治，但这也引发了国内政治动荡。2009年，卡尔扎伊在政治动荡中下台，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
AF-KAR-001.case_en: In 2001, Karzai led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. He implemented a tribal federation system, respecting Afghanistan's traditional tribal structures. Karzai established close alliances with the United States but this also sparked domestic controversy. Karzai implemented electoral politics but this also sparked domestic political turmoil. In 2009, Karzai stepped down in the face of political turmoil, and Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
AF-KAR-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tribal federation model, American alliance, post-9/11 Afghanistan reconstruction

ES-CHA-001.description_en: Charles V became Holy Roman Emperor in 1519, presiding over an empire where the sun never set. His reign saw the Protestant Reformation, the Diet of Augsburg in 1555 which granted limited rights to Protestants, and the beginning of Spain's dominance as the world's first superpower.

ES-FER-001.name_en: 费尔南多/西班牙/伊莎贝拉/统一/宗教裁判/哥伦布/大航海
ES-FER-001.description_zh: 西班牙统一/宗教裁判/新世界发现/美洲殖民/大航海时代/天主教王后
ES-FER-001.description_en: Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile unified Spain through marriage in 1469, establishing the Spanish Empire. Their joint reign oversaw the completion of the Reconquista in 1492, expulsion of Jews and Muslims, funding of Columbus' voyages, and the beginning of Spanish colonization in the Americas. This created the foundation for Spain's golden age and global empire.

KE-KEN-001.description_zh: 乔莫·肯雅塔（1889-1978），肯尼亚第一任总理，1963-1978年在任。他是一位肯尼亚部落领袖和政治家，领导肯尼亚独立，从英国殖民统治中解放出来，建立了肯尼亚共和国。他推动了土地分配改革，支持部落政治，奠定了肯尼亚独立的基础。
KE-KEN-001.description_en: Jomo Kenyatta (1889-1978), first Prime Minister of Kenya, served from 1963 to 1978. He was a Kenyan tribal leader and politician who led Kenya to independence from British colonial rule, establishing the Republic of Kenya. He promoted land redistribution reforms and supported tribal politics, laying the foundation for Kenyan independence.
KE-KEN-001.reason_zh: 肯雅塔是肯尼亚独立运动的领导者，通过部落政治和土地改革，建立了肯尼亚国家。他体现了非洲领导者的智慧，通过和平过渡和部落团结实现了国家的独立和统一。
KE-KEN-001.reason_en: Kenyatta was the leader of Kenya's independence movement, establishing the nation through tribal politics and land reforms. He exemplified African leadership wisdom, achieving national independence and unity through peaceful transition and tribal solidarity.

KE-MOI-001.description_en: Daniel Moi (1924-present), former President of Kenya, served from 1978 to 2002. He was a Kenyan politician and former teacher, became Prime Minister in 1964, succeeded Kenyatta in 1978, continued Kenyatta's policies. He established the Kenya African National Union as a one-party state, ruling Kenya for decades. His rule saw economic growth and political stability, but also power succession issues.

TZ-NYE-001.description_zh: 朱利叶斯·尼雷尔（1910-1999），坦桑尼亚前总统，乌贾马政治哲学的倡导者，从1961年到1985年担任总统。他是一位教育工作者和政治家，领导坦桑尼亚获得独立并实施乌贾马政策，强调非洲社会主义、自给自足和道德主义。通过推动坦桑尼亚的独立和实施非洲发展模式，他为坦桑尼亚的民族建设和非洲发展做出了重要贡献。
TZ-NYE-001.description_en: Julius Nyerere (1910-1999), former President of Tanzania, advocated Ujamaa political philosophy. He served as president from 1961 to 1985. An educator and politician, he led Tanzania to independence and implemented Ujamaa policies, emphasizing African socialism, self-reliance, and moralism. Through promoting Tanzania's independence and implementing African development models, he made significant contributions to Tanzania's nation-building and African development.
TZ-NYE-001.reason_zh: 尼雷尔是坦桑尼亚乌贾马政治哲学的奠基人，倡导非洲社会主义、自给自足和道德主义，对坦桑尼亚独立和国家建设做出了重要贡献。他的乌贾马思想成为非洲发展理论的重要组成部分，对非洲政治和经济发展产生了深远影响。
TZ-NYE-001.reason_en: Nyerere was the founder of Ujamaa political philosophy in Tanzania, advocating African socialism, self-reliance, and moralism. He made significant contributions to Tanzania's independence and national construction. His Ujamaa ideology became a significant component of African development theory and had profound impact on African politics and economic development.

TZ-MKP-001.core_mode: M573 改革私有化/区域一体化/私有化/东非共同体

TZ-MKP-001.description_zh:
本杰明·姆卡帕 (1938-2020) 坦桑尼亚第4任总统 (1995-2005)，推动了坦桑尼亚经济私有化改革和东非共同体的建立，倡导区域一体化，强调市场导向经济政策。

姆卡帕总统在任期间，坦桑尼亚经济从国有制转向私有化，吸引了外国投资，启动了重大基础设施项目。他是《东非共同体条约》的主要推动者，于1999年推动建立了当前的三方东非共同体（坦桑尼亚、肯尼亚、乌干达）。他强调坦桑尼亚应成为东非地区的经济强国。

姆卡帕倡导坦桑尼亚经济多样化，发展制造业和服务业，同时保持农业在经济中的重要地位。他还推动了教育和医疗保健领域的改革，提高了国民生活水平。

他的政策被认为是坦桑尼亚经济转型的重要推动因素，为坦桑尼亚经济的进一步发展奠定了基础。
TZ-MKP-001.description_en:
Benjamin Mkapa (1938-2020) Tanzania's 4th President (1995-2005), who implemented economic privatization reforms and established the East African Community, promoting regional integration and market-oriented economic policies.

During Mkapa's presidency, Tanzania's economy transitioned from state ownership to privatization, attracting foreign investment and launching major infrastructure projects. He was the key driver behind the East African Community Treaty, establishing the current tripartite EAC (Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda) in 1999. He emphasized that Tanzania should become an economic powerhouse in East Africa.

Mkapa promoted economic diversification in Tanzania, developing manufacturing and service industries while maintaining agriculture's importance in the economy. He also drove reforms in education and healthcare, improving national living standards.

His policies are considered a key driver of Tanzania's economic transformation, laying the foundation for further economic development.
TZ-MKP-001.reason_zh: 姆卡帕总统领导下的坦桑尼亚经济改革实现了从社会主义计划经济的向市场经济的转型，东非共同体的建立增强了地区一体化，展示了发展中国家成功实施经济改革和区域合作的范例。
TZ-MKP-001.reason_en: Under President Mkapa, Tanzania's economic reforms achieved a successful transition from socialist planned economy to market economy, and the establishment of the East African Community enhanced regional integration, showcasing a model for developing countries' economic reform and regional cooperation.

UG-OBO-001.name_zh: 奥博特/乌干达/独裁/阿敏/战争/米尔顿/阿波罗/穆塞韦尼
UG-OBO-001.core_mode: M574 后殖民独裁循环/阿敏/长期战争/米尔顿统治
UG-OBO-001.intellectual_tradition: 后殖民政治/独裁主义/非洲民族主义/东非政治/帝国主义遗产
UG-OBO-001.description_zh: 米尔顿·阿波罗·奥博特（1925-2013），乌干达政治家，1962年-1966年和1980-1985年担任乌干达总理。他领导乌干达独立，建立了一党制乌干达人民议会党，倡导泛非主义和非洲社会主义。后因阿明独裁政权被推翻，1980年重新执政，但长期的独裁循环和与伊迪·阿明的战争导致乌干达持续动荡。
UG-OBO-001.description_en: Milton Apollo Obote (1925-2013), Ugandan politician, served as Prime Minister of Uganda from 1962 to 1966 and from 1980 to 1985. He led Uganda's independence, established the one-party Uganda Peoples Congress, advocated Pan-Africanism and African socialism. Later due to Idi Amin's dictatorship, he was overthrown, returned to power in 1980, but the long-term dictatorship cycle and war with Idi Amin caused continued turmoil in Uganda.
UG-OBO-001.reason_zh: 奥博特是乌干达独立和建国的重要领导人，但长期的独裁统治和与阿明政权的战争，体现了东非国家后殖民时期的独裁循环和政治动荡。他的统治反映了帝国主义遗产和非洲民族主义的复杂性。
UG-OBO-001.reason_en: Obote was an important leader of Uganda's independence and nation-building, but long-term dictatorship and war with Idi Amin's regime reflected the dictatorship cycle and political turmoil in post-colonial East Africa. His rule reflected the complexity of imperialist legacy and African nationalism.

UG-OBO-001.expected_en: Establishing Uganda's independence and one-party political system, but long-term dictatorship and war reflected the political turmoil and complexity of imperialist legacy in post-colonial period.

UG-MUS-001.description_zh: 伊迪·阿明（1941-至今），乌干达前总统，1971-1979年在位。他曾是一名逃兵，后通过政变上台，建立极权独裁政权，以残暴和反犹太主义闻名。长期统治期间，乌干达经济崩溃，人权状况极度恶化。1990年后转为民主政治，但早期独裁统治对乌干达造成了深远影响。
UG-MUS-001.description_en: Idi Amin (1941-present), former President of Uganda, ruled from 1971 to 1979. He was a former soldier who staged a coup d'état and established a repressive dictatorship. Known for brutality and anti-Semitism, his 8-year rule saw the collapse of Uganda's economy and severe human rights abuses. Though Uganda returned to democracy after 1990, his early dictatorship left deep scars on the nation.
UG-MUS-001.reason_zh: 阿明是乌干达历史上最残暴的独裁者之一，其统治体现了后殖民时期的政治腐败和军事政权的极端性。他长期执政，造成了巨大的人道主义灾难，对东非政治产生了深远影响。
UG-MUS-001.reason_en: Amin was one of Uganda's most brutal dictators, his rule embodied the extreme nature of post-colonial political corruption and military regimes. His long-term dictatorship caused huge humanitarian disasters and had profound impact on East African politics.

RW-KAG-001.name_zh: 卡加梅/卢旺达/种族灭绝/重建/强人/奇迹/保罗/卡加梅
RW-KAG-001.core_mode: M576 种族灭绝重建/强人发展/奇迹叙事/保罗模式/卢旺达奇迹
RW-KAG-001.intellectual_tradition: 军事领导/国家重建/发展经济学/安全主义/种族和解/技术主导发展
RW-KAG-001.description_zh: 保罗·卡加梅（1957-至今），卢旺达总统，1994年至今在位。他是一位退休的卢旺达空军少校，在1994年胡图族图西族冲突后接管政府，实施了大胆的国家重建和经济发展政策。成功实现快速经济发展，被称为'非洲奇迹'的领导者。
RW-KAG-001.description_en: Paul Kagame (1957-present), President of Rwanda, has been in power since 1994. A retired Rwandan Air Force officer, he took over after the 1994 Hutu-Tutsi conflict and implemented bold national reconstruction and economic development policies. Successfully achieved rapid economic development, he is regarded as a leader of the 'African Miracle'.
RW-KAG-001.reason_zh: 卡加梅是卢旺达国家重建的领导者，通过安全主义和技术主导发展实现了‘非洲奇迹’。他在后种族灭绝时期成功重建国家，成为东非最成功的执政者之一。他的发展模式体现了强人领导的效率和安全与发展的平衡。
RW-KAG-001.reason_en: Kagame was the leader of Rwanda's national reconstruction, achieving the 'African Miracle' through securityism and technology-dominated development. He successfully rebuilt the nation in the post-genocide period and is one of East Africa's most successful rulers. His development model reflected the efficiency of strongman leadership and the balance between security and development.

BI-NKU-001.description_zh: 皮埃尔·恩库伦齐扎（1964-2020），布隆迪政治家，2005-2020年担任布隆迪总统。他是一位牧师出身的政治家，通过体育和跑步被誉为'跑步总统'。在任期间，布隆迪结束了长期的内战，实现了政治稳定，但第三任任期引发争议。
BI-NKU-001.description_en: Pierre Nkurunziza (1964-2020), Burundian politician, served as President of Burundi from 2005 to 2020. A pastor-turned-politician, he was known as 'President of the Running' due to his passion for sports and running. During his tenure, Burundi ended long-term civil war and achieved political stability, but his third-term candidacy sparked controversy.
BI-NKU-001.reason_zh: 恩库伦齐扎是布隆迪结束内战的领导者，通过宗教政治和体育外交实现了国家统一。他的'跑步总统'形象成为和平外交的象征，但第三任任期引发了政治争议。
BI-NKU-001.reason_en: Nkurunziza was the leader who ended Burundi's civil war, achieving national unity through religious politics and sports diplomacy. His 'running president' image became a symbol of peaceful diplomacy, but his third-term candidacy sparked political controversy.

MW-BAN-001.description_zh: 乔伊斯·班达 (1956-) 马拉维第3任总统 (2012-2014)，马拉维首位女总统，领导了马拉维的民主转型和政治改革，她推翻了前总统贝斯特的独裁统治，建立了议会民主制度，恢复了人权和新闻自由。
MW-BAN-001.description_en: Joyce Banda (1956-) Malawi's 3rd President (2012-2014), the first female president in Malawi, led Malawi's democratic transition and political reforms, overthrowing President Bingu wa Mutharika's dictatorship and establishing parliamentary democracy, restoring human rights and press freedom.
MW-BAN-001.reason_zh: 班达总统领导的民主转型展示了女性领导如何推动制度变革，推翻独裁，建立民主，恢复人权和媒体自由。她的经验表明，女性领导可以成为反独裁和民主改革的重要推动者。
MW-BAN-001.reason_en: President Banda's democratic transition demonstrates how female leadership can drive institutional change, overthrow dictatorship, establish democracy, restore human rights and media freedom. Her experience shows that female leaders can be key drivers of anti-dictatorship and democratic reform.

ZM-KAU-001.description_zh: 肯尼斯·卡翁达 (1924-) 赞比亚首任总统 (1964-1991)，领导了赞比亚的独立运动和建国，倡导非暴力抵抗和平等政治，重视铜矿资源开发和经济建设。

ZM-KAU-001.reason_zh: 卡翁达总统领导的赞比亚独立运动展示了非殖民地化国家建设模式，通过铜经济驱动发展，通过一党制实现政治稳定，通过非洲团结实现国际地位。
ZM-KAU-001.reason_en: President Kaunda's Zambian independence movement showcases a model for newly decolonized nations, using copper economy to drive development, implementing one-party rule for political stability, and achieving international status through African unity.

IL-MEI-001.name_zh: 梅尔/以色列/铁娘子/战争/定居点/诺贝尔/安萨尔/耶路撒冷
IL-MEI-001.description_zh: 戈德哈玛·梅尔 (1898-1995) 是以色列著名的女政治家和总理，享有"铁娘子"的称号。她领导以色列进行一系列战争，包括独立战争和六日战争等，推行定居点政策，加强以色列国防力量，赢得诺贝尔和平奖，并推动安沙尔计划等。
IL-MEI-001.description_en: Golda Meir (1898-1995) was a famous female politician and Prime Minister of Israel, known as the "Iron Lady". She led Israel in a series of wars including independence war and six-day war, implemented settlement policy, strengthened Israel's defense capabilities, won the Nobel Peace Prize, and promoted Anchar program etc.
IL-MEI-001.reason_zh: 核心思维：M535(铁娘子/战争领袖/定居点/诺贝尔/梅尔主义)、1(战略预判)、67(战略敏捷)、37(知行合一)、153(儒商传承/民族建设)。梅尔体现了战略预判和知行合一的精神，通过战争领袖身份实现国家建设，通过定居点政策加强国防力量，通过诺贝尔奖提升国际地位，通过安沙尔计划实现民族复兴。
IL-MEI-001.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M535(Iron Lady/War Leader/Settlements/Nobel/Meirism)、1(Strategic Foresight)、67(Strategic Agility)、37(Know-Act Integration)、153(Ju-Shang Inheritance/Nation Building)。Meir embodies strategic foresight and know-act integration spirit through war leader identity achieving national construction, settlement policy strengthening defense capabilities, Nobel Prize enhancing international status, Anchar program realizing national revival.
steps_zh: 第1步：战略预判法——制定战争大计：制定独立战争和六日战争计划
第2步：战略敏捷法——灵活战争：通过战争行动实现国家建设
第3步：知行合一——实施战争战略：通过政治努力和战争实践实现国家建设
第4步：儒商传承——民族建设：继承民族智慧，建设现代国家
第5步：长期主义——维护国家：确保以色列的长期发展和安全
steps_en: Step 1: Strategic Foresight - Formulate war plan: Formulate independence war and six-day war plan
Step 2: Strategic Agility - Flexible war: Achieve national construction through war actions
Step 3: Know-Act Integration - Implement war strategy: Realize national construction through political efforts and war practice
Step 4: Ju-Shang Inheritance - National construction: Inherit national wisdom, build modern nation
Step 5: Long-termism - Maintain nation: Ensure Israel's long-term development and security
expected_zh: 推动以色列的独立和生存
提升以色列的国际地位

IL-RAB-001.name_zh: 拉宾/以色列/奥斯陆/诺贝尔/和平/遇刺/辛贝特/佩雷斯
IL-RAB-001.description_zh: 伊扎克·拉宾 (1922-1995) 是以色列政治家，曾任总理。他领导以色列与巴勒斯坦权力机构签署奥斯陆协议，推动和平进程，赢得诺贝尔和平奖，但后来遇刺身亡。他的安全机构辛贝特在以色列安全中发挥重要作用，与佩雷斯等政治家合作。
IL-RAB-001.description_en: Yitzhak Rabin (1922-1995) was an Israeli politician who served as Prime Minister. He led Israel in signing the Oslo Accords with the Palestinian Authority, promoting peace process, winning the Nobel Peace Prize, but was later assassinated. His security agency Shin Bet played an important role in Israel security, cooperating with politicians like Peres.
IL-RAB-001.reason_zh: 核心思维：M536(奥斯陆协议/和平进程/遇刺/辛贝特/拉宾遗产)、1(战略预判)、20(博弈论)、40(三衙分兵/军政分离)、67(战略敏捷)。拉宾体现了战略预判和博弈论精神，通过奥斯陆协议实现和平进程，通过遇刺和安全机构建设确保国家安全，通过三衙分兵实现军政分离。
IL-RAB-001.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M536(Oslo Agreement/Pacific Process/Assassination/Shin Bet/Rabin Heritage)、1(Strategic Foresight)、20(Game Theory)、40(Three-gate Separation/Military-Civilian Separation)、67(Strategic Agility)。Rabin embodies strategic foresight and game theory spirit through Oslo Agreement realizing peace process, assassination and security agency construction ensuring national security, Three-gate Separation achieving military-civilian separation.

TR-ERD-001.name_zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安
TR-ERD-001.core_mode: M540 新奥斯曼主义/正义发展党治理/司法改革/媒体控制/叙利亚干预/经济发展
TR-ERD-001.intellectual_tradition: 新奥斯曼主义/伊斯兰保守民主/经济发展实用主义/强人政治
TR-ERD-001.description_zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安 (1954年2月26日— ) 是土耳其政治人物，2003年至2014年担任总理，2014年起担任总统。他创立了正义与发展党 (AKP)，执政土耳其超过二十年，是中东地区在位最久的国家领导人之一。其政治核心包括：新奥斯曼主义外交——将土耳其影响力从巴尔干、中东延伸至北非和中亚，通过利比亚干预、叙利亚军事行动和东地中海油气勘探重塑地区秩序；伊斯兰保守民主——打破凯末尔主义世俗精英体制，放松头巾禁令，推动宗教自由；司法改革与总统制转型——2017年公投通过行政体制改革，取消总理职位，建立强总统制；媒体控制——2016年未遂政变后大规模清洗并接管反对派媒体，将土耳其媒体集中度推至欧洲最高水平；叙利亚政策——支持叙利亚反对派、打击库尔德武装、在利比亚和纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫介入冲突；经济发展——执政初期通过新自由主义改革实现年均8%增长，基础设施大规模建设（机场、桥梁、隧道），但后期遭遇里拉危机和高通胀。2016年未遂政变后，其权力进一步集中，通过紧急状态清洗数十万公务员和军人。2023年在大选第二轮险胜，连任至第五个总统任期。
TR-ERD-001.description_en: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (born February 26, 1954) is a Turkish politician who has served as Prime Minister (2003-2014) and President (2014-) of Turkey. He founded the Justice and Development Party (AKP) and has ruled for over twenty years, making him one of the longest-serving national leaders in the Middle East. His political core encompasses: neo-Ottoman foreign policy—extending Turkish influence from the Balkans and Middle East to North Africa and Central Asia through Libyan intervention, Syrian military operations, and Eastern Mediterranean energy exploration; Islamic conservative democracy—breaking the Kemalist secular elite system, lifting headscarf bans, promoting religious freedom; judicial reform and presidential transformation—a 2017 referendum approved administrative restructuring that abolished the prime minister post and established a strong presidential system; media control—massive purge and takeover of opposition media after the 2016 failed coup, pushing Turkey's media concentration to Europe's highest levels; Syria policy—supporting Syrian opposition forces, targeting Kurdish militias, and intervening in Libya and Nagorno-Karabakh; economic development—initial neoliberal reforms achieving 8% annual growth, massive infrastructure construction (airports, bridges, tunnels), but later encountering lira crisis and high inflation. After the 2016 failed coup, his power further consolidated through state of emergency purges affecting hundreds of thousands. In 2023, he narrowly won the runoff election, beginning his fifth presidential term.
TR-ERD-001.reason_zh: 核心思维模式：M540（新奥斯曼主义/正义发展党治理/司法改革/媒体控制/叙利亚干预/经济发展）。埃尔多安体现了从伊斯兰保守政党领袖到强总统的转型路径。他通过新奥斯曼主义外交将土耳其地区影响力从巴尔干扩展至北非和中亚，利用历史遗产构建跨区域战略同盟。他打破了凯末尔主义世俗精英对政治的垄断，将伊斯兰保守价值观与经济发展实用主义相结合，创造了独特的'伊斯兰保守民主'模式。2017年行政体制改革建立总统制是其政治工程的核心成果。2016年未遂政变后的大规模清洗巩固了其权力基础，同时实施了欧洲最高水平的媒体集中控制。在叙利亚和利比亚的军事干预展现了新奥斯曼主义的现实投射，而早期的经济高速增长则体现了发展型国家模式的土耳其版本。
TR-ERD-001.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M540 (Neo-Ottomanism/Justice and Development Party Governance/Judicial Reform/Media Control/Syria Intervention/Economic Development). Erdoğan embodies the transformation path from Islamic conservative party leader to strong president. He extended Turkey's regional influence from the Balkans to North Africa and Central Asia through neo-Ottoman foreign policy, leveraging historical legacy to build cross-regional strategic alliances. He broke the Kemalist secular elite's monopoly on politics, combining Islamic conservative values with economic development pragmatism to create a unique 'Islamic conservative democracy' model. The 2017 administrative reform establishing the presidential system was the core achievement of his political engineering. The massive purges after the 2016 failed coup consolidated his power base while implementing Europe's highest level of media concentration. Military interventions in Syria and Libya demonstrated the realistic projection of neo-Ottomanism, while early economic growth exemplified Turkey's version of the developmental state model.
steps_zh: 第1步：新奥斯曼思维法——地区秩序重塑：从历史帝国遗产出发，识别土耳其在地中海、巴尔干、中东和北非的战略利益交汇点
第2步：政党治理思维法——伊斯兰保守民主：打破凯末尔主义世俗精英体制，以宗教保守价值观结合经济实用主义构建执政基础
第3步：制度变革思维法——总统制转型：通过2017年公投推动行政体制改革，取消总理职位，建立强总统制框架
第4步：危机应对思维法——未遂政变后的权力巩固：利用2016年政变危机实施大规模清洗，重建安全与情报体系
第5步：地缘博弈思维法——叙利亚/利比亚干预：以军事和外交手段投射地区影响力，平衡北约、俄罗斯和中东各方利益
steps_en: Step 1: Neo-Ottoman Thinking Method - Regional order reshaping: identifying Turkey's strategic interests across the Mediterranean, Balkans, Middle East and North Africa through historical imperial legacy

Step 2: Party Governance Thinking Method - Islamic conservative democracy: breaking the Kemalist secular elite system, building ruling foundation by combining religious conservative values with economic pragmatism

Step 3: Institutional Reform Thinking Method - Presidential transformation: pushing administrative restructuring through 2017 referendum, abolishing the prime minister post, establishing strong presidential framework
Step 4: Crisis Response Thinking Method - Power consolidation post-coup attempt: using the 2016 coup crisis to implement massive purges, rebuilding security and intelligence apparatus
Step 5: Geopolitical Gaming Thinking Method - Syria/Libya intervention: projecting regional influence through military and diplomatic means, balancing NATO, Russia and Middle Eastern interests
expected_zh: 将土耳其从地区大国重塑为跨区域的战略力量（新奥斯曼主义）

完成从议会制到总统制的政治体制转型

实现大规模基础设施建设和经济现代化（后期面临通胀危机）
expected_en: Transform Turkey from regional power to cross-regional strategic force (neo-Ottomanism)
Establish ruling model combining Islamic conservative values with economic development
Complete political transition from parliamentary system to presidential system
Establish Turkey-led security order in Syria and Libya
Achieve massive infrastructure construction and economic modernization (later facing inflation crisis)
TR-ERD-001.case_zh: 1954年出生于伊斯坦布尔费内尔区；1994年当选伊斯坦布尔市长；1998年因朗读宗教诗歌被监禁六个月；2001年创立正义与发展党 (AKP)；2003年担任总理，开启长期执政；2011-2015年AKP连续三次大选获胜，巩固权力基础；2013年遭盖齐公园抗议冲击但成功镇压；2014年成为土耳其首位直选总统；2016年7月15日未遂军事政变后宣布紧急状态，清洗数十万公务员、军人和教师；2017年公投通过行政体制改革取消总理职位，建立总统制；2018年就任首任总统制下的总统；在叙利亚支持反对派、打击YPG、2019年进攻曼比季；2020年介入利比亚内战支持民族团结政府；2023年在选举第二轮险胜基利奇达尔奥卢连任，开启第五个总统任期。
TR-ERD-001.case_en: Born in Fatih district, Istanbul 1954; elected Mayor of Istanbul 1994; imprisoned six months in 1998 for reciting a religious poem; founded the Justice and Development Party (AKP) in 2001; became Prime Minister 2003, beginning extended rule; AKP won three consecutive elections (2011-2015), consolidating power base; survived Gezi Park protests 2013 but crushed them; became Turkey's first directly elected President 2014; failed military coup on July 15, 2016 followed by mass purges of hundreds of thousands of civil servants, military personnel and teachers; 2017 referendum approved administrative reform abolishing PM post, establishing presidential system; inaugurated as first president under new system 2018; supported Syrian opposition, targeted YPG, invaded Manbij 2019; intervened in Libyan civil war 2020 supporting GNA; narrowly won runoff election against Kılıçdaroğlu in 2023, beginning fifth presidential term.

AT-MET-001.name_zh: 梅特涅/奥地利/维也纳体系/均势/保守/圣同盟/外交大师
AT-MET-001.description_zh: 勒奥·约瑟夫·安东·梅特涅（1773-1859），奥地利政治家，1806年-1814年担任奥地利帝国外交部长，1814年-1821年担任帝国国务部长，1815年发起维也纳体系和圣同盟，主张保守主义，欧洲反革命领导人，维也纳会议主要推动者，建立欧洲均势外交体系，领导欧洲反拿破仑斗争，1808年-1848年担任奥地利帝国国务大臣，倡导强硬外交政策，维持欧洲长期和平。
AT-MET-001.description_en: Klemens Wenzel Nepomuk Lothar, Prince von Metternich (1773-1859), Austrian politician, served as Austrian Foreign Minister (1806-1814) and Imperial Secretary of State (1814-1821), initiated Vienna System and Holy Alliance in 1815, advocated conservatism, European counter-revolution leader, key promoter of Vienna Congress, established European balance of power diplomatic system, led European anti-Napoleon struggle, served as Imperial Secretary of State (1808-1848), advocated strong diplomatic policy, maintained long-term European peace.
AT-MET-001.reason_zh: 梅特涅是欧洲保守主义外交体系的核心 architect，以维也纳体系和圣同盟为代表，建立均势外交原则，领导欧洲反拿破仑联盟，维护欧洲长期和平，其外交理念和体系结构成为欧洲国际关系的基础。
AT-MET-001.reason_en: Metternich was the core architect of European conservative diplomatic system, represented by Vienna System and Holy Alliance, established balance of power diplomatic principles, led European anti-Napoleon coalition, maintained long-term European peace, his diplomatic ideas and system structure became the foundation of European international relations.

AT-FRE-001.name_zh: 弗洛伊德/奥地利/精神分析/潜意识/梦/性/维也纳/犹太/伦敦
AT-FRE-001.description_zh: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德（1856-1939），奥地利犹太精神病医师，现代心理学的创始人，弗洛伊德精神分析学派创始人，精神分析理论体系构建者，潜意识/梦的解析/性心理学理论建立者，维也纳精神分析学派领袖，later 移居伦敦，领导犹太流亡精神治疗工作，提出俄狄浦斯情结/泛性论/精神传导理论，出版《梦的解析》/《性学三论》/《精神传导论》，其理论对现代心理学/文化研究/哲学产生深远影响。
AT-FRE-001.description_en: Sigmund Freud (1856-1939), Austrian Jewish psychiatrist, founder of modern psychology, founder of Freud psychoanalysis school, mental analysis theory system constructor, unconscious/dream interpretation/sexology theory founder, leader of Vienna psychoanalysis school, later emigrated to London, led Jewish exile mental treatment work, proposed Oedipus complex/generality theory/psychical transmission theory, published "The Interpretation of Dreams"/"Three Essays on the Theory of Sexuality"/"Psychical Transmission Theory", his theory profoundly influenced modern psychology/cultural studies/philosophy.
AT-FRE-001.reason_zh: 弗洛伊德是现代心理学和精神分析学派的创始人，其理论体系彻底改变了人类对心理的理解，提出潜意识/梦的解析/性心理学等概念，成为20世纪心理学/文化研究/哲学领域最重要的理论之一。
AT-FRE-001.reason_en: Freud was founder of modern psychology and psychoanalysis school, his theory system thoroughly changed human understanding of psychology, proposed unconscious/dream interpretation/sexology concepts, became one of 20th century psychology/cultural studies/philosophy most important theories.

PK-ABD-001.name_zh: 阿卜杜斯·萨拉姆：伊斯兰科学/诺贝尔奖/少数派身份/总统/物理学家/理论物理学
PK-ABD-001.name_en: Abdus Salam: Islamic Science/Nobel Prize/Minority Identity/President/Physicist/Theoretical Physics
PK-ABD-001.description_zh: 阿卜杜斯·萨拉姆是巴基斯坦的著名物理学家，1926-1996年，他在理论物理学领域做出了重大贡献，尤其是在统一场理论和弱相互作用方面。萨拉姆赢得了1979年诺贝尔物理学奖，与史瓦皮萨特和温伯格分享。他还担任过巴基斯坦的第三任总统（1974-1978年），致力于推动伊斯兰科学与现代科学的融合，促进巴基斯坦的教育和科技发展。他的多宗教背景和对科学的热爱使他成为连接伊斯兰世界和全球科学界的桥梁。
PK-ABD-001.description_en: Abdus Salam was a prominent Pakistani physicist from 1926 to 1996, who made significant contributions in theoretical physics, particularly in unified field theory and weak interactions. Salam won the 1979 Nobel Prize in Physics, shared with Schawlow and Weinberg. He also served as the third President of Pakistan (1974-1978), dedicated to promoting the integration of Islamic science with modern science and advancing Pakistan's education and technology development. His multi-religious background and love for science made him a bridge between the Islamic world and global science.
PK-ABD-001.reason_zh: 萨拉姆赢得了诺贝尔奖，提升了巴基斯坦的国际地位，但他的总统任期引发了国内政治争议。他致力于伊斯兰科学与现代科学的融合，但这在保守派中引发了担忧。他的多宗教背景和科学信仰使他成为一个独特的文化桥梁，但也引发了身份认同的争议。他的遗产至今仍充满争议。
PK-ABD-001.reason_en: Salam won the Nobel Prize, elevating Pakistan's international status, but his presidency sparked domestic political controversy. His efforts to integrate Islamic science with modern science faced resistance from conservative groups. His multi-religious background and scientific devotion made him a unique cultural bridge but also raised questions about identity and belonging. His legacy remains highly controversial today.
steps_zh: 学习萨拉姆的科学精神和跨文化交流能力，理解在不同文化中推动科学发展的必要性
研究萨拉姆的理论物理学成就，掌握现代物理学的发展历程
分析萨拉姆的跨宗教和平事业，探索在不同文化中促进和谐的方法
探讨萨拉姆的伊斯兰科学思想，理解在宗教框架内推动科学进步的可能性
总结萨拉姆的经验教训，阐述在多文化环境中推动科学和和平的挑战
steps_en: Study Salam's scientific spirit and cross-cultural communication abilities, understand the necessity of promoting science development across different cultures
Study Salam's theoretical physics achievements, master the development process of modern physics
Analyze Salam's interfaith peace efforts, explore methods for promoting harmony across different cultures
Explore Salam's Islamic science ideas, understand the possibilities of promoting science progress within religious frameworks
Summarize Salam's experiences and the challenges of promoting science and peace in multicultural environments
PK-ABD-001.expected_zh: 掌握萨拉姆的科学精神和跨文化交流能力，熟悉现代物理学的发展历程，理解伊斯兰科学与现代科学的融合，分析跨宗教和平事业，培养学生对在多文化环境中推动科学和和平的理解和认识。
PK-ABD-001.expected_en: Master Salam's scientific spirit and cross-cultural communication abilities, be familiar with the development process of modern physics, understand the integration of Islamic science with modern science, analyze interfaith peace efforts, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of promoting science and peace in multicultural environments.
PK-ABD-001.case_zh: 1979年，萨拉姆因统一场理论研究而获得诺贝尔物理学奖，成为首位来自巴基斯坦的诺贝尔奖得主。他担任总统期间，推动了伊斯兰科学与现代科学的融合。1996年，萨拉姆因病去世，他的科学精神和跨文化事业仍在影响着巴基斯坦的科学发展。
PK-ABD-001.case_en: In 1979, Salam won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his research on unified field theory, becoming the first person from Pakistan to receive the Nobel Prize. During his presidency, he promoted the integration of Islamic science with modern science. In 1996, Salam passed away, but his scientific spirit and cross-cultural efforts continue to influence Pakistan's scientific development.
PK-ABD-001.cross_cultural_impact: Nobel Prize winner from Pakistan, integration of Islamic science with modern physics, scientific diplomacy

AT-FRU-001.name_zh: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世/奥地利/哈布斯堡/二元君主/一战/帝国解体/长寿
AT-FRU-001.description_zh: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世（1830-1916），奥匈帝国皇帝（1848-1916），哈布斯堡王朝第68代皇帝，二元君主制创始人，长期执政，为欧洲最长寿领导人之一，领导奥匈帝国度过危机时期，推行温和改革，管理多民族帝国，一战爆发后支持参战，最终导致帝国解体，退位成为奥地利公爵。
AT-FRU-001.description_en: Franz Joseph I (1830-1916), Emperor of Austria (1848-1916), 68th ruler of Habsburg dynasty, founder of dual monarchy, long-term ruler, one of Europe's longest-serving leaders, led Austro-Hungarian Empire through crisis periods, implemented moderate reforms, managed multi-ethnic empire, supported WWI participation after outbreak, eventually led to imperial disintegration, abdicated became Austrian Duke.
AT-FRU-001.reason_zh: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世是奥匈帝国历史中最具象征意义的人物，他跨越了漫长的哈布斯堡统治时期，建立二元君主制，并在一战前后见证了帝国从强盛走向最终崩溃。
AT-FRU-001.reason_en: Franz Joseph I is the most iconic figure in Austro-Hungarian history, spanning a long Habsburg reign, establishing the dual monarchy, and witnessing the empire's transition from strength to its eventual collapse around WWI.
steps_zh: 继位与改革：1848 革命继位/帝国统一/君主立宪尝试/二元君主制构想/君主威权
二元体系建立：1867 协定/奥地利-匈牙利联合/双重帝国/民族自治平衡/君主制稳定
帝国扩张与稳定：1870s 现代化改革/管理多民族平衡/维持帝国稳定/长期执政
一战与解体：1914 萨拉热窝/参战决定/一战冲突/帝国疲惫/1916 逝世/帝国崩溃/结局
遗产与意义：1848-1916 统治/帝国记忆/哈布斯堡传统/奥地利政治根基/历史反思
steps_en: Succession & Reform: 1848 revolution succession/imperial unity/constitutional attempts/dual monarchy concept/monarchic authority
Dual system establishment: 1867 Compromise/Austria-Hungary union/dual empire/ethnic autonomy balance/monarchy stability
Imperial expansion & stability: 1870s modernization reforms/managing multi-ethnic balance/maintaining stability/long reign
WWI & Disintegration: 1914 Sarajevo/war declaration/WWI conflict/imperial exhaustion/1916 death/collapse/outcome
Legacy & significance: 1848-1916 reign/imperial memory/Habsburg tradition/Austrian political roots/historical reflection
AT-FRU-001.expected_zh: 构建奥匈帝国多民族帝国的君主统治范式，通过二元君主制维持长期的多民族帝国管理，反映哈布斯堡王朝在近代民族国家挑战下的崩溃过程。
AT-FRU-001.expected_en: Built the monarchical governance paradigm for a multi-ethnic empire, maintained long-term management through the dual monarchy, reflecting the Habsburg collapse under the challenges of modern nation-states.
AT-FRU-001.case_zh: 1830 出生/1848 继位/1867 二元协议/1914 一战/1916 逝世/帝国解体/哈布斯堡/奥地利/约瑟夫/永存。
AT-FRU-001.cross_cultural_impact: Dual monarchy establishment; multi-ethnic imperial management model; pre-WWI European diplomacy influence
AT-FRU-001.spiritual_tradition: Catholic Church support; imperial legitimacy traditions; Jesuit upbringing
AT-FRU-001.colonial_history: Bosnia-Herzegovina occupation/annexation; limited imperial ambitions; inner European dominance
AT-FRU-001.diaspora_influence: None majorly direct; Austrian exile post-monarchy
AT-FRU-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Viennese bureaucratic tradition; Imperial dynastic lore; Multi-ethnic administrative techniques
AT-FRU-001.oral_tradition: Court protocols as oral traditions; Imperial family chronicles; Community authorization: Austrian National Archives 2023

AR-PER-002.description_zh: 卡洛斯·梅内姆 (1930-) 阿根廷总统 (1989-1999) 实施货币板经济政策，推动大规模私有化改革，通过赦免政策解决债务危机，建立里奥哈家族政治网络，与美国建立紧密经济关系，推动阿根廷经济现代化，但也留下政治腐败和经济危机遗产。
AR-PER-002.description_en: Carlos Menem (1930-) Argentine President (1989-1999) implemented currency board economic policy, promoted large-scale privatization reforms, through amnesty policy solved debt crisis, established Rioja family political network, established close economic relations with United States, promoted Argentine economic modernization, but also left political corruption and economic crisis legacy.
AR-PER-002.reason_zh: 梅内姆代表拉美经济转型时期如何通过货币稳定换取政治改革，如何利用私有化实现经济振兴，以及政治赦免如何影响国家长期治理，体现了拉美经济改革的复杂性。
AR-PER-002.reason_en: Menem represents how Latin American economic transition period stabilizes currency through political reform, achieves economic revitalization through privatization, and political amnesty influences national long-term governance, embodies complexity of Latin American economic reform.

CL-BAC-002.name_zh: 巴切莱特/智利/女性/医生/社会/养老金/米歇尔/温和/改革
CL-BAC-002.description_zh: 米歇尔·巴切莱特 (1951-) 智利总统 (2006-2010, 2014-2018) 第一位女总统，医生出身，推行社会改革、养老金制度改革、教育改革、性别平等立法，倡导温和改革，推动智利社会现代化，被誉为 "社会改革者", 对拉美性别政治产生深远影响。
CL-BAC-002.description_en: Michelle Bachelet (1951-) Chilean President (2006-2010, 2014-2018) first female president, doctor by profession, promoted social reform, pension system reform, education reform, gender equality legislation, advocated moderate reform, promoted Chilean social modernization, known as "social reformer", had profound impact on Latin American gender politics.
CL-BAC-002.reason_zh: 巴切莱特代表拉美女性领导人如何通过社会改革实现国家现代化，如何通过性别平等立法推动社会进步，以及如何通过温和改革实现政治转型，体现了拉美民主转型的进步性。
CL-BAC-002.reason_en: Bachelet represents how Latin American female leaders achieve national modernization through social reform, promote gender equality through legislation, and achieve political transformation through moderate reform, embodies progressiveness of Latin American democratic transition.

CL-PIN-002.name_zh: 皮诺切特/智利/新自由/芝加哥/失踪/宪法/公投/奥古斯托/1980
CL-PIN-002.description_zh: 奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (1915-2006) 智利总统 (1973-1990) 新自由主义经济学家，实施芝加哥经济学政策，通过1980年新宪法和全民公投巩固权力，领导军事独裁统治，推行大规模经济自由化，被誉为 "新自由实验室", 对拉美经济改革产生深远影响。
CL-PIN-002.description_en: Augusto Pinochet (1915-2006) Chilean President (1973-1990) neoliberal economist, implemented Chicago economics policy, through 1980 new Constitution and plebiscite consolidated power, led military dictatorship, promoted large-scale economic liberalization, known as "neoliberal laboratory", had profound impact on Latin American economic reform.

CL-PIN-002.reason_en: Pinochet represents how Latin American military dictators achieve national modernization through economic reform, consolidate power through Constitution and plebiscite, and how neoliberal policies profoundly impact Latin American economy, embodies complexity of Latin American economic transformation.

CR-FIG-001.name_zh: 菲格雷斯/哥斯达黎加/废军/民主/福利/生态/何塞/和平/生物
CR-FIG-001.core_mode: M609 废除军队/福利民主/生态和平/哥斯达黎加模式/无军国家
CR-FIG-001.description_zh: 何塞·菲格雷斯（1906-1990），哥斯达黎加前总统，1953-1966年在位。他是一位哥斯达黎加政治家，前军人，通过领导废除军队运动，实现了哥斯达黎加从军人统治到民主制度的转变。他实施了福利国家政策，建立了社会福利体系，推动了哥斯达黎加的生态保护和和平发展。他的统治时期，哥斯达黎加被称为"无军国家"，成为世界和平与民主的典范。
CR-FIG-001.description_en: Jose Figueres (1906-1990), former President of Costa Rica, served from 1953 to 1966. He was a Costa Rican politician and former military officer, led the Abandon Army Movement to achieve Costa Rica's transition from military rule to democracy. He implemented welfare state policies, established social welfare system, promoted Costa Rica's ecological protection and peaceful development. His rule period, Costa Rica was known as "No Army Country", became a world model of peace and democracy.

His rule period, Costa Rica was known as "No Army Country", became a world model of peace and democracy.

CU-CAS-001.name_zh: 卡斯特罗/古巴/革命/导弹危机/医疗教育/封锁生存
CU-CAS-001.description_zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗（1926-2016），古巴革命领袖、前总统，在位长达54年（1959-2016）。他领导'七二六运动'通过武装斗争推翻巴蒂斯塔独裁政权，建立了拉丁美洲第一个社会主义国家。任内推行全民免费医疗和教育制度，在导弹危机中与美国正面抗衡并成功抵御美国封锁长达60余年。卡斯特罗以坚韧的政治意志、精妙的外交策略和深厚的群众基础，使古巴成为小国在大国博弈中保持独立的典范。
CU-CAS-001.description_en: Fidel Castro (1926-2016), Cuban revolutionary leader and former president, in power for over 54 years (1959-2016). He led the '26th July Movement' to overthrow the Batista dictatorship through armed struggle, establishing Latin America's first socialist state. During his tenure he implemented universal free healthcare and education systems, stood down to the United States during the Missile Crisis, and successfully withstood American blockade for over 60 years. Castro's tenacious political will, sophisticated diplomatic strategy and deep popular support made Cuba a model of how small nations maintain independence amid great power competition.
CU-CAS-001.reason_zh: 卡斯特罗代表了小国在大国博弈中通过革命建国、坚持独立道路的典范。他从律师转型为游击战士，从社会主义建设者到长期执政者的角色转变，展现了拉美左翼政治的复杂性和韧性。导弹危机中的战略博弈、全民医疗教育制度的建立、以及60年封锁下的生存智慧，都是研究小国地缘政治的必读案例。
CU-CAS-001.reason_en: Castro represents the paradigm of how a small nation maintains an independent revolutionary path amid great power competition. His transformation from lawyer to guerrilla fighter, and from socialist builder to long-term ruler, demonstrates the complexity and resilience of Latin American left-wing politics. The strategic maneuvering during the Missile Crisis, establishment of universal healthcare and education systems, and survival wisdom under 60 years of blockade are essential case studies for understanding small-nation geopolitics.

CU-CAS-001.expected_zh: 掌握卡斯特罗从法学家到革命领袖的思想转变，理解古巴革命的军事战略和社会主义建设路径，评估导弹危机和小国在封锁下生存的外交智慧。
CU-CAS-001.expected_en: Master Castro's ideological transformation from jurist to revolutionary leader, understand Cuba's military strategy and socialist construction path, and evaluate the diplomatic wisdom of missile crisis negotiation and small-nation survival under blockade.
CU-CAS-001.case_zh: 1953年7月26日，卡斯特罗率160余名支持者袭击蒙卡达兵营和巴亚莫军营，失败后被捕。1955年在特赦出狱后立即流亡墨西哥组织'七二六运动'。1956年12月乘坐'格拉玛号'登陆古巴，仅约20人生还后进入马埃斯特腊山区建立根据地。1959年1月1日巴蒂斯塔逃亡，卡斯特罗率军进入哈瓦那。革命后推行土地改革法令（1959）、全民免费医疗制度、全国扫盲运动。1962年导弹危机中，他将苏联核导弹部署至古巴，与美国正面博弈13天最终迫使美国撤回在土耳其的导弹。在美国长达60余年的经济封锁下，古巴保持了政治独立。
CU-CAS-001.case_en: On July 26, 1953, Castro led over 160 supporters to attack the Moncada Barracks and Bayamo garrison, was captured after failure. Freed in 1955 by amnesty, he immediately went into exile in Mexico to organize the '26th July Movement.' In December 1956, he landed in Cuba aboard the 'Granma,' with only about 20 survivors entering the Sierra Maestra to establish a base. On January 1, 1959, Batista fled and Castro's forces entered Havana. Post-revolution he implemented land reform decrees (1959), universal free healthcare, and a nationwide literacy campaign. During the 1962 Missile Crisis he deployed Soviet nuclear missiles to Cuba, engaging in a 13-day confrontation with the United States that ultimately forced America to withdraw missiles from Turkey. Under over 60 years of American economic blockade, Cuba maintained political independence.
CU-CAS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Latin American socialist leader, Cuban Revolution icon, small-nation diplomacy model

CU-CHE-001.name_zh: 切·格瓦拉/阿根廷/古巴/玻利维亚/游击/国际主义革命
CU-CHE-001.description_zh: 切·格瓦拉（1928-1967），阿根廷医生、马克思主义革命家，拉丁美洲最具影响力的国际主义战士。他与卡斯特罗共同领导古巴革命（1956-1959），在新生政权中担任重要职务，推动土地改革和扫盲运动。革命后他离开古巴，在玻利维亚、刚果等地继续推行国际主义游击战略，最终在玻利维亚被俘牺牲。格瓦拉将马克思主义与拉美本土革命实践相结合，其《游击战》著作和'新人'理论对全球反殖民运动产生了深远影响。
CU-CHE-001.description_en: Che Guevara (1928-1967), Argentine doctor and Marxist revolutionary, the most influential internationalist fighter in Latin America. He jointly led the Cuban Revolution (1956-1959) with Castro, holding key positions in the new regime and implementing land reform and literacy campaigns. After the revolution, he left Cuba to continue his internationalist guerrilla strategy in Bolivia and Congo, ultimately captured and executed in Bolivia. Guevara combined Marxism with Latin American revolutionary practice; his writings on guerrilla warfare and 'New Man' theory had a profound impact on global anti-colonial movements.
CU-CHE-001.reason_zh: 切·格瓦拉代表了拉美革命者将马克思主义理论与本土游击实践相结合的典范。他的国际主义精神超越了国界，从古巴到玻利维亚的持续革命实践展现了反殖民斗争的全球视野。其'新人'理论和游击战学说对20世纪全球解放运动产生了不可磨灭的影响，成为反帝国主义斗争的精神象征。
CU-CHE-001.reason_en: Che Guevara represents the paradigm of Latin American revolutionaries combining Marxist theory with local guerrilla practice. His internationalist spirit transcended borders, and his continuous revolutionary practice from Cuba to Bolivia demonstrated a global vision of anti-colonial struggle. His 'New Man' theory and guerrilla warfare doctrine left an indelible impact on 20th-century global liberation movements, becoming a spiritual symbol of anti-imperialist struggle.

CU-CHE-001.expected_zh: 掌握切·格瓦拉从阿根廷医生到国际主义革命家的思想转变历程，理解古巴革命中他的军事指挥和治国贡献，评估其游击战理论和'新人'思想对全球反殖民运动的深远影响。
CU-CHE-001.expected_en: Master Che Guevara's ideological transformation from Argentine doctor to internationalist revolutionary, understand his military command and governance contributions during the Cuban Revolution, and evaluate the profound impact of his guerrilla warfare theory and 'New Man' thought on global anti-colonial movements.
CU-CHE-001.case_zh: 1956年12月，格瓦拉与卡斯特罗率82名起义者乘坐'格拉玛号'登陆古巴，在马埃斯特腊山区建立游击根据地。1958年12月，他指挥东部战线发起攻势，攻占比亚克拉巴城，切断了哈瓦那与东部的联系，直接导致巴蒂斯塔政权崩溃。革命胜利后，他担任国家银行行长和工业部长，推动土地改革法令、工业化计划和全国扫盲运动。1965年他离开古巴发表《致第三世界人民的信》，随后在刚果和玻利维亚领导游击战，1967年10月9日在玻利维亚被俘牺牲。
CU-CHE-001.case_en: In December 1956, Guevara and Castro landed 82 revolutionaries aboard the 'Granma' in Cuba, establishing guerrilla bases in the Sierra Maestra. In December 1958, he commanded the eastern front offensive, capturing Santa Clara and cutting off Havana's connection to the east, directly leading to Batista's regime collapse. After revolutionary victory, he served as president of the National Bank and Minister of Industry, implementing land reform decrees, industrialization plans, and a nationwide literacy campaign. In 1965 he left Cuba to publish his 'Letter to the Third World Peoples,' subsequently leading guerrilla warfare in Congo and Bolivia, captured and executed on October 9, 1967 in Bolivia.
CU-CHE-001.cross_cultural_impact: Latin American revolutionary icon, global anti-imperialist symbol

GT-ARB-001.core_mode: M605 土地改革/跨国公司/CIA政变/切觉醒/900号法令
GT-ARB-001.description_zh: 雅科沃·阿本斯（1913-1971），危地马拉前总统，1951-1954年在位。他是一位危地马拉政治家，前农场主，通过实施土地改革和没收联合果品公司的土地，引发了联合果品公司的不满和美国的干预。1954年，美国支持的叛乱部队推翻了阿本斯政府，阿本斯流亡国外。他的统治时期，危地马拉实施了土地改革，但也引发了跨国公司的干预和美国的入侵。
GT-ARB-001.description_en: Jacobo Arbenz (1913-1971), former President of Guatemala, served from 1951 to 1954. He was a Guatemalan politician and former farmer, implemented land reform and confiscated United Fruit Company land, causing United Fruit Company dissatisfaction and US intervention. In 1954, US-supported rebel forces overthrew the Arbenz government, and Arbenz fled abroad. During his rule, Guatemala implemented land reform, but also provoked multinational corporate intervention and US invasion.

NI-ORT-001.core_mode: M608 革命独裁/选举循环/桑地诺异化/罗莎里奥/家族统治
NI-ORT-001.description_zh: 丹尼尔·奥尔特加（1952-至今），尼加拉瓜前总统，1985-1990年在位。他是一位尼加拉瓜政治家，前战士，通过领导桑地诺革命推翻了美国支持的索摩扎政权。奥尔特加是桑地诺革命的领导者之一，领导了尼加拉瓜的解放斗争。他在领导革命中，提出了"革命独裁"理论，体现了桑地诺异化现象。他的统治时期，尼加拉瓜实现了从独裁到革命的过渡，但也面临了美国的持续干预和国内政治循环。
NI-ORT-001.description_en: Daniel Ortega (1952-present), former President of Nicaragua, served from 1985 to 1990. He was a Nicaraguan politician and former guerrilla fighter, led Sandinista Revolution to overthrow US-backed Somoza dictatorship. Ortega was one of the leaders of Sandinista Revolution, led Nicaragua's liberation struggle. He proposed "revolutionary dictatorship" theory in leading the revolution, exemplified Sandinista alienation. His rule period, Nicaragua achieved transition from dictatorship to revolution, but also faced continuous US intervention and domestic political cycle.

His rule period, Nicaragua achieved transition from dictatorship to revolution, but also faced continuous US intervention and domestic political cycle.

PA-NOR-001.description_zh: 曼努埃尔·诺列加（1938-至今），巴拿马前总统，1983-1990年在位。他是一位巴拿马政治家，前军官，通过领导巴拿马毒品走私和美国入侵，实现了巴拿马的独立和运河主权。诺列加是独裁统治者，通过毒品走私和美国的干预，巩固了他的权力。他的统治时期，巴拿马经历了毒品走私和美国入侵，导致国内政治动荡。
PA-NOR-001.description_en: Manuel Noriega (1938-present), former President of Panama, served from 1983 to 1990. He was a Panamanian politician and former military officer, led Panama's drug smuggling and US intervention to achieve Panama's independence and canal sovereignty. Noriega was a dictator, through drug smuggling and US intervention, consolidated his power. His rule period, Panama experienced drug smuggling and US invasion, leading to domestic political turmoil.

SV-ROM-001.core_mode: M606 解放神学/大主教殉道/真相委员会/圣人/弥撒遇刺
SV-ROM-001.description_zh: 奥斯卡·罗梅罗（1917-1980），萨尔瓦多前大主教，1974-1980年在位。他是一位天主教神父，通过传播解放神学的思想和支持萨尔瓦多人民的权利，领导了萨尔瓦多的解放斗争。他呼吁为萨尔瓦多人民的解放和正义而奋斗，并反对政府的镇压。在1980年的一次弥撒中，罗梅罗遇刺身亡，成为殉道者。他的殉道精神激励了萨尔瓦多人民的解放斗争。
SV-ROM-001.description_en: Óscar Romero (1917-1980), former Archbishop of El Salvador, served from 1974 to 1980. He was a Catholic priest who spread the ideas of liberation theology and led El Salvador's liberation struggle by supporting the rights of El Salvador's people. He called for El Salvador's people's liberation and justice and opposed government repression. During a mass in 1980, Romero was assassinated and became a martyr. His martyrdom inspired El Salvador's people's liberation struggle.
SV-ROM-001.reason_zh: 罗梅罗是萨尔瓦多天主教神父，通过传播解放神学的思想和支持萨尔瓦多人民的权利，领导了萨尔瓦多的解放斗争。他的殉道精神激励了萨尔瓦多人民的解放斗争，体现了天主教会对社会正义的追求。

His martyrdom inspired El Salvador's people's liberation struggle, exemplified Catholic Church's pursuit of social justice.

KG-AKA-001.description_en: Askar Akayev (born 1944) was President of Kyrgyzstan (1990-2005). Physicist-turned-president peacefully led country towards democracy. Tulip Revolution in 2005 led to his exile in Moscow. His physics mindset influenced Central Asian political development.

KG-AKA-001.reason_en: Akayev's governance wisdom exemplified in physics mindset and democratic transition. Led country towards democracy through physics approach. Tulip Revolution embodied Kyrgyz democratic awakening. His exile demonstrated Central Asian political transformation complexity.

KZ-NAZ-001.description_zh: 努尔苏丹·阿比什·乌拉·纳扎尔巴耶夫（1940 年出生）是哈萨克斯坦总统（1990-2019 年）。领导国家实现核武器放弃和多楔外交战略。2019 年首都从阿拉木图迁至努尔苏丹。作为三十年总统，他实现了哈萨克斯坦的稳定转型和独立。
KZ-NAZ-001.description_en: Nursultan Abishovich Nazarbayev (born 1940) was President of Kazakhstan (1990-2019). Led the country through nuclear weapons abandonment and multi-pronged diplomatic strategy. In 2019, capital city moved from Almaty to Nursultan. As thirty-year president, achieved stability and transition to independence.
KZ-NAZ-001.reason_zh: 纳扎尔巴耶夫的治理智慧体现在资源管理和多楔外交中。通过放弃核武器和稳定转型，哈萨克斯坦实现了独立和稳定。首都迁移体现了前瞻性思维。
KZ-NAZ-001.reason_en: Nazarbayev's governance wisdom exemplified resource management and multi-pronged diplomacy. Through nuclear abandonment and stable transition, Kazakhstan achieved independence and stability. Capital relocation demonstrated forward-thinking governance.

MN-SUK-001.reason_en: Sukhbaatar's governance wisdom exemplified in party leadership and industrial development. Through Gobi Desert development, achieved Mongolian industrialization. Party leadership realized Mongolian stability and development.

OM-QAB-001.description_zh: 卡布斯·本·赛义德（1940-2020）自1970年统治阿曼。他实现了从传统部落国家向现代君主制国家的转型，保持国家中立地位，在地区事务中发挥重要调解作用。阿曼在香料贸易和海洋外交中扮演重要角色。
OM-QAB-001.description_en: Qabus bin Said (1940-2020) ruled Oman from 1970 until his death. He transformed Oman from a traditional tribal state to a modern monarchy, maintaining neutrality in regional affairs while playing a significant mediating role. Oman played crucial roles in spice trade and maritime diplomacy.
OM-QAB-001.reason_zh: 卡布斯的治理智慧体现了稳定转型和外交平衡。通过保持中立和调解角色，阿曼在地区事务中发挥了重要作用。香料贸易和海洋外交是其软实力基础。
OM-QAB-001.reason_en: Qabus's governance wisdom exemplified stability and diplomatic balance. Through neutrality and mediation, Oman played crucial role in regional affairs. Spice trade and maritime diplomacy formed the foundation of its soft power.

TM-NIA-001.description_en: Saparmurat Niyazov (1940-2006) was President of Turkmenistan (1990-2006). Long-term dictatorial rule. Wrote ideological work "Rukhnama". Through golden construction and neutral diplomacy, played significant role in regional affairs. Achieved Turkmenistan's long-term stability and development.
TM-NIA-001.reason_zh: 尼亚佐夫的治理智慧体现在个人崇拜和意识形态控制中。通过黄金建设和中立外交在地区事务中发挥重要作用。鲁赫纳马体现了土库曼斯坦的意识形态控制。他的长期执政实现了国家的稳定和发展。
TM-NIA-001.reason_en: Niyazov's governance wisdom exemplified in personal worship and ideological control. Through golden construction and neutral diplomacy, played significant role in regional affairs. "Rukhnama" reflected Turkmenistan's ideological control. Long-term rule achieved stability and development.

UZ-KAR-001.reason_en: Karimov's governance wisdom exemplified in resource control and dictatorial rule. Through cotton and oil economy, achieved national stability. Islamization policies controlled tribes and religion. Succession crisis was challenge of his rule.

YE-SAL-001.description_en: Ali Abdullah Saleh (1942-2017) was President of Yemen (1978-2017). He led Yemen's north-south unification (1990) but faced subsequent civil wars and tribal conflicts. Supported Houthi movement leading to prolonged conflicts. Cholera epidemic broke out in 2017 after conflict, causing severe humanitarian crisis.
YE-SAL-001.reason_zh: 萨利赫的治理智慧体现了部落政治和国家统一的复杂性。通过支持部落和Houthis，他引发了长期冲突。也门统一面临部落利益和地区冲突的挑战。
YE-SAL-001.reason_en: Saleh's governance wisdom exemplified tribal politics and national unity complexity. By supporting tribes and Houthis, he triggered prolonged conflicts. Yemen unification faced tribal interests and regional conflicts challenges.

AF-AMK-001.core_mode: M633 阿富汗现代化/阿曼努拉改革/伊斯兰现代化/部落平衡/流亡国王

AF-AMK-001.description_zh: 阿曼努拉·汗（1919-1929）是阿富汗国王。他领导阿富汗进行现代化改革，推行教育和妇女权利。建立了阿富汗现代教育体系和法律改革。1919年阿富汗独立后，他推行了一系列现代化改革，包括教育、司法和妇女权利。
AF-AMK-001.description_en: Amanullah Khan (1919-1929) was King of Afghanistan. Led Afghanistan through modernization reforms, education and women rights. Established modern education system and legal reforms. After Afghanistan independence in 1919, he implemented modernization reforms including education, judiciary and women rights.
AF-AMK-001.reason_zh: 阿曼努拉的治理智慧体现在现代化改革和妇女赋权中。通过教育和司法改革实现国家现代化。他的现代化改革推动了阿富汗的进步，但也引发了部落和宗教的抵制。
AF-AMK-001.reason_en: Amanullah's governance wisdom exemplified in modernization reforms and women empowerment. Achieved national modernization through education and judicial reforms. Modernization reforms promoted Afghanistan progress but triggered tribal and religious resistance.

Women empowerment: 1919-1929 Women rights education/Social participation/International status/Nation image/Soft power
International participation: 1919-1929 International relations establishment/International status elevation/International cooperation/International image/Global influence

AF-AMK-001.expected_en: Achieve national modernization and stable development, promote Afghanistan progress through education and judicial reforms.

ML-MAN-001.reason_en: Mansa Musa led the Mali Empire to its zenith, driving trans-Saharan trade through gold diplomacy and Islamic scholarship, promoting Timbuktu as an academic center. Gold wealth supported the legendary Makkah pilgrimage, showcasing Islamic world power.
